قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرِ الْبَاقِرُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «أَلا أَحَكِي لَكُمْ وُضُوءَ رَسُولِ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ » فَقِيلَ لَهُ بَلَى
فَدَعَا بِقَعْبٍ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ مِنْ مَاءٍ فَوَضَعَهُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ حَسَرَ عَنْ ذِرَاعَيْهِ ثُمَّ غَمَسَ فِيهِ كَفَّهُ ٱلْيُمْنَى ثُمَّ قَالَ «هَذَا
إِذَا كَانَتِ الْكَفّ طَاهِرَةً» ثُمَّ غَرَفَ مِلْأَهَا مَاءً ثُمَّ وَضَعَهُ عَلَى جَبْهَتِهِ وَقَالَ « بِسْمِ اللَّهِ » وَ سَيَّلَهُ عَلَى أَطرَافِ لِحْيَتِهِ
ثُمّ أَمَرَّ يَدَهُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ وَ ظَاهِرٍ جَبِينَيْهِ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً ثُمَّ غَمَسَ يَدَهُ ٱلْيُسْرَى فَغَرَفَ بِهَا مِلْأَهَا ثُمَّ وَضَعَهُ عَلَى مِرْفَقِهِ
اَلْيُمْنَى فَأَمَرَّ كَفَّهُ عَلَى سَاعِدِهِ حَتَّى جَرَى الْمَاءُ عَلَى أَطْرَافِ أَصَابِعِهِ ثُمَّ غَرَفَ بِيَمِينِهِ مِلْأَهَا فَوَضَعَهُ عَلَى مِرْفَقِهِ
الْأَيْسَرِ فَأَمَرَّ كَفَّهُ عَلَى سَاعِدِهِ حَتَّى جَرَى الْمَاءُ عَلَى أَطْرَافٍ أَصَابِعِهِ وَ مَسَحَ عَلَى مُقَدَّمِ رَأْسِهِ وَ ظَهْرِ قَدَمَيْهِ بِبِلَّةِ
بَقِيَّةٍ مَائِهِ.
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"Shall I not describe the ablution of the Messenger of Allah {saws} to you?"
They replied: "Yes."
Imam {a.s} then called for a bowl containing some water and placed it in front of him.
He rolled up his sleeves, dipped his right hand into the water, and said: "This is if the
hand is pure."
Imam {a.s} then scooped a full handful of water, placed it on his forehead, "In the name
of Allah {SWT}," allowing the water to flow over the edges of his beard.
Then Imam {a.s} passed his hand over his face and the front of his temples once.
Imam {a.s} dipped his left hand into the water, scooped a full handful, and placed it on
his right elbow, running his hand along his forearm until the water flowed over the tips
of his fingers.
Imam {a.s} then scooped with his right hand again and placed it on his left elbow,
running his hand along his forearm until the water flowed over the tips of his fingers.
He then wiped front of his head and the tops of his feet with the leftover moisture from
the water.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE DESCRIPTION OF THE ABLUTION OF THE MESSENGER OF ALLAH {saws}
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيّ: «أَنْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ تَوَضَّأْ ثُمَّ مَسَحَ عَلَى نَعْلَيْهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ ٱلْمُغِيرَةُ أنَسِيتَ يَا رَسُولَ
اللّه قَالَ «بَلْ أنْتَ نَسِيتَ هَكَذَا أَمَرَنِي رَبِّي».
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} performed wudu and then wiped over his sandals.
Al-Mughirah said to him: "Did you forget, O’ Messenger of Allah {saws}?"
He {saws} replied: "No, rather it is you who has forgotten. This is how my Lord {AZJ}
commanded me."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 286 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 460

Chapter Title: THE DESCRIPTION OF THE ABLUTION OF THE MESSENGER OF ALLAH {saws}
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «وَ اللّهِ مَا كَانَ وُضُوءُ رَسُولِ اللْهِ صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ إِلا مَرَةً مَرَةً وَ تَوَضَّا
اَلنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ مَرَّةً مَرَّةً» فَقَالَ «هَذَا وُضُوءً لاَ يَقْبَلُ اللَّهُ الصَّلاَةَ إِلاَّ بِهِ.
فأما الاخبار التى رويت فى أن الوضوء مرتين مرتين:
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"By Allah {SWT}, the ablution of the Messenger of Allah {saws} was performed only once for
each part, and The Prophet {saws} performed wudu once for each action."
Imam {a.s} said: "This is an ablution that Allah {SWT} does not accept the prayer without
it”.
commentary:
As for the reports that have been narrated about performing wudu twice for each
action: (continues to next hadith)
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 318 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 438

Chapter Title: THE DESCRIPTION OF THE ABLUTION OF THE MESSENGER OF ALLAH {saws}
arabic_text:
بِإِسَادٍ مُنْقَطِعٍ يَرْوِيهِ أَبُو جَعْفَرِ الْأَحْوَلُ ذَكَرَهُ عَمَّنْ رَوَاهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «فَرَضَ آللَّهُ
ٱلْوُضُوءَ وَاجِدَةً وَاجِدَةً وَ وَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ لِلنَّاسِ اِثْنَتَيْنِ اِثْنَتَيْنِ.
وهذا على جهة الانكار، لا على جهة الاخبار، كأنه عليه السلام يقول: حد اللّٰه حدا فتجاوزه رسول اللّٰه صلى اللّٰه عليه وآله
وتعداه وقد قال اللّٰه تعالى: "•) وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ ظَلَمَ نَفْسَهُ )
english_text:
In a broken chain of narration, Abu Ja'far al-Ahwal recounts from those who
narrated from Abu Abdullah {a.s} who said: "Allah {SWT} made ablution (wudu) obligatory
once for each action, but the Messenger of Allah {saws} prescribed it twice for the
people”.
commentary:
The chain of narration is disconnected, and this is in the form of denial (that Prophet
‘exceeded’ the limit of Allah {SWT}), and not informing (of the limit being exceeded).
Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} recalled this report is in the context to refute it, and not to ‘report’
it.
This is stated in a manner of condemnation, rather than mere reporting, as if He {a.s} is
saying: ‘Allah {SWT} has set a limit, and the Messenger of Allah {saws} has ‘exceeded’ it?
(How can this be?) when Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, has said: "And whoever transgresses
the limits of Allah {SWT} has certainly wronged himself."’ (Surah At Talaq 65:1)
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 318 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 439

Chapter Title: THE DESCRIPTION OF THE ABLUTION OF THE MESSENGER OF ALLAH {saws}
arabic_text:
وَ قَدْ رُوِيَ: «أَنْ ٱلْوُضُوءَ حَدٌّ مِنْ حُدُودِ اللّهِ لِيَعْلَمَ اللَّهُ مَنْ يُطِيعُهُ وَ مَنْ يَعْصِيهِ وَ أَنَّ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَ لا يُنَجِّسُهُ شَيْءَ
وَ إِنَّمَا يَكْفِيهِ مِثَلُ الدَّهْنِ.
english_text:
It has been narrated (by Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} ) that:
"Ablution is a limit set by Allah {SWT} so that He may know who obeys Him and who
disobeys Him. And a believer is not made impure by anything ; rather, something like
oil is sufficient for him”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 21 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 1, p. 279 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 138 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 309 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 438 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 484 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 77, p. 127 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 77, p. 288

Chapter Title: THE DESCRIPTION OF THE ABLUTION OF THE MESSENGER OF ALLAH {saws}
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ ٱلصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ تَعَدَّى فِي وُضُوئِهِ كَانَ كَنَاقِضِهِ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Whoever exceeds the prescribed limits in his ablution (wudu) is like one who nullifies
it”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 313 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 438

Chapter Title: THE DESCRIPTION OF THE ABLUTION OF THE MESSENGER OF ALLAH {saws}
arabic_text:
وَ فِي ذَلِكَ حَدِيثُ آخَرُ بِإِسْتَادٍ مُنقَطِعِ رَوَاهُ عَمْرُو بْنُ أَبِي الْمِقْدَامِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَنْ سَمِعَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «إِنِّي لَأَعْجَبُ مِمْنُ يَرْغَبُ أَنْ يَتَوَضَّا اِثْنَتَيْنِ اِثْنَتَيْنِ وَ قَدْ تَوَضَّأَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
اِثْنَتَيْنِ اِثْنَتَيْنِ فَإِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَانَ يُجَدَّدُ الْوُضُوءَ لِكُلِّ فَرِيضَةٍ وَ لِكُلِّ صَلاَةٍ.
فمعنى الحديث هو اني لأعجب ممن يرغب عن تجديد الوضوء وقد جدده النبي صلى اللّٰه عليه وآله، والخبر الذي روي
أن من زاد على مرتين لم يؤجر " يؤكد ما ذكرته ومعناه أن تجديده بعد التجديد لا أجر له كالاذان، من صلى الظهر والعصر
بأذان وإقامتين أجزأه ومن أذن للعصر كان أفضل، والاذان الثالث بدعة لا أجر له، وكذلك ما روي أن مرتين أفضل معناه
التجديد، وكذلك ما روي مرتين أنه إسباغ.
english_text:
In another narration with a broken chain, Amr ibn Abi al-Miqdam said: "I was
informed by someone who heard Abu Abdullah {a.s} say: 'I am amazed at those who
prefer to perform wudu twice, while the Messenger of Allah {saws} performed it twice.
The Prophet {saws} would renew his ablution for each obligatory prayer and each
prayer.'"
commentary:
The meaning of this narration is that I am astonished at those who neglect to renew
their ablution when the Prophet did so. The report that states "Whoever exceeds twice
will not be rewarded" supports what I have mentioned. It means that renewing wudu
after it has already been done does not carry a reward, similar to the call to prayer
(adhan). For instance, one who prays Dhuhr and Asr with one adhan and two iqamah
suffices, and it is better to call the adhan for Asr as well. The third call to prayer is an
innovation with no reward. The reports indicating that twice is better imply the renewal
of wudu, and those mentioning two times indicate its thoroughness (i.e., performing it
well).
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE DESCRIPTION OF THE ABLUTION OF THE MESSENGER OF ALLAH {saws}
arabic_text: - وَ رُوِيّ: « أنَّ تَجْدِيدَ الْوُضُوءِ لِصَلاَةِ الْعِشَاءِ يَمْحُو لا وَ اللَّهِ وَ بَلَى وَ اللَّهِ.
english_text:
(Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha {a.s} ) narrated that:
"Renewing wudu for the Isha prayer erases sins, by Allah {SWT}, indeed it does, by Allah
{SWT}."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Thawāb al-Aʿmāl wa ʿIqāb al-Aʿmāl, Part 1, p. 17 • Al- Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 366 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 377 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 77, p. 303

Chapter Title: THE DESCRIPTION OF THE ABLUTION OF THE MESSENGER OF ALLAH {saws}
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيَ فِي خَبَرٍ آخَرَ: «أَنَّ الْوُضُوءَ عَلَى ٱلْوُضُوءِ نُورٌ عَلَى نُورٍ وَ مَنْ جَدَّدَ وُضُوءَهُ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَدَثٍ آخَرَ جَدَّدَ
اللّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ تَوْبَتَهُ مِنْ غَيْرِ اِسْتِغْفَارٍ.
وقد فوض الله عز وجل إلى نبيه عليه السلام أمر دينه ولم يفوض إليه تعدي حدوده.
english_text:
(Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} ) narrated in another report that:
"Ablution (wudu) upon wudu is light upon light, and whoever renews their wudu
without having incurred a new state of impurity, Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic, renews
their repentance without requiring further forgiveness."
commentary:
Allah {SWT} Almighty has entrusted the Prophet {saws} with matters of religion, but He did
not entrust him with transgressing the established boundaries set by divine law.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 367

Chapter Title: THE DESCRIPTION OF THE ABLUTION OF THE MESSENGER OF ALLAH {saws}
arabic_text:
وَ قَوْلُ الصَّادِقِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ مَرَّتَيْنِ لَمْ يُؤْجَرْ.
يعني به أنه أتى بغير الذي أمر به ووعد الاجر عليه فلا يستحق الاجر وكذلك كل أجير إذا فعل غير الذي استؤجر عليه لم
يكن له أجرة.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} has narrated;
"Whoever performs wudu twice will not be rewarded."
commentary:
This means that by performing wudu in a manner different from what has been
prescribed, one does not earn the reward that was promised for proper adherence to
the ritual. The comparison is made to a worker who does not perform the task they
were hired for; they would not receive payment for not fulfilling the terms of their
agreement.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 318 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 321 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 438

Chapter Title: THE DESCRIPTION OF THE ABLUTION OF THE AMEER
arabic_text:
باب - صفة وضوء أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام
قَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ: «بَيْنَا أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ ذَاتَ يَوْمِ جَالِسٌ مَعَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحَنَفِيَّةِ إِذْ قَالَ
لَهُ «يَا مُحَمَّدُ اِنْتِنِي بِإِنَاءِ مِنْ مَاءِ أَتَوَضَّأُ لِلصَّلاةِ» فَأْتَاهُ مُحَمَّدٌ بِالْمَاءِ فَأَكْفَأَ بِيَدِهِ ٱلْيُمْنَى عَلَى يَدِهِ ٱلْيُسْرَى ثُمَّ قَالَ
« بِسْمِ اللهِ وَ بِاللَّهِ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ اَلَّذِي جَعَلَ الْمَاءَ طَهُوراً وَ لَمْ يَجْعَلْهُ نَجِساً -» » قَالَ «ثُمَّ اِسْتَنجَى فَقَالَ» « آَللَّهُمَ
حَصِّنْ فَرْجِي وَ أَعِفَّهُ وَ أسْتُرْ عَوْرَتِي وَ حَرَّمْنِي عَلَى النَّارِ» قَالَ «ثُمّ تَمَضْمَضَ فَقَالَ - « ٱللَّهُمْ لَقَنِّي حُجَتِي يَوْمَ
أَلْقَاكَ وَ أَطَلِقُ لِسَانِي بِذِكْرِكَ وَ شُكْرِكَ » ثُمَّ اِسْتَنْشَقَ فَقَالَ - « اللّهُمّ لا تُحَرِّمْ عَلَيَّ رِيحَ الْجَنَّةِ وَ اِجْعَلْنِي مِمَّنْ يَشَمُ
رِيحَهَا وَ رَوْحَهَا وَ طِيبَهَا -» » قَالَ «ثُمَّ غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ فَقَالَ - « اَللّهُمَّ بَيِّضْ وَجْهِي يَوْمَ تَسْوَدُّ فِيهِ الْوُجُوهُ وَ لاَ
تُسَوِّدْ وَجْهِي يَوْمَ تَبْيَضُ فِيهِ ٱلْوُجُوهُ» ثُمَّ غَسَلَ يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى فَقَالَ - « آَللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنِي كِتَابِي بِيَمِينِي وَ الْخَلْدَ فِي
الْجِنَانِ بِيَسَارِي وَ حَاسِبْنِي حِساباً يَسِيراً»)» ثُمَّ غَسَلَ يَدَهُ الْيُسْرَى فَقَالَ - « اللَّهُمَّ لا تُعْطِنِي كِتَابِي بِيَسَارِي وَ لا
تَجْعَلْهَا مَغْلُولَةً إِلَى عُنْقِي وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّي مِنْ مُقَطَّعَاتِ النَّيرَانِ » ثُمَّ مَسَحَ رَأْسَهُ فَقَالَ - « آَللّهُمَّ غَشَنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ
وَ بَرَكَاتِكَ وَ عَفْوِكَ » ثُمَّ مَسَحَ رِجْلَيْهِ فَقَالَ - « اللَّهُمَّ ثَبَّثْنِي عَلَى الصِّرَاطِ يَوْمَ تَزِلُ فِيهِ الْأَقْدَامُ وَ اِجْعَلْ سَعْبِي
فِيمَا يُرْضِيكَ عَنِّي يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَ الْإِكْرَامِ» ثُمَّ رَفَّعَ رَأْسَهُ فَنَظَرَ إِلَى مُحَمَّدٍ فَقَالَ «يَا مُحَمَّدُ مَنْ تَوَضّاً مِثْلَ وُضُوئِي
وَقَالَ مِثْلَ قَوْلِي خَلَقَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وتَعَالَى مِنْ كُلَّ قَطْرَةٍ مَلَكاً يُقَدِّسُهُ وَ يُسَبِّحُهُ وَ يُكَبَّرُهُ فَيَكْتُبُ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ
ثَوَابَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"One day, The Commander of the Faithful {a.s} was sitting with Muhammad ibn al-
Hanafiyyah when He said to him: 'O’ Muhammad, bring me a container of water so I
can perform wudu for prayer.'
Muhammad brought him water.
Imam {a.s} poured it with his right hand onto his left hand, then said:
'In the name of Allah {SWT} and by Allah {SWT}, and all praise is due to Allah {SWT} who made
water purifying and did not make it impure.'
He then performed istinja and said:
'O’ Allah {SWT}, protect my private part and keep it chaste; cover my private areas and
forbid me from the Fire.'.
Then He rinsed his mouth and said:
'O’ Allah {SWT}, grant me the ability to present my arguments on the Day I meet You, and
loosen my tongue to remember You and to thank You.'.
He then sniffed water and said:
'O’ Allah {SWT}, do not make me forbidden from the fragrance of Paradise, and make me
among those who can smell its scent and enjoy its sweetness.'.
He washed his face and said:
'O’ Allah {SWT}, make my face white on the Day when faces are darkened, and do not
make my face dark on the Day when faces are made luminous.'.
He then washed his right hand and said:
'O’ Allah {SWT}, grant me my book in my right hand and grant me eternity in Paradise with
my left hand, and hold me accountable with an easy account.'
He then washed his left hand and said:
'O’ Allah {SWT}, do not grant me my book in my left hand, and do not make it tied around
my neck. I seek refuge in You, O’ my Lord {AZJ}, from the torments of the Fire.'
He then wiped his head and said:
'O’ Allah {SWT}, envelop me in Your mercy, blessings, and forgiveness.'
He then wiped his feet and said:
'O’ Allah {SWT}, keep me steadfast on the Straight Path on the Day when the feet may
slip, and make my efforts pleasing to You, O’ Lord {AZJ} of Glory and Honor.'
He then raised his head and looked at Muhammad and said:
'O’ Muhammad, whoever performs wudu like my wudu and recites like my recitations,
Allah {SWT}, Blessed and Exalted, will create an angel from every drop [of water] that
purifies him, and that angel will glorify and praise Allah {SWT}, and Allah {SWT}, Mighty and
Majestic, will record the reward for him until the Day of Resurrection.'".
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al-A’mal, Part 1, p. 16 • Al- Amali (by Al-Saduq) Vol. 1, p. 554 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 53 • Al-Waezin School, Vol. 2, p. 305 • Falah Al-Sael, Part 1, p. 52 • Meftah al-Falah, Part 1, p. 28 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 401 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 77, p. 318

Chapter Title: THE DESCRIPTION OF THE ABLUTION OF THE AMEER UL MOMINEEN
arabic_text:
وَ كَانَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ إِذَا تَوَضَّاْ لَمْ يَدَغْ أَحَداً يَصُبُ عَلَيْهِ الْمَاءَ فَقِيلَ لَهُ يَا أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ لِمَ لا
تَدَعُهُمْ يَصُبُّونَ عَلَيْكَ الْمَاءَ فَقَالَ «لا أُحِبُ أَنْ أُشرِكَ فِي صَلاَتِي أَحَداً وَقَالَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى:
« فَمَنْ كَانَ يَرْجُوا لِقَاءَ رَبِّهِ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلاً صَالِحا وَ لا يُشِرِك بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِ أَحَداً )
english_text:
It was noted that The Commander of the Faithful {a.s} would not allow anyone to
pour water on him while performing wudu.
When he was asked: "O’ Commander of the Faithful, why do you not let them pour
water on you?"
Imam {a.s} said: "I do not like to share my prayer with anyone”.
He also recited the verse of Allah {SWT}, Blessed and Exalted:
"And whoever expects to meet his Lord {AZJ}, let him do righteous work and not associate
anyone in the worship of his Lord {AZJ}." (Surah Al Kahf 18:110).
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 330 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 477

Chapter Title: THE DESCRIPTION OF THE ABLUTION OF THE AMEER UL MOMINEEN
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «مَسَحَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَلَى النَّعْلَيْنِ وَ لَمْ يَسْتَبْطِنِ الشِّرَاكَيْنِ.
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"The Commander of the Faithful {a.s} wiped over his sandals and did not remove the
straps”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 415

Chapter Title: THE DESCRIPTION OF THE ABLUTION OF THE AMEER UL MOMINEEN
arabic_text:
وَ كَانَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِذَا تَوَضاَ قَالَ - « بِسْمِ اللهِ وَ بِاللهِ وَ خَيْرُ الْأَسْمَاءِ لِلْهِ وَ أَكْبَرُ ٱلْأَسْمَاءِ لِلْهِ
وَ قَاهِرٌ لِمَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَ قَاهِرٌ لِمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي جَعَلَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ حَيَّ وَ أَحْيَا قَلْبِي بِالْإِيمَانِ
اللَّهُمَّ ثُبْ عَلَيّ وَ طَهَرْنِي " وَ اِقْضِ لِي بِالْحُسْنَى وَ أَرِنِي كُلَّ آلَّذِي أُحِبُّ وَ اِفْتَحْ لِي بِالْخَيْرَاتِ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ يَا سَمِيعَ
اَلدُّعَاءِ.
english_text:
It is narrated that Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, when performing wudu, would
say:
"In the name of Allah {SWT} and by Allah {SWT}, and the best names for Allah {SWT} and the
greatest names for Allah {SWT}, who is the Dominant over those in the heavens and the
Dominant over those on the earth. All praise is due to Allah {SWT}, who has made from
water every living thing and has revived my heart with faith. O’ Allah {SWT}, accept my
repentance and purify me. Grant me goodness and show me all I love, and open for
me the avenues of good from You, O’ Hearer of Supplication."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 328 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 424

Chapter Title: THE LIMITS OF ABLUTION, ITS ORDER AND REWARD
arabic_text:
باب - حد الوضوء وترتيبه وثوابه
قَالَ زُرَارَةُ بْنُ أغيَنَ لأَبِي جَعْفَرِ الْبَاقِرِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ: أَحْبِرْنِي عَنْ حَدَّ ٱلْوَجْهِ الَّذِي يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُوَضَّا الَّذِي قَالَ
اللهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فَقَالَ «آلْوَجَهُ الَّذِي قَالَ اللَّهُ وَ أَمَرَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بِغَسْلِهِ الَّذِي لا يَنْبَغِي لِأَحَدِ أَنْ يَزِيدَ عَلَيْهِ وَ لا
يَنْقَصَ مِنْهُ إِنْ زَادَ عَلَيْهِ لَمْ يُوجَرْ وَ إِنْ نَقَصَ مِنْهُ أَثِمَ مَا دَارَتْ عَلَيْهِ الْوُسْطَى وَ ٱلْإِنْهَامُ مِنْ قُصَاصٍ شَعْرِ ٱلرّأْسِ
إِلَى الذَّقَنِ وَ مَا جَرَثْ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْإِصْبَعَانِ مُسْتَدِيراً فَهُوَ مِنَ ٱلْوَجْهِ وَ مَا سِوَى ذَلِكَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَ ٱلْوَجْهِ» فَقَالَ لَهُ الصُدْغُ
مِنَ الْوَجْهِ فَقَالَ «لا» قَالَ زُرَارَةُ قُلْتُ لَهُ أَرَأَيْتَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ الشَعْرُ فَقَالَ «كُلُّ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ مِنَ الشَعْرِ فَلَيْسَ عَلَى
اَلْعِبَادِ أَنْ يَطْلُبُوهُ وَلَا يَنْحَثُوا عَنْهُ وَ لَكِنْ يُجْرَى عَلَيْهِ الْمَاءُ.
وحد غسل اليدين من المرفق إلى أطراف الأصابع، وحد مسح الرأس أن تمسح بثلاث أصابع مضمومة من مقدم الرأس،
وحد مسح الرجلين أن تضع كفيك على أطراف أصابع رجليك وتمدهما إلى الكعبين فتبدأ بالرجل اليمنى في المسح قبل
اليسرى ويكون ذلك بما بقي في اليدين من النداوة من غير أن تجدد له ماء، ولا ترد الشعر في غسل اليدين ولا في مسح
الرأس والقدمين
english_text:
Zurarah bin A'yan said to Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}:
"Inform me about the limits of the face that one should wash, as mentioned by Allah
{SWT}, Mighty and Majestic."
Imam {a.s} said: "The face that Allah {SWT} has commanded to be washed is that which no
one should add to or subtract from. If someone adds to it, they will not be rewarded,
and if they subtract from it, they will sin. The area includes from the hairline of the head
to the chin, and what is encompassed by the thumbs (when making a circle with the
fingers) is considered part of the face. Anything outside of that is not considered part
of the face”.
Zurarah asked: "What about the temples?"
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
Zurarah then said: "What if it is surrounded by hair?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Whatever is surrounded by hair is not required for the servants to seek
or look for; however, water should flow over it."
commentary:
Regarding the washing of the hands, it extends from the elbows to the tips of the
fingers. The limit for wiping the head is to wipe with three joined fingers from the front
of the head. The limit for wiping the feet is to place your hands at the tips of your toes
and extend them to the ankles, starting with the right foot before the left, and this
should be done with what remains of moisture on the hands without renewing the
water. There should be no hair returned during the washing of the hands or the wiping
of the head and feet.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE LIMITS OF ABLUTION, ITS ORDER AND REWARD
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ أُبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «تَابِعْ بَيْنَ الْوُضُوءِ كَمَا قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ اِبْدَأْ بِالْوَجْهِ ثُمَّ بِالْيَدَيْنِ ثُمَّّ اِمْسَخ
بِالرَّأْسِ وَ الرِّجْلَيْنِ وَ لا تُقَدَّمَنَّ شَيْئاً بَيْنَ يَدَيْ شَيْءٍ ثُخَالِفْ مَا أُمِرْتَ بِهِ فَإِنْ غَسَلْتَ الذَّرَاعَ قَبْلَ الْوَجِهِ فَابْدَأ
بِالْوَجْهِ وَ أَعِدْ عَلَى الذِّرَاعِ وَ إِنْ مَسَحْتَ الرِّجْلَ قَبْلَ الرَّأْسِ فَامْسَحْ عَلَى الرَّأْسِ ثُمَّ أَعِدْ عَلَى الرِّجْلِ اِبْدَأْ بِمَا بَدَأ
اَللَهُ بِهِ.
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"Follow the sequence of wudu as Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic, has commanded.
Start with the face, then the hands, then wipe the head and the feet. Do not precede
anything before what you are commanded.
If you wash the arm before the face, start with the face and then repeat on the arm. If
you wipe the foot before the head, then wipe the head and then repeat on the foot.
Begin with what Allah {SWT} has started with."
Similarly, in the adhan to Salat and the iqamah, start with the first (shahada) and then
the second (shahada) and so forth.
If you say: ‘Hasten to prayer (Hayya allas’Salat)’ before the testimonies, then you will
again start with the testimonies and then repeat ‘Hasten to prayer.’"
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 34 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 97 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 73 • Fiqh al-Qur'ān, Part 1, p. 28 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 2, p. 197 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 343 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 448 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 77, p. 362 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 1, p.

Chapter Title: THE LIMITS OF ABLUTION, ITS ORDER AND REWARD
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيَ فِي حَدِيثٍ آخَرَ: « فِيمَنْ بَدَأَ بِغَسْلِ يَسَارِهِ قَبْلَ يَمِينِهِ أَنَّهُ يُعِيدُ عَلَى يَمِينِهِ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُ عَلَى يَسَارِهِ » وَ
قَدْ رُوِيّ «أنَّهُ يُعِيدُ عَلَى يَسَارِهِ.
english_text:
It has been narrated in another report: "In the case of someone who starts
washing their left arm before their right, they should wash their right arm again and
then wash their left arm again”.
It has also been reported, "that they should wash their left arm again”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 344 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 453

Chapter Title: THE LIMITS OF ABLUTION, ITS ORDER AND REWARD
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «اِغْسِلْ يَدَكَ مِنَ ٱلْبَوْلِ مَرَّةً وَ مِنَ ٱلْغَائِطِ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَ مِنَ ٱلْجَنَابَةِ ثَلاَثاً .
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Wash your hand after urine once,
after defecation twice, and after janabah (ritual impurity) three times."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 332 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 428

Chapter Title: THE LIMITS OF ABLUTION, ITS ORDER AND REWARD
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «اغْسِلْ يَدَكَ مِنَ النَّوْمِ مَرَّةً.
ومن كان وضؤوه من النوم ونسي [أن يغسل يده] فأدخل يده الماء قبل أن يغسلها فعليه أن يصب ذلك الماء ولا يستعمل
فإن أدخلها في الماء من حدث البول والغائط قبل أن يغسلها ناسيا فلا بأس به. إلا أن يكون في يده قذر ينجس الماء.
والوضوء مرة مرة، ومن توضأ مرتين لم يؤجر ومن توضأ ثلاثا فقد أبدع، ومن مسح باطن قدميه فقد تبع وسواس
الشيطان.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"When you wake up from your sleep, wash your hands once”.
commentary:
He added that if someone performed wudu after sleeping and forgot to wash their
hand before putting it in the water, they must pour that water out and not use it for
ablution.
However, if they put their hand in the water after using the bathroom (urine or
defecation) before washing it while forgetting, it is permissible. This is unless there is
something impure on their hand that would make the water impure.
Furthermore, wudu should be performed once for each action, and whoever performs
it twice will not be rewarded. If someone performs wudu three times, they have
innovated, and whoever wipes the soles of their feet is following the whispers of Satan.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 332 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 428

Chapter Title: THE LIMITS OF ABLUTION, ITS ORDER AND REWARD
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «لَوْ لا أَنَّي رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يَمْسَحُ ظَاهِرَ قَدَمَيْهِ
لَظَنَثْتُ أَنّ بَاطِنَهُمَا أَوْلَى بِالْمَسْحِ مِنْ ظَاهِرِهِمَا.
ومن كان به في المواضع التي يجب عليها الوضوء قرحة أو جراحة أو دماميل ولم يؤذه حلها، فليحلها وليغسلها، وإن أضر
به حلها، فليمسح يده على الجبائر والقروح ولا يحلها ولا يعبث بجراحته.
english_text:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"If I had not seen the Messenger of Allah {saws} wiping over the tops of his feet, I would
have thought that the soles of the feet should be wiped instead of the tops”.
commentary:
If someone has sores, wounds, or boils in the places where wudu is required, and
removing them does not harm them, they should remove them and wash the affected
areas.
If removing them would cause harm, they should wipe over the bandages and sores
without removing them or tampering with their wounds.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 292 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 416

Chapter Title: THE LIMITS OF ABLUTION, ITS ORDER AND REWARD
arabic_text:
وَ قَدْ رُوِيَ: فِي الْجَبَائِرِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ «يَغْسِلُ مَا حَوْلَهَا.
ولا يجوز المسح على العمامة ولا على القلنسوة ولا على الخفين والجوربين إلا في حال التقية والخيفة من العدو أو في
ثلج يخاف فيه على الرجلين، تقام الخفان مقام الجبائر فيمسح عليهما.
english_text:
It has been narrated about bandages from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq
{a.s}:
Imam {a.s} said: "Wash that which is around them."
commentary:
It is not permissible to wipe over a turban (Amamah), a cap (qalansuwah), or leather
socks (khuffs) and stockings (jawrab) except in cases of necessity, such as during fear
of an enemy or in snow where there is a risk to the feet.
The leather socks can be treated like bandages, and one can wipe over them.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 464

Chapter Title: THE LIMITS OF ABLUTION, ITS ORDER AND REWARD
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ ٱلْعَالِمُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلامُ: «ثَلاَثَةٌ لا أَتَّقِي فِيهَا أَحَداً شُرْبُ ٱلْمُسْكِرِ وَ ٱلْمَسْحُ عَلَى ٱلْخُفَّيْنِ وَ مُثْعَةُ ٱلْحَجِّ.
english_text:
The scholar, Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}, said:
"There are three things in which I do not fear anyone (taqiyya): drinking intoxicants,
wiping over the leather socks (khuffs), and the Hajj Tamattu'"
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 77, p. 292

Chapter Title: THE LIMITS OF ABLUTION, ITS ORDER AND REWARD
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَثْ عَائِشَةُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلِّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «أَشَدُّ النَّاسِ حَسْرَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَنْ رَأَى وُضُوءَهُ
عَلَى جِلْدٍ غَيْرِهِ.
english_text:
Aisha narrated from the Prophet {saws}, that He said:
"The people with the most regret on the Day of Resurrection will be those who sees his
wudu (ablution) on the skin of someone else”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 306 • Tafsir al-Safi, Part 2, p. 15 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 461 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 10, p. 399 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 31, p. 37 • Tafsir Kanz al-Daqa’iq, Part 4, p. 50

Chapter Title: THE LIMITS OF ABLUTION, ITS ORDER AND REWARD
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنْهَا أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ: «لَأَنْ أَمْسَحَ عَلَى ظَهِرٍ عَيْرٍ بِالْفَلاةِ أَحَبُ إِلَيّ مِنْ أَنْ أَمْسَحَ عَلَى خَفِّي.
ولم يعرف للنبي صلى اللّٰه عليه وآله خف إلا خفا أهداه له النجاشي، وكان موضع ظهر القدمين منه مشقوقا، فمسح النبي
صلى اللّٰه عليه وآله على رجليه وعليه خفاه، فقال الناس: إنه مسح على خفيه على أن الحديث في ذلك غير صحيح
الاسناد،
english_text:
It was narrated from Aisha that The Prophet {saws} narrated:
"I would prefer to wipe over the back of a donkey in the wilderness than to wipe over
my leather socks (khuffs)."
commentary:
It is noted that the Prophet Muhammad {saws} did not possess any leather socks except
for a pair that was gifted to him by the Negus (the king of Abyssinia). These socks had
a split in the area covering the tops of the feet.
The Prophet wiped over his feet while wearing these socks.
When people saw this, they said he had wiped over his leather socks (but he had not).
However, the authenticity of this narration is not confirmed.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 31, p. 38

Chapter Title: THE LIMITS OF ABLUTION, ITS ORDER AND REWARD
arabic_text:
وَ سُيْلَ مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ خُفُّهُ مُخَرَّقاً فَيُدْخِلُ يَدَهُ وَ يَمْسَحُ ظَهِرَ قَدَمَيْهِ أ
يُجْزِيهِ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ.
english_text:
Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} was asked about a man whose leather socks
(khuffs) are torn, and he puts his hand in and wipes over the tops of his feet. Is this
sufficient?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE LIMITS OF ABLUTION, ITS ORDER AND REWARD
arabic_text:
وَسُئِلَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: عَنْ رَجُلٍ قُطِعَتْ يَدُهُ مِنَ الْمِرْفَقِ كَيْفَ يَتَوَضَّأُ قَالَ «يَغْسِلُ
مَا بَقِيَ مِنْ عَضُدِهِ. وَ كَذَلِكَ رُوِيَ: فِي قَطْعِ الرِّجْلِ «وَ إِذَا تَوَضَّأْتٍ، الْمَرْأَةُ أَلْقَتْ قِنَاعَهَا عَنْ مَوْضِعِ مَسْحِ رَأْسِهَا
فِي صَلَاَةِ الْغَدَاةِ وَ ٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَتَمْسَحُ عَلَيْهِ وَ يُجْزِيهَا فِي سَائِرِ الصَّلَوَاتِ أَنْ تُدْجِلَ إِصْبَعَهَا فَتَمْسَحَ عَلَى رَأْسِهَا مِنْ
غَيْرِ أَنْ تُلْقِيَ عَنْهَا قِنَاعَهَا.
english_text:
Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s}, was asked about a man
whose hand was cut off at the elbow. How should he perform wudu?
Imam {a.s} said: "He should wash what remains of his forearm."
And similarly, it was narrated regarding the amputation of the leg.
When a woman performs wudu, She should remove her head covering (niqab) from
the area where She wipes her head during the Fajr and Maghrib prayers, and She can
wipe over it. In all other prayers, She may insert her finger to wipe over her head without
having to remove her head covering.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Masa’il Ali ibn Ja’far, Part 1, p. 208 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 29 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 360 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 363 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 479

Chapter Title: THE LIMITS OF ABLUTION, ITS ORDER AND REWARD
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «قَرَضَ اللهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ فِي ٱلْوُضُوءِ أَنْ تَبْدَأَ الْمَرْأَةُ بِبَاطِنِ ذِرَاعِهَا وَ
الرّجُلُ بِظَاهِرِ الذِّرَاعِ.
english_text:
Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha {a.s} said: "Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic, has
prescribed for people in wudu that a woman should begin with the inner part of her
arm, while a man should begin with the outer part of his arm”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 467

Chapter Title: THE LIMITS OF ABLUTION, ITS ORDER AND REWARD
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «مَنْ ذَكَرَ اِسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَى وُضُوئِهِ فَكَأَنْمَا اِغْتَسَلَ.
english_text:
Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: 'Whoever mentions the name of Allah {SWT} while
performing wudu (ablution) is as if they have taken a full bath (ghusl).'".
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Thawāb al-Aʿmāl wa ʿIqāb al-Aʿmāl, Part 1, p. 15 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 358 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 67 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 327 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 423 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 425 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 77, p. 315

Chapter Title: THE LIMITS OF ABLUTION, ITS ORDER AND REWARD
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنّ مَنْ تَوَضَّا فَذَكَرَ اِسْمَ اللَّهِ طَهْرَ جَمِيعُ جَسَدِهِ وَ كَانَ ٱلْوُضُوءُ إِلَى ٱلْوُضُوءِ كَفَّارَةً لِمَا بَيْنَهُمَا مِنَ
الذُّنُوبِ وَ مَنْ لَمْ يُسَمِّ لَمْ يَطْهُرْ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ إِلَّ مَا أَصَابَهُ الْمَاءُ.
english_text:
It is narrated: 'Whoever performs ablution and mentions the name of Allah {SWT},
all of his body becomes pure, and the ablution performed between two ablutions
serves as atonement for the sins committed between them.
And whoever does not mention [the name of Allah {SWT}] will not purify his body except
for what the water touches.'"
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Thawāb al-Aʿmāl wa ʿIqāb al-Aʿmāl, Part 1, p. 15 • Ilal al- Sharai’ Vol. 1, p. 289 • Rawdat al-Wa’izin, Vol. 2, p. 306 • Jami’ al-Akhbar, Part 1, p. 63 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 328 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 425 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 77, p. 314

Chapter Title: THE LIMITS OF ABLUTION, ITS ORDER AND REWARD
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ تَوَضَاً لِلْمَغْرِبِ كَانَ وُضُووُهُ ذَلِكَ كَفَّارَةً لِمَا مَضَى مِنْ
ذُنُوبِهِ فِي نَهَارِهِ مَا خَلاَ ٱلْكَبَائِرَ وَ مَنْ تَوَضَّاَ لِصَلاَةِ الصُّبْحِ كَانَ وُضُووُهُ ذَلِكَ كَفَارَةً لِمَا مَضَى مِنْ ذُنُوبِهِ فِي لَيْلَتِهِ
إلاً الكَبَائِرَ.
english_text:
Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} said:
'Whoever performs ablution for the Maghrib prayer, his ablution serves as atonement
for the sins he committed during the day, except for the major sins.
And whoever performs ablution for the Fajr prayer, his ablution serves as atonement
for the sins he committed during the night, except for the major sins.'"
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 70 • Thawāb al-Aʿmāl wa ʿIqāb al- Aʿmāl, Part 1, p. 17 • Rawdat al-Wa’izin, Vol. 2, p. 306 • Jami’ al-Akhbar, Part 1, p. 64 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 366 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 376 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 77, p. 231

Chapter Title: THE LIMITS OF ABLUTION, ITS ORDER AND REWARD
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «اِفْتَحُوا عُيُونَكُمْ عِنْدَ الْوُضُوءِ لَعَلَّهَا لاَ تَرَى نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ.
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"'Open your eyes during ablution, so that they may not see the fire of Hell.'".
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Thawāb al-Aʿmāl wa ʿIqāb al-Aʿmāl, Part 1, p. 17 • Ilal al- Sharai’ Vol. 1, p. 280 • Jami’ al-Akhbar, Part 1, p. 64 • Miftāḥ al-Falāḥ, Part 1, p. 24 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 334 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 486 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 77, p. 336 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 77, p. 346 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 3, p. 270

Chapter Title: THE LIMITS OF ABLUTION, ITS ORDER AND REWARD
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «مَنْ تَوَضَّاَ وَ تَمَنْدَلَ كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ حَسَنَةً وَ مَنْ تَوَضَّاَ وَ لَمْ يَتَمَنْدَلْ حَتَّى يَجِفَ
وَضُووُهُ كَتَبَ اللَهُ لَهُ ثَلاَثُونَ حَسَنَةً
وبأس بأن يصلي الرجل بوضوء واحد صلوات الليل والنهار كلها ما لم يحدث وكذلك بتيمم واحد ما لم يحدث أو يصب
ماء.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
'Whoever performs ablution and wipes himself (with a towel) will have a good deed
written for him. And whoever performs ablution and does not wipe himself until his
ablution dries, Allah {SWT} will write for him thirty good deeds.'.
commentary:
And it is permissible for a man to pray with one ablution for all the prayers of the night
and day as long as he does not break his ablution, and the same applies to a single
tayammum (dry ablution) as long as he does not break it or find water.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Rawdat al-Wa’izin, Vol. 2, p. 306

Chapter Title: THE LIMITS OF ABLUTION, ITS ORDER AND REWARD
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «إِذَا تَوَضَّاَ الرَّجُلُ فَلْيَصْفِقُ وَجْهَهُ بِالْمَاءِ فَإِنَّهُ إِنْ كَانَ نَاعِساً فَزِعَ وَ اِسْتَيْقَظَ
وَ إِنْ كَانَ الْبَرْدُ فَزِعَ فَلَمْ يَجِدِ ٱلْبَرْدَ.
فإذا كان مع الرجل خاتم فليدوره في الوضوء، ويحوله عند الغسل
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"'When a man performs ablution, let him splash his face with water, for if he is drowsy,
it will awaken him, and if it is cold, he will not feel the cold.'".
commentary:
If a man has a ring, he should rotate it during ablution and remove it during a wash
(ghusl).
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 1, p. 281 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 357 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 68 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 333 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 434 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 77, p. 337

Chapter Title: THE LIMITS OF ABLUTION, ITS ORDER AND REWARD
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «وَ إِنْ نَسِيتَ حَتَّى تَقُومَ مِنَ الصَلاَةِ فَلاَ آمُرُكَ أَنْ تُعِيدَ».
وإذا استيقظ الرجل من نومه ولم يبل فلا يدخل يده في الاناء حتى يغسلها فإنه لا يدري أين باتت يده. وزكاة الوضوء أن
بقول المتوضي: " اللهم إني أسألك تمام الوضوء وتمام الصلاة وتمام رضوانك والجنة " فهذا زكاة الوضوء.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"And if you forget (to rotate your ring in ablution) until you stand in Salat, then I do not
command you to repeat it (Salat)."
commentary:
And if a man wakes up from his sleep and has not relieved himself, he should not put
his hand in the vessel until he washes it, for he does not know where his hand has been
during the night.
The supplication of ablution is for the person performing it to say: supplication of
ablution is for the one performing it to say:
'O’ Allah {SWT}, I ask You for the completion of my ablution, the completion of my prayer,
Your pleasure, and Paradise.'
This is the supplication of ablution.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 281

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER OF SIWAK
arabic_text:
باب - السواك
قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «مَا زَالَ جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ يُوصِينِي بِالسِّوَاكِ حَتَّى خَشِيتُ أَنْ
أُحْفِي أَوْ أَدْرَدَ وَ مَا زَالَ يُوصِينِي بِالْجَارِ حَتَّى ظَنَنْتُ أَنْهُ سَيُوَرَّثُهُ وَ مَا زَالَ يُوصِينِي بِالْمَمْلُوكِ حَتَّى ظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ
سَيَضْرِبُ لَهُ أَجَلاً يُعْتَقُ فِيهِ. وَ فِي خَبَرٍ آخَرَ: «وَ مَا زَالَ يُوصِينِي بِالْمَرْأَةِ حَتَّى ظَنَئْتُ أَنَّهُ لا يَنْبَغِي طَلَاَقُهَا.
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said: "Archangel Jibril {a.s} kept advising me about
the miswak until I feared I might wear down my teeth or make them fall out.
And Archangel Jibril {a.s} continued to advise me about the neighbor until I thought he
would make him an heir.
And Archangel Jibril {a.s} continued to advise me about servants until I thought he would
set a term for them to be freed."
In another report, "And Archangel Jibril {a.s} continued to advise me about women until
I thought that divorce would not be appropriate for them."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 48 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 2, p. 7 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 5, p. 515

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER OF SIWAK
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «نَزَلَ جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ بِالسِّوَاكِ وَ الْحِجَامَةِ وَ الْخِلاَلِ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: 'Archangel Jibril {a.s} brought down
the practices of using the miswak, cupping (hijama), and flossing (khilal).'.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al Mahasin, Part 2, p. 558 • Al-Ādāb al-Dīniyyah, Part 1, p. 71 • Al-Ādāb al-Dīniyyah, Part 1, p. 89 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 51 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 677 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol. 59, p. 117 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 63, p. 439 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 130 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 138

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER OF SIWAK
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «أَكْلُ ٱلْأَشنَانِ يُذِيبُ اَلْبَدَنَ وَ التَّدَلُكُ بِالْخَزَفِ يُنْلِي الْجَسَدَ وَ السِّوَاكُ
فِي اَلْخَلاءِ يُورِثُ الْبَخَرَ.
english_text:
Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} said:
"Consuming ushnan (a type of cleansing herb) melts the body, scrubbing with pottery
wears out the body, and using a siwak in the bathroom causes bad breath”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 32 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 48 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 51 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 122 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 337 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 135 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 138

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER OF SIWAK
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «أَزْبَعْ مِنْ سُنَنِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ التَّعَطُّرُ وَ السِّوَاكُ وَ النَّسَاءُ وَ الْحِنَّاءُ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Four practices are from the traditions of the messengers: applying fragrance, using
siwak (toothstick), having relations with women, and using henna."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 677 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 10 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 135

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER OF SIWAK
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «إِنَّ أَفْوَاهَكُمْ طُرُقُ ٱلْقُرْآنِ فَطَهُرُوهَا بِالسِّوَاكِ.
english_text:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"Your mouths are the pathways of the Quran, so purify them with siwak (toothstick)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Majmu’at Warram, Part 1, p. 7 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 676 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 2, p. 23

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER OF SIWAK
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فِي وَصِيَّتِهِ لِعَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «يَا عَلِيْ عَلَيْكَ بِالسِّوَاكِ عِنْدَ وُضُوءِ كُلِّ
صَلاَةٍ.
english_text:
The Prophet {saws}, said in his will to Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s}:
"O’ Ali {a.s}, make sure to use siwak (toothstick) before wudu (ablution) for every prayer."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 2, p. 17

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER OF SIWAK
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «السِّوَاكُ شَطْرُ الْوُضُوءِ.
english_text:
Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said: "Siwak (tooth cleaning) is half of wudu
(ablution)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 49 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 676 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 2, p. 17 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 136 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 77, p. 343 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol. 77, p. 346 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Part 1, p. 364

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER OF SIWAK
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «لَمَّا دَخَلَ النَّاسُ فِي الدِّينِ أَفْوَاجاً أَتَثَهُمُ ٱلْأَزْدُ أَرَفّهَا قُلُوبا وَ أَعْذَبَهَا أَفْوَاهاً
فَقِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، هَذَا أَرَقُهَا قُلُوباً عَرَفْنَاهُ فَلِمَ صَارَتْ أَعْذَبَهَا أَفْوَاهاً فَقَالَ «إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَسْتَاكُ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said :
"When people entered the religion in large numbers, the tribe of Azd came among
them with the softest hearts and the sweetest mouths.
It was asked: 'O’ Messenger of Allah {saws}, we understand why they have the softest
hearts, but why do they have the sweetest mouths?'
He {saws} said: 'They used to use siwak (toothstick) even in the pre-Islamic period.'"
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 676 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 10 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 22, p. 312 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 136

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER OF SIWAK
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «لِكُلِّ شَيْءِ طَهُورٌ وَ طَهُورُ الْفَمِ السِّوَاكُ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Everything has a means of purification, and the means of purification for the mouth is
the siwak (tooth cleaning)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 49 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 677 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 10 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 22, p. 312 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 136

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER OF SIWAK
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ: «إنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَانَ يُكْثِرُ السِّوَاكَ وَ لَيْسَ بِوَاجِبِ فَلا
يَضُرُّكَ تَرْكُهُ فِي فَرْطِ الْأَيَّامِ.
ولا بأس أن يستاك الصائم في شهر رمضان أي النهار شاء. ولا بأس بالسواك للمحرم، ويكره السواك في الحمام لأنه يورث
اوباء الأسنان، والسواك من الحنيفية وهي عشر سنن: خمس في الرأس وخمس في الجسد، فأما التي في الرأس فالمضمضة،
والاستنشاق، و السواك، وقص الشارب والفرق لمن طول شعر رأسه، ومن لم يفرق شعر رأسه فرقه اللّٰه يوم القيامة بمنشار
من نار. وأما التى فى الجسد: فالاستنجاء، والختان، وحلق العانة، وقص الأظفار ونتف الإيطين.
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"Indeed, the Messenger of Allah {saws} frequently used siwak (tooth cleaning), but it is
not obligatory, so it will not harm you if you leave it for a few days”.
commentary:
is permissible for a fasting person to use siwak at any time of the day in Month of
Ramadan, and for someone in a state of ihram (pilgrim's state) to use siwak. However,
using siwak in the bathhouse is discouraged, as it is believed to harm the teeth.
The siwak is part of the Hanifye Ibraheem sunnah, which consists of ten Sunnahs: five
for the head and five for the body.
As for those related to the head, they are; rinsing the mouth, cleaning the nose, using
siwak, trimming the mustache, and parting the hair. Those who do not part their hair
will have it parted by a saw of fire on the Day of Judgment.
As for those related to the body, they are; Cleansing after relieving oneself (istinja),
circumcision, shaving the pubic hair, clipping the nails, and plucking the armpit hair.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al Mahasin, Part 2, p. 563 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 677 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 2, p. 11 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 134

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER OF SIWAK
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ الْبَاقِرُ وَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ: «صَلاَةُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ بِسِوَاكِ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ رَكْعَةً بِغَيْرِ سِوَاكٍ.
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} and Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq
{a.s} said: "Two units of prayer performed with siwak (tooth cleaning) are better than
seventy units of prayer without siwak."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Ādāb al-Dīniyyah, Part 1, p. 72 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 50 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 137

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER OF SIWAK
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرِ ٱلْبَاقِرُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ: فِي السِّوَاكِ «لا تَدَعْهُ فِي كُلَ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامِ وَ لَوْ أَنْ ثُمِرَّهُ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً.
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said about the siwak:
"Do not neglect it for more than three days, even if you use it just once."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 50 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 137

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER OF SIWAK
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «اِكْتَجِلُوا وَثْراً وَ اِسْتَاكُوا عَرْضاً.
english_text:
The Prophet {saws} said: "Apply kohl in an odd number of strokes and use siwak
(tooth cleaning) across the width of the mouth”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Ādāb al-Dīniyyah, Part 1, p. 80 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 678 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 2, p. 23 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 101

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER OF SIWAK
arabic_text: - وَتَرَكَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ السِّوَاكَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْبَضَ بِسَنَتَيْنِ وَ ذَلِكَ أَنَ أَسْنَانَهُ ضَعُفَتْ.
english_text:
It is reported that Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} stopped using siwak
two years before he passed away, as his teeth had weakened.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 678 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 2, p. 25 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 127

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER OF SIWAK
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ أَخَاهُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَسْتَاكُ مَرَّةً بِيَدِهِ إِذَا قَامَ إِلَى صَلاةٍ
اللَّيْلِ وَ هُوَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى السِّوَاكِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا خَافَ الصُّبْحَ فَلا بَأْسَ بِهِ.
english_text:
Ali ibn Ja'far asked his brother Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} bout a man
who uses his hand to clean his teeth when he gets up for the night prayer (Salat Al Layl),
even though he has access to siwak.
Imam {a.s} said: "If he fears that dawn is approaching, there is no harm in doing so."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Masa’il Ali ibn Ja’far, Part 1, p. 250 • Qurb al-Isnad, Part 1, p. 207 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 50 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 127 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 77, p. 341 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 84, p. 207

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER OF SIWAK
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «لَوْ لاَ أَنْ أَشْقَ عَلَى أَمَّتِي لَأَمَرْتُهُمْ بِالسَّوَاكِ عِنْدَ وُضُوءِ كُلِّ صَلاّةٍ.
english_text:
The Prophet {saws} said: "If it were not burdensome for my community, I would
have commanded them to use siwak (tooth cleaning) with each wudu (ablution) before
every prayer."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al Mahasin, Part 2, p. 561 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 1, p. 293 • Al-Ādāb al-Dīniyyah, Part 1, p. 72 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 50 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 2, p. 21 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 2, p. 17 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 2, p. 19 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 126 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 137

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER OF SIWAK
arabic_text: - وَ رُوِيَ: «لَوْ عَلِمَ النَّاسُ مَا فِي السَّوَاكِ لَأَبَاتُوهُ مَعَهُمْ فِي لِحَافٍ.
english_text:
It is narrated: "If people knew what benefits siwak holds, they would keep it
with them in their bedding at night."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al-A’mal, Part 1, p. 18 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 677 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 10 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 2, p. 12 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 130 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 77, p. 342

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER OF SIWAK
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنّ الْكَعْبَةَ شَكَتْ إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ مَا تَلْقَى مِنْ أَنْفَاسِ الْمُشرِكِينَ فَأَوْحَى اللَّهُ تَعَالَى إلَيْهَا «قِرِّي
يَا كَعْبَةُ فَإِنِّي مُبْدِلُكِ بِهِمْ قَوْمًا يَتَنَظَّفُونَ بِقُضْبَانِ الشَّجَرِ» فَلَمَا بَعَثَ اللّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ نَبِيَّهُ مُحَمَداً صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ
آلِهِ نَزَلَ عَلَيْهِ الرُّوحُ الْأَمِينُ جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ بِالسِّوَاكِ.
english_text:
It is narrated: "The Kaaba complained to Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic, about
the distress it suffered from the breaths of the polytheists.
Allah {SWT}, Exalted be He, revealed to it: 'Calm yourself, O’ Kaaba, for I will replace them
with a people who purify themselves with branches of trees.'
When Allah {SWT} sent His Prophet Muhammad {saws}, the Trustworthy Spirit, Archangel
Jibril {a.s}, descended upon him with the siwak (toothstick)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 50 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 677 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 2, p. 23 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 137

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER OF SIWAK
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ: «فِي السِّوَاكِ اِثْنَتَا عَشَرَةَ خَصْلَةً هُوَ مِنَ ٱلسُنَّةِ وَ مَظْهَرَةٌ لِلْفَمِ وَ مَجْلاَةٌ لِلْبَصَرِ
وَ يُرْضِي الرَّحْمَنَ وَ يُبَيِّضُ الْأَسْنَانَ وَ يَذْهَبُ بِالْحَفْرِ وَ يَشُدُ اللَّثةَ وَ يُشَهَي الطَّعَامَ وَ يَذْهَبُ بِالْبَلْغَمِ وَ يَزِيدُ فِي
الْحِفْظِ وَ يُضَاعِفُ الْحَسَنَاتِ وَ تَفْرَحُ بِهِ ٱلْمَلاَئِكَةُ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Siwak (tooth cleaning) has twelve benefits: it is part of the Sunnah (tradition), purifies
the mouth, improves vision, pleases the Merciful, whitens the teeth, removes decay,
strengthens the gums, increases appetite, removes phlegm, enhances memory,
multiplies good deeds, and brings joy to the angels."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al Mahasin, Part 2, p. 562 • Thawāb al-Aʿmāl wa ʿIqāb al- Aʿmāl, Part 1, p. 17 • Al-Khasal, Part 2, p. 481 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 50 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 1, p. 320 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 129 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 77, p. 346

Chapter Title: THE REASON FOR ABLUTION
arabic_text:
باب - علة الوضوء
جَاءَ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَسَأْلُوهُ عَنْ مَسَائِلَ فَكَانَ فِيمَا سَأَلُوهُ أَخْبِرْنَا يَا
مُحَمَّدُ لِأَيَّ عِلَّةِ تُوَضَّأْ هَذِهِ الْجَوَارِحُ الْأَرْبَعُ وَ هِيَ أَنظَفُ الْمَوَاضِعِ فِي الْجَسَدِ
قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ « لَمَّا أَنْ وَسْوَسَ الشَّيْطَانُ إِلَى آدَمَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ رَنَا مِنَ الشَّجَرَةِ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهَا فَذَهَبَ
مَاءَ وَجْهِهِ ثُمَّ قَامَ وَ مَشَى إِلَيْهَا وَ هِيَ أَوْلُ قَدَمِ مَشَتَ إِلَى الْخَطِيئَةِ ثُمَّ تَنَاوَلَ بِيَدِهِ مِنْهَا مَا عَلَيْهَا فَأَكَلَ فَطَارَ
اَلْحُلِي وَ الْحُلَلُ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ فَوَضَعَ آدَمُ يَدَهُ عَلَى أَمِّ رَأْسِهِ وَ بَكَى
فَلَمَا تَابَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ عَلَيْهِ فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلَى ذُرِّيَّتِهِ تَطْهِيرَ هَذِهِ الْجَوَارِحِ الْأَرْبَعِ فَأَمَرَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ بِغَسْلِ
الْوَجْهِ لِمَا نَظَرَ إِلَى الشَّجَرَةِ وَ أَمَرَهُ بِغَسْلِ الْيَدَيْنِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ لِمَا تَنَاوَلَ بِهِمَا وَ أَمَرَهُ بِمَسْحِ الرَّأْسِ لِمَا وَضَعَ يَدَهُ
عَلَى أُمِّ رَأْسِهِ وَ أَمَرَهُ بِمَسْحِ الْقَدَمَيْنِ لِمَا مَشَى بِهِمَا إِلَى الْخَطِيئَةِ.
english_text:
A group of Jews came to the Messenger of Allah {saws} and asked Him about
various matters. Among the questions they asked was: ‘Tell us, O’ Muhammad, why
these four parts are washed in ablution when they are the cleanest parts of the body?'
The Prophet {saws} replied: "When Satan whispered to Adam {a.s}, he approached the tree
and looked at it, and thus he lost the brightness of his face. Then he walked towards it
- this was the first step taken towards wrongdoing.
He reached out with his hand to take from it, and he ate. Consequently, the ornaments
and coverings left his body, and he placed his hands on his head and wept.
When Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic, accepted his repentance, He made it obligatory
upon him and his descendants to purify these four parts.
Thus, Allah {SWT} commanded the washing of the face because he had looked at the
tree, the washing of the hands up to the elbows because he had used them to take
from it, the wiping of the head because he had placed his hand on his head, and the
wiping of the feet because he had walked with them towards the wrongdoing
(khatee'ah)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 1, p. 280 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 368 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 395 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 1, p. 596 • Tafsir Kanz al-Daqa’iq, Part 4, p. 52

Chapter Title: RULING ON THE DRYING OF SOME PARTS OF ABLUTION BEFORE COMPLETION
arabic_text:
128 وَ كَتَبَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَلِيْ بْنُ مُوسَى الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ إِلَى مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ فِيمَا كَتَبَ مِنْ جَوَابٍ مَسَائِلِهِ:
«أَنَّ عِلَّةَ الْوُضُوءِ الَّتِي مِنْ أَجْلِهَا صَارَ عَلَى ٱلْعَبْدِ غَسْلُ ٱلْوَجْهِ وَ ٱلذِّرَاعَيْنِ وَ مَسْحُ ٱلرَّأْسِ وَ ٱلْقَدَمَيْنِ فَلِقِيَامِهِ بَيْنَ
يَدَي اللهِ تَعَالَى وَ اِسْتِقْبَالِهِ إِيَّاهُ بِجَوَارِجِهِ الظَّاهِرَةِ وَ مُلاَقَاتِهِ بِهَا الْكِرَامَ الْكَاتِبِينَ فَيَغْسِلُ الْوَجْهَ لِلسُّجُودِ وَ
الْخُضُوعِ وَ يَغْسِلُ اليَدَيْنِ لِيُقَلَّبَهُمَا وَ يَرْغَبَ بِهِمَا وَ يَرْهَبَ وَ يَتَبَثَّلَ وَ يَمْسَحُ الرَّأْسَ وَ الْقَدَمَيْنِ لِأَنَهُمَا ظَاهِرَانٍ
مَكْشُوفَانٍ يَسْتَقْبِلُ بِهِمَا كُلَّ حَالاَتِهِ وَ لَيْسَ فِيهِمَا مِنَ الْخُضُوعِ وَ التَّبَثْلِ مَا فِي الْوَجْهِ وَ الذِّرَاعَيْنِ.
english_text:
Abu Al-Hasan Imam Ar-Ridha {a.s} wrote to Muhammad ibn Sinan in response
to his questions: "The reason for wudu (ablution), for which it has become obligatory
for a servant to wash the face and arms, and to wipe the head and feet, is to prepare
to stand before Allah {SWT} Almighty, to face Him with one’s visible limbs, and to
encounter the noble recording angels with them.
The face is washed for the act of prostration and submission. The hands are washed
so that one may turn them over in prayer, supplicating with them, expressing hope and
reverence, and focusing in worship. The head and feet are wiped because they are
exposed, facing all conditions, and do not possess the same level of humility and
dedication as the face and arms."
commentary:
My father wrote in his letter: "If you finish part of your wudu and the water runs out
before you complete it, then when you bring water to continue, complete your wudu if
the parts you previously washed are still wet. But if they have dried, start your wudu
over. If some parts of your wudu dry before you complete it, but water is still available
to you, simply wash the remaining parts, whether the earlier parts have dried or not."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 1, p. 280 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 369 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 395 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 77, p. 231 Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: ON THOSE WHO OMIT WUDU OR PART OF IT, OR
arabic_text:
باب - حكم جفاف بعض الوضوء قبل تمامه
قال أبي رضي اللّٰه عنه في رسالته إلي: إن فرغت من بعض وضوئك وانقطع بك الماء من قبل أن تتمه فأتيت بالماء فتمم
وضوءك إذا كان ما غسلته رطبا، وإن كان قد جف فأعد وضوءك، وإن جف بعض وضوئك قبل أن تتم الوضوء من غير أن
ينقطع عنك الماء فاغسل ما بقي، جف وضوؤك أو لم يجف.
باب - فيمن ترك الوضوء أو بعضه أو شك فيه
قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «لا صَلاَةَ إِلاَّ بِطَهُورٍ.
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said: "There is no prayer without
purification”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Da‘ā’im al-Islām, Part 1, p. 100 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 140 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 2, p. 209 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 3, p. 8 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 365 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 43 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 365 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 366 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 368

Chapter Title: ON THOSE WHO OMIT WUDU OR PART OF IT, OR
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّ رَجُلاً مِنَ ٱلْأَحْبَارِ أَقْعِدَ فِي قَبْرِهِ فَقِيلَ لَهُ إِنَّا جَالِدُوكَ مِائَةَ جَلْدَةٍ مِنْ عَذَابِ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ قَالَ
لاَ أُطِيقُهَا فَلَمْ يَزَالُوا بِهِ حَتَّى رَدُّوهُ إِلَى وَاحِدَةٍ فَقَالَ لاَ أُطِيقُهَا فَقَالُوا لا بُدَّ مِنْهَا قَالَ فَبِمَا تَجْلِدُونِيهَا قَالُوا نَجْلِدُكَ
بِأَنَّكَ صَلَّيْتَ يَوْماً بِغَيْرِ وُضُوءِ وَ مَرَزْتَ عَلَى ضَعِيفٍ فَلَمْ تَنصُرْهُ فَجَلَدُوهُ جَلْدَةَ مِنْ عَذَابِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى فَامْتَلَاً قَبْرُهُ
نَاراً.
english_text:
(Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} ) narrated:
"A certain man from among the scholars was placed in his grave, and it was said to
him:
'We will strike you with one hundred lashes from the punishment of Allah {SWT}, Mighty
and Majestic.' He replied: 'I cannot bear it.'
They continued to reduce the punishment, until it was brought down to one lash.
(Still) He said: 'I still cannot bear it.'
They replied: 'It is unavoidable.'
He asked: 'Why will you lash me?'
They said: 'We will lash you because one day you prayed without wudu (ablution), and
because you passed by a weak person and did not help him.'
So they lashed him once with a punishment from Allah {SWT}, and his grave was filled
with fire."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 43

Chapter Title: ON THOSE WHO OMIT WUDU OR PART OF IT, OR DOUBTS IN ITS COMPLETION
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «ثَمَانِيَةٌ لَا يَقْبَلُ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ صَلاَةً اَلْعَبْدُ الْآَبِقُ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ إِلَى مَوْلاَهُ وَ
اَلنَّاشِرُ عَنْ زَوْجِهَا وَ هُوَ عَلَيْهَا سَاخِطْ وَ مَانعُ الزَّكَاةِ وَ إِمَامُ قَوْمِ يُصَلِّي بِهِمْ وَ هُمْ لَهُ كَارِهُونَ وَ تَارِكُ ٱلْوُضُوءِ وَ
الْمَرْأَةُ الْمُدْرِكَةُ تُصَلِّي بِغَيْرِ جِمَارٍ وَ الزَّبِّينُ وَ هُوَ الَّذِي يُدَافِعُ الْبَوْلَ وَ الْغَائِطَ وَ اَلسِّكْرَانُ.
وتارك الوضوء ناسيا متى ذكر فعليه أن يتوضأ ويعيد الصلاة.
english_text:
The Prophet, said:
"Allah {SWT} does not accept the prayer of eight types of people:
The runaway servant until he returns to his master,
The rebellious wife whose husband is displeased with her,
The one who withholds zakat,
The Imam whom people dislike to pray behind,
The one who neglects wudu,
The mature (of age) woman who prays without a head covering,
The one who prays while suppressing the urge to urinate or defecate (Zabeen),
And the one who is intoxicated."
commentary:
If someone forgets to perform wudu and remembers later, they must perform wudu
and repeat the prayer.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 44 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 8, p. 348

Chapter Title: ON THOSE WHO OMIT WUDU OR PART OF IT, OR DOUBTS IN ITS COMPLETION
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ النَّبِيْ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «وُضِعَ عَنْ أَمَّتِي تِسْعَةُ أَشيَاءَ اَلسَّهْوُ وَ ٱلْخَطَأ وَ النَّسْيَانُ وَ مَا أَكْرِهُوا
عَلَيْهِ وَ مَا لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَ مَا لاَ يُطِيقُونَ وَ الطَّيَرَةُ وَ الْحَسَدُ وَ التَّفَكُرُ فِي الْوَسْوَسَةِ فِي الْخَلْقِ مَا لَمْ يَنْطِقِ الْإِنْسَانُ
بِشَفَّةٍ.
english_text:
The Prophet {saws} said:
"Nine things have been lifted from my community: mistakes, errors, forgetfulness,
what they are compelled to do, what they do not know, what they cannot endure,
superstitions, envy (if not acted upon), and thoughts of doubt in creation as long as a
person does not express them verbally."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 5, p. 1085 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 7, p. 293 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 8, p. 249 • Al-Fusul al-Muhimmah, Part 1, p. 637

Chapter Title: ON THOSE WHO OMIT WUDU OR PART OF IT, OR DOUBTS IN ITS COMPLETION
arabic_text:
وَ سُئِلَ أَبُو اَلْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَبْقَى مِنْ وَجْهِهِ إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ مَوْضِعْ لَمْ يُصِبْهُ
اَلْمَاءُ فَقَالَ «يُجْزِيهِ أَنْ يَبُلْهُ مِنْ بَعْضِ جَسَدِهِ.
english_text:
Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} was asked about a man who,
while performing wudu, misses a small area on his face that the water does not reach.
Imam {a.s} said: "It suffices for him to moisten it with water from another part of his
body."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 352 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 472

Chapter Title: ON THOSE WHO OMIT WUDU OR PART OF IT, OR DOUBTS IN ITS COMPLETION
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «إِنْ نَسِيتَ مَسْحَ رَأْسِكَ فَامْسَحْ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلَى رِجْلَيْكَ مِنْ بِلّةٍ وَضُوئِكَ فَإِنْ لَمْ
يَكُنْ بَقِيَ فِي يَدِكَ مِنْ نَدَاوَةٍ وَضُوئِكَ شَيْءُ فَخُذْ مِمَّا بَقِيَ مِنْهُ فِي لِحْيَتِكَ وَ اِمْسَحْ بِهِ رَأْسَكَ وَ رِجْلَيْكَ وَ إِنْ لَمْ
يَكُنْ لَكَ لِحْيَةً فَخُذْ مِنْ حَاجِبَيْكَ وَ أَشفَارٍ عَيْنَيْكَ وَ اِمْسَحْ بِهِ رَأْسَكَ وَ رِجْلَيْكَ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَبْقَ مِنْ بِلَّةِ وَضُوئِكَ شَيْءٌ
أَعَدْتَ الْوُضُوءَ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"If you forget to wipe your head, then wipe it and your feet with the remaining moisture
from your wudu.
If there is no moisture left in your hands from the wudu, then take what remains in your
beard and wipe your head and feet with it.
If you do not have a beard, then take from your eyebrows and the lashes of your eyes
and wipe your head and feet with that.
If there is no moisture left from your wudu, then repeat the wudu."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 351 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 409

Chapter Title: ON THOSE WHO OMIT WUDU OR PART OF IT, OR DOUBTS IN ITS COMPLETION
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى أَبُو بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: فِي رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ مَسْحَ رَأْسِهِ قَالَ «فَلْيَمْسَخ» قَالَ لَمْ يَذْكُرْهُ
حَتَّى دَخَلَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ «فَلْيَمْسَخْ رَأْسَهُ مِنْ بَلَلِ لِحْيَتِهِ.
english_text:
Abu Basir narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} regarding a
man who forgets to wipe his head during wudu.
Imam {a.s} said: "Then let him wipe it."
Abu Basir asked: "What if he does not remember until he has started the prayer?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Then let him wipe his head with the moisture from his beard”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 352 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 410

Chapter Title: ON THOSE WHO OMIT WUDU OR PART OF IT, OR DOUBTS IN ITS COMPLETION
arabic_text:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ زَيْدِ الشَّحَّامِ وَ الْمُفَضَّلِ بْنِ صَالِحِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: فِي رَجْلٍ تَوَضَّأَ فَنَسِيَ أَنْ
يَمْسَحَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ حَتَّى قَامَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ قَالَ «فَلْيَنْصَرِفُ فَلْيَمْسَحْ بِرَأْسِهِ وَ لَيُعِدِ الصَّلاَةَ.
ومن شك في شئ من وضوئه وهو قاعد على حال الوضوء فليعد، ومن قام عن مكانه ثم شك في شئ من وضوئه فلا
بلتفت إلى الشك إلا أن يستيقن، ومن شك في الوضوء وهو على يقين من الحدث فليتوضاً، ومن شك في الحدث وكان
على يقين من الوضوء فلا ينقض اليقين بالشك إلا أن يستيقن، ومن كان على يقين من الوضوء والحدث ولا يدري أيهما
أسبق فليتوضأ.
english_text:
In the narration of Zayd al-Shahham and al-Mufaddal ibn Salih, narrated from
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}, concerning a man who performs wudu but
forgets to wipe his head until he has started the prayer,
Imam {a.s} said: "Let him leave, wipe his head, and repeat the prayer."
commentary:
For anyone who doubts something in their wudu while still seated in the place of wudu,
they should redo it. However, if they have already left the place and then doubt
something about the wudu, they should disregard the doubt unless they are certain. If
a person is certain of a state of ritual impurity (hadath) but doubts whether they
performed wudu, they should perform wudu. Conversely, if one is certain of wudu but
doubts an act that would invalidate it, they should not negate their certainty due to
doubt unless they are certain. If one is sure of both wudu and impurity but does not
know which came first, they should perform wudu.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 352 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 371

Chapter Title: WHAT NULLIFIES ABLUTION
arabic_text:
باب - ما ينقض الوضوء
سَأَلَ زُرَارَةُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ وَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: عَمّا يَنْقُضُ الْوُضُوءَ فَقَالا «مَا خَرَجَ مِنْ طَرَفَيْكَ
الْأَسْفَلَيْنٍ الذَّكَرِ وَ الدُّبُرِ مِنْ غَائِطِ أَوْ بَوْلٍ أَوْ مَنِيَّ أَوْ رِيحِ وَ النَّوْمُ حَتَّى يُذْهِبَ ٱلْعَقْلَ.
ولا ينقض الوضوء ما سوى ذلك من القئ والقلس والرعاف والحجامة والدماميل والجروح والقروح، ولا يوجب الاستنجاء.
english_text:
Zurarah ibn A'yan asked Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} and Imam Jafar
ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about what nullifies wudu (ablution).
They said: "Anything that exits from your two lower openings, the front (urethra) and
the back (anus), such as excrement, urine, semen, or wind, as well as sleep that
causes a loss of consciousness, invalidates wudu”.
commentary:
And the ablution is not invalidated by anything other, such as; vomiting, regurgitation,
nosebleeds, cupping, abscesses, wounds, and sores, do not nullify ablution nor
necessitate istinja (cleansing of private parts).
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: WHAT NULLIFIES ABLUTION
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «لَيْسَ فِي حَبّ الْقَرْعِ وَ الدِّيدَانِ الصِّغَارِ وُضُوءُ إِنَّمَا هُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْقَمْلِ».
وهذا إذا لم يكن فيه ثفل، فإذا كان فيه ثفل ففيه الاستنجاء والوضوء.
وكلما خرج من الطرفين من دم وقيح ومذي ووذي وغير ذلك فلا وضوء فيه ولا استنجاء ما لم يخرج بول أو غائط أو
ريح أو مني
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"There is no ablution required in the instance of taenia worms (or ticks and small
worms), they are regarded like lice, and this applies if they do not have any waste
matter, However, if there is waste matter, then istinja (cleansing of the private parts)
and ablution are required.”
commentary:
Anything that exits from the two lower openings (other than stool, urine, wind, or
semen) such as blood, pus, pre-seminal fluid, or other discharges does not require
ablution or istinja, unless it is urine, stool, wind, or semen.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 36 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 12 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 82 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 248 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 258

Chapter Title: WHAT NULLIFIES ABLUTION
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ لِلصَّادِقِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: أَجِدُ الرِّيحَ فِي بَطْنِي حَتَّى أَظْنَ أَنَّهَا قَدْ خَرَجَتْ
فَقَالَ «لَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ وُضُوءُ حَتَّى تَسْمَعَ الصَّوْتَ أَوْ تَجِدَ الرِّيحَ» ثُمّ قَالَ «إِنّ إِبْلِيسَ يَجْلِسُ بَيْنَ ألْيَتَيِ الرَّجُلِ
فَيُحْدِثُ لِيُشَكِّكَهُ.
english_text:
Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah asked Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
'I feel wind in my stomach to the extent that I think it has exited.'
Imam {a.s} said: 'You do not need to perform ablution unless you hear a sound or
perceive the smell.'
Imam {a.s} then added:
'Indeed, Satan sits between a man's buttocks and causes him to think he has passed
wind to make him doubt.'.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 246

Chapter Title: WHAT NULLIFIES ABLUTION
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ زُرَارَةُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُقَلَّمُ أَظَافِيرَهُ وَ يَجُزُّ شَارِبَهُ وَ يَأْخُذُ مِنْ شَعْرٍ لِحْيَتِهِ وَ
رَأْسِهِ هَلْ يَنْقُضُ ذَلِكَ الْوُضُوءَ فَقَالَ
«يَا زُرَارَةُ كُلُّ هَذَا سُنَّةٌ وَ الْوُضُوءُ فَرِيضَةٌ وَ لَيْسَ شَيْءٌ مِنَ السُنَّةِ يَنْقُضُ الْفَرِيضَةَ وَ إِنَّ ذَلِكَ لَيَزِيدُهُ تَظهِيراً.
english_text:
Zurarah asked Imam Al-Baqir {a.s} about a man who trims his nails, clips his
mustache, and cuts some of the hair from his beard and head. Does that nullify his
ablution?
Imam {a.s} said: 'O’ Zurarah, all of this is Sunnah (recommended practice), while
ablution is an obligation (fardh). None of the Sunnah practices invalidate an
obligation. In fact, such practices increase one's purity.'.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 346 • Al-Istibsar, P 1, p. 95 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 252 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 287 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 105 • Al-Fusul al- Muhimmah, P 2, p. 17

Chapter Title: WHAT NULLIFIES ABLUTION
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَابِرٍ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَأْخُذُ مِنْ أَظَافِيرِهِ وَ شَارِبِهِ أَيَمْسَحُهُ بِالْمَاءِ
فَقَالَ «لا هُوَ طَهُورٌ.
english_text:
Ismail ibn Jaber asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man
who trims his nails and mustache: should he wipe them with water afterward?
Imam {a.s} said: 'No, he is already pure.'.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: WHAT NULLIFIES ABLUTION
arabic_text: - وَ سُئِلَ عَنْ إِنْشَادِ الشِّعْرِ هَلْ يَنْقُضُ الْوُضُوءَ فَقَالَ لا.
english_text:
(Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s}) was asked whether reciting poetry nullifies ablution?
Imam {a.s} said: 'No.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: WHAT NULLIFIES ABLUTION
arabic_text: - وَ سَأَلَهُ سَمَاعَةُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ: عَنِ الرّجُلِ يُخْفِقُ رَأْسَهُ وَ هُوَ فِي الصَّلاةِ قَائِماً أَوْ رَاكِعاً قَالَ «لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ وُضُوءُ.
english_text:
Sama'a ibn Mehran asked Imam {a.s} about a man who nods off while standing
or bowing in prayer. Imam {a.s} said: 'He does not need to perform ablution.'.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 255

Chapter Title: WHAT NULLIFIES ABLUTION
arabic_text:
وَ سُئِلَ مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَرْقُدُ وَ هُوَ قَاعِدٌ هَلْ عَلَيْهِ وُضُوءُ فَقَالَ «لاَ وُضُوءَ عَلَيْهِ
مَا دَامَ قَاعِداً إِنْ لَمْ يَنْفَرِجْ.
english_text:
Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} was asked about a man who falls asleep
while sitting: does he need to perform ablution?
Imam {a.s} said: 'He does not need to perform ablution as long as he remains seated
and does not slump over.' (overcome with sleep whereby he loses awareness)
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: WHAT NULLIFIES ABLUTION
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ أُبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «لَيْسَ فِي الْقُبْلَةِ وَ لاَ ٱلْمُبَاشَرَةِ وَ لاَ مَسِّ ٱلْفَرْجِ وُضُوءُ.
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
'There is no need for ablution after kissing, touching intimately, or touching the private
parts.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 37 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 21 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 87 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 268 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 270

Chapter Title: WHAT NULLIFIES ABLUTION
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى حَرِيزٌ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ - «إِذَا كَانَ ٱلرَّجُلُ يَقْطُرُ مِنْهُ الْبَوْلُ وَ ٱلدَّمُ إِذَا كَانَ جِينَ
الصَّلَاةِ اِتَّخَذَ كِيساً وَ جَعَلَ فِيهِ قُطْناً ثُمَّ عَلْقَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ أَدْخَلَ ذَكَرَهُ فِيهِ ثُمْ صَلْى يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الصَّلاَتَيْنِ الظَّهْرِ وَ
الْعَصْرِ يُؤَخِّرُ الظُّهْرَ وَ يُعَجّلُ الْعَصْرَ بِأَذَانٍ وَ إقَامَتَيْنِ وَ يُؤَخِّرُ الْمَغْرِبَ وَ يُعَجِّلُ الْعِشَاءَ بِأَذَانٍ وَ إِقَامَتَيْنِ وَ يَفْعَلُ
ذَلِكَ فِي الصُّبْحِ
english_text:
Hariz narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that He said:
'If a man has a condition where urine or blood drips from him, then at the time of
prayer, he should use a pouch filled with cotton, attach it, and place his private part
inside it.
Then he should pray, combining the Dhuhr and Asr prayers by delaying Dhuhr and
advancing Asr with one call to prayer (adhan) and two calls to commence (iqamah).
Similarly, he should delay Maghrib and advance Isha with one adhan and two iqamah.
He should do the same for Fajr.'.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 348 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 3, p. 26 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 143 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 297

Chapter Title: WHAT NULLIFIES ABLUTION
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ عَبْدُ اللّهِ بْنُ أَبِي يَعْفُورِ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: عَنْ رَجُلٍ بَالَ ثُمَّ تَوَضّاً وَ قَامَ إِلَى الصَّلَاَةِ فَوَجَدَ
بَلَلاً قَالَ «لاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ وَ لاَ يَتَوَضَّاً
english_text:
Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'fur asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a
man who urinates, performs ablution, then stands for prayer and finds wetness.
Imam {a.s} said: 'There is nothing upon him, and he does not need to perform ablution
again.'.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: WHAT NULLIFIES ABLUTION
arabic_text:
148 رَوَى غَيْرُهُ: فِي الرَّجُلِ يَبُولُ ثُمَّ يَسْتَنْجِي ثُمَّ يَرَى بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ بَلَلا «أَنَّهُ إِذَا بَالَ فَخَرَطَ مَا بَيْنَ ٱلْمَقْعَدَةِ وَ
الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ وَ غَمَزَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا ثُمَّ اِسْتَنْجَى فَإِنْ سَالَ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى بَلَغَ السُّوقَ فَلَاَ يُبَالِي.
وإذا مس الرجل باطن دبره أو باطن إحليله فعليه أن يعيد الوضوء، وإن كان في الصلاة قطع الصلاة وتوضأ وأعاد الصلاة،
وإن فتح إحليله أعاد الوضوء والصلاة. ومن احتقن أو حمل شيافة [قذرا] فليس عليه إعادة الوضوء وإن خرج ذلك منه
إلا أن يكون مختلطا بالثفل فعليه الاستنجاء والوضوء.
english_text:
Another narration (by Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} ) states: In the
case of a man who urinates, performs istinja (cleansing of private parts), and then
notices wetness afterward: 'If he, after urinating, presses the area between the anus
and the testicles three times and massages it, then performs istinja, he need not worry
even if wetness flows down to his thighs.'.
commentary:
If a man touches the inner part of his anus or the inner part of his urethra, he must
repeat his ablution; if he does so during prayer, he should interrupt the prayer, perform
ablution, and repeat the prayer. Additionally, if he opens his urethra, he must redo his
ablution and prayer.
However, if someone uses an enema or carries something impure [such as filth], he is
not required to redo his ablution even if it exits from him, unless it is mixed with feces,
in which case he must perform istinja (cleaning the private parts) and redo the
ablution.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: WHAT DEFILES CLOTHING AND THE BODY
arabic_text:
باب - ما ينجس الثوب والجسد
كَانَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ لا يَرَى فِي الْمَذْي وُضُوءاً وَ لاَ غَسْلَ مَا أَصَابَ التَّوْبَ مِنْهُ.
english_text:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} did not consider the
pre-seminal fluid (madhi) to invalidate ablution or require ritual wash, nor did he deem
it necessary to wash clothing that had been affected by it”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 177 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 281

Chapter Title: WHAT DEFILES CLOTHING AND THE BODY
arabic_text:
150 رُوِيَ: «أَنَّ ٱلْمَذْيَ وَ ٱلْوَذْيَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ ٱلْبُصَاقِ وَ ٱلْمُخَاطِ فَلاَ يُغْسَلُ مِنْهُمَا التَوْبُ وَ لاَ ٱلْإِحْلِيلُ.
وهي أربعة أشياء: المني، والمذي، والوذي، والودي. فأما المني فهو الماء الغليظ الدافق الذي يوجب الغسل. والمذي ما
يخرج قبل المني والوذي ما يخرج بعد المني على أثره، والودي ما يخرج على أثر البول، لا يجب في شئ من ذلك الغسل
ولا الوضوء ولا غسل ثوب ولا غسل ما يصيب الجسد منه إلا المني
english_text:
It has been narrated that pre-seminal fluid (madhi) and post-urinal fluid
(wadhi) are akin to saliva and mucus, so neither the garment nor the private parts need
to be washed because of them.
commentary:
These are four things: Semen (mani), pre-seminal fluid (madhi), post-seminal
discharge (wadhi), and a fluid discharged after urination (wudi).
Semen is a thick, gushing fluid that necessitates a full ritual bath (ghusl janabah).
Madhi is what comes out before semen, wadhi is what comes out after semen, and
wudi is what is discharged after urination. None of these, except semen, require a
ritual ghusl), nor ablution (wudu), nor the washing of clothing, nor the washing of
anything that comes into contact with the body.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 177

Chapter Title: WHAT DEFILES CLOTHING AND THE BODY
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ عَنْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَلْبَسُ التَّوْبَ وَ فِيهِ الْجَنَابَةُ فَيَعْرَقُ فِيهِ فَقَالَ
«إِنّ الثَّوْبَ لاَ يُجْنِبُ الرَّجَلَ.
english_text:
Abdullah ibn Bakir asked Imam Jafar Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man who wears a
garment with janabah (ritual impurity from sexual activity) and sweats in it.
Imam {a.s} said: 'The garment does not make the man ritually impure.'.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 52 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 268 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 185 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 170 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 182 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 267 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 3, p. 445

Chapter Title: WHAT DEFILES CLOTHING AND THE BODY
arabic_text: - وَ فِي خَبَرٍ آخَرَ: «أَنَّهُ لا يُجْنِبُ الثَّوْبُ الرَّجُلَ وَ لا الرَّجُلُ يُجْنِبُ التَّوْبَ.
english_text:
In another narration: 'A garment does not make a man ritually impure, nor does
a man make a garment ritually impure.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: WHAT DEFILES CLOTHING AND THE BODY
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ زَيْدٌ الشَّحَّامُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: عَنِ الثَوْبِ يَكُونُ فِيهِ الْجَنَابَةُ وَ تُصِيبُنِي السَّمَاءُ حَتّى يَبْتَلَّ
عَلَيَّ فَقَالَ «لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ.
وإذا نام الرجل على فراش قد أصابه مني فعرق فيه فلا بأس به. ومتى عرق في ثوبه وهو جنب فليتنشف فيه إذا اغتسل
