فَعَرَفْنَا أَنَّ الْوَجْهَ كُلَّهُ يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُغْسَلَ ثُمَّ قَالَ « وَ أَيْدِيَكُمْ إِلَى الْمَرْافِقِ
@) فَوَصَلَ الْيَدَيْنِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ
بِالْوَجْهِ فَعَرَفْنَا أَنَّهُ يَنْبَغِي لَهُمَا أَنْ يُغْسَلاَ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ ثُمَّ فَصَّلَ بَيْنَ الْكَلامِ فَقَالَ: «) وَ اِمْسَحُوا بِرُؤْسِكُمْ )
فَعَرَفْنَا جِينَ قَالَ « بِرُوُسِكُمْ » أَنَ ٱلْمَسْحَ بِبَعْضِ الرَّأْسِ لِمَكَانِ الْبَاءِ ثُمَّ وَصَلَ الرِّجْلَيْنِ بِالرَّأْسِ كَمَا وَصَلَ ٱلْيَدَيْنِ
بِالْوَجْهِ فَقَالَ: « وَ أَرْجُلَكُمْ إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ » فَعَرَفْنَا جينَ وَصَلَهُمَا بِالرَّأْسِ أَنَّ ٱلْمَسْحَ عَلَى بَعْضِهِمَا ثُمَّ فَسَّرَ
ذَلِكَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ لِلنَّاسِ فَضَيَّعُوهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ: () فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا مَاءً فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيداً طَيِّباً
فَامْسَحُوا بِوُجُوهِكُمْ » فَلَمَّا أَنْ وَضَعَ الْوُضُوءَ عَمَّنْ لَمْ يَجِدِ ٱلْمَاءَ أَثْبَتَ بَعْضَ ٱلْغَسْلِ مَسْحاً لِأَنَّهُ قَالَ
«بِوُجُوهِكُمْ»
ثُمَّ وَصَلَ بِهَا: «وَ أَيْدِيكُمْ مِنْهُ» أَيْ مِنْ ذَلِكَ التَّيَمُّمِ لِأَنَّهُ عَلِمَ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ أَجْمَعَ لَمْ يَجْرٍ عَلَى الْوَجْهِ لِأَنْهُ يَعْلَقُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ
الصَّعِيدِ بِبَعْضِ الْكَفِّ وَ لا يَعْلَقُ بِبَعْضِهَا ثُمَّ قَالَ اللهُ « مَا يُرِيدُ اللهُ لِيَجْعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ حَرَجٍ » وَ الْحَرَجُ
اَلضِّيقُ.
english_text:
From Zurarah, he asked Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}:
'Would you not inform me from where you derived and said that wiping is done on part
of head and part of feet?'
Imam {a.s} smiled and said:
'O’ Zurarah, it was stated by the Messenger of Allah {saws} and it was revealed in the Book
of Allah {SWT}. Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, said: "So wash your faces" (Surah Al-Ma’idah 5:6).
Thus, we understood that the entire face must be washed.
Then Imam {a.s} said: "and your hands up to the elbows."
Thus, Allah {SWT} has connected the hands up to the elbows with the face, so we
understood that they must be washed up to the elbows.
Then, Allah {SWT} separated between the statements and said: "and wipe your heads."
Thus, we understood from "your heads" that wiping is done on part of the head due to
the use of "bi" (preposition indicating partiality).
Then, Allah {SWT} connected the feet to the head just as Allah {SWT} connected the hands
to the face and said: "and your feet up to the ankles."
Thus, we understood, by connecting them to the head, that wiping is done on part of
them.'
Imam {a.s} continued: 'The Messenger of Allah {saws} explained this to the people, but they
neglected it.
Then Allah {SWT} said: "If you do not find water, then seek clean earth and wipe over your
faces and hands with it."
Thus, when Allah {SWT} waived the requirement of wudu for one who does not find water,
Allah {SWT} replaced some of the washing with wiping, as Allah {SWT} said, "with your
faces."
Then Allah {SWT} connected it with: "and your hands from it," meaning from that
tayammum.
This is because Allah {SWT} knew that not all of the dust would reach the face, as some
of it would adhere to some parts of the hand and not all of the hand.
Then Allah {SWT} said: "Allah {SWT} does not intend to make difficulty for you," and difficulty
means constraint.'"
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 30 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 1, p. 279 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 61 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 62 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 282 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol. 2, p. 256 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 77, p. 289 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 1, p. 596

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER ON TAYAMMUM (DRY ABLUTION)
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ زُرَارَةُ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ ذَاتَ يَوْمِ لِعَمَّارٍ فِي سَفَرٍ لَهُ
«يَا عَمَّارُ بَلَغَنَا أَنَّكَ أَجْتَبْتَ فَكَيْفَ صَنَعْتَ» قَالَ تَمَرَّغْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ فِي التُرَابِ قَالَ فَقَالَ لَهُ «كَذَلِكَ يَتَمَرَّغُ
الْجِمَارُ أَفَلا صَنَعْتَ كَذَا» ثُمَّ أَهْوَى بِيَدَيْهِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ فَوَضَعَهُمَا عَلَى الصَّعِيدِ ثُمَّ مَسَحَ جَبِينَيْهِ بِأَصَابِعِهِ وَ كَفِّيْهِ
إِحْدَاهُمَا بِالأُخْرَى ثُمَّ لَمْ يُعِدْ ذَلِكَ.
فإذا تيمم الرجل للوضوء ضرب يديه على الأرض مرة واحدة ثم نفضهما و مسح بهما جبينيه وحاجبيه ومسح على ظهر
كفيه، وإذا كان التيمم للجنابة ضرب يديه على الأرض مرة واحدة، ثم نفضهما ومسح بهما جبينيه وحاجبيه، ثم ضرب
يديه على الأرض مرة أخرى ومسح على ظهر يديه فوق الكف قليلا ويبدأ بمسح اليمنى قبل اليسرى.
english_text:
From Zurarah, he narrates that Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, said:
'One day, the Messenger of Allah {saws} said to Ammar while on a journey,
"O’ Ammar, it has reached us that you became junub (ritually impure due to sexual
discharge). What did you do?"
Ammar replied: "I rolled in the dirt, O’ Messenger of Allah {saws}."
The Prophet then said to him, "This is how a donkey rolls. You should have done this
instead."
Prophet {saws} then placed his hands on the clean earth, wiped his forehead with his
fingers, and then wiped the back of each hand with the other hand, and he did not
repeat it ’.
commentary:
When a person performs tayammum for wudu (ablution), he should strike his hands
on the earth once, shake them off, and then wipe his forehead and eyebrows, and then
the backs of his hands.
If the tayammum is for janabah (major ritual impurity), he should strike his hands on
the earth once, shake them off, and wipe his forehead and eyebrows.
Then, he strikes his hands on the earth again, wipes the backs of his hands up to a little
above the wrists, and starts by wiping the right hand before the left.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 580 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 3, p. 360

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER ON TAYAMMUM (DRY ABLUTION)
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَلِيّ الْحَلَبِي أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ إِذَا أَجْتَبَ وَ لَمْ يَجِدِ الْمَاءَ قَالَ
«يَتَيَمَّمُ بِالصَّعِيدِ فَإِذَا وَجَدَ الْمَاءَ فَلْيَعْتَسِلْ وَ لا يُعِيدُ الصَّلاةَ»
وَ عَنِ الرَجْلِ يَمُرُ بِالرَكِيَّةِ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ دَلْوْ قَالَ «لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ الرَكِيَّةَ لِأَنَ رَبَّ ٱلْمَاءِ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْأَرْضِ فَلْيَتَيَمَمْ»
وَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُجْنِبُ وَ مَعَهُ قَدْرُ مَا يَكْفِيهِ مِنَ ٱلْمَاءِ لِوُضُوءِ الصَّلاَةِ أَيَتَوَضَا بِالْمَاءِ أَوْ يَتَيَمَّمُ قَالَ «لا بَلْ يَتَيَمَّمُ أَلا
تَرَى أَنَّهُ إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ عَلَيْهِ نِصْفُ الْوُضُوءِ.
ومتى أصاب المتيمم الماء ورجا أن يقدر على ماء آخر أو ظن أنه يقدر عليه كما أراده فعسر عليه ذلك، فإن نظره إلى الماء
بنقض تيممه وعليه أن يعيد التيمم، فإن أصاب الماء وقد دخل في الصلاة فليضرب وليتوضا ما لم يركع، فإن كان قد ركع
فليمض في صلاته فان التيمم أحد الطهورين، ومن تيمم ثم أصاب الماء فعليه الغسل إن كان جنبا والوضوء إن لم يكن
جنبا، فإن أصاب الماء وقد صلى بتيمم وهو في وقت فقد تمت صلاته ولا إعادة عليه.
english_text:
Ubaidullah ibn Ali Al-Halabi asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}
about a man who becomes junub (ritually impure due to sexual discharge) and does
not find water.
Imam {a.s} said: 'He should perform tayammum with clean earth (sa’eed), and when he
finds water, he should perform ghusl, but he does not need to repeat the prayer.'
He also asked about a man who passes by a well but does not have a bucket with him.
Imam {a.s} said: 'He is not required to enter the well because the Lord {AZJ} of the water is
also the Lord {AZJ} of the earth, so he should perform tayammum.'.
He asked further about a man who becomes junub and has only enough water to
perform wudu (ablution) for prayer; should he use the water for wudu or perform
tayammum?
Imam {a.s} said: 'No, he should do tayammum. Do you not see that only half of wudu is
needed of him?'
commentary:
If a person who has performed tayammum finds water and hopes to find more water
later or thinks he might find it as intended but then struggles to find it, merely seeing
the water invalidates his tayammum, and he must repeat it.
If he finds water after starting his prayer but has not yet bowed (Rukuh), he should
interrupt and perform wudu. If he has already bowed, he should continue with his
prayer, as tayammum is one of the forms of purification. If a person performs
tayammum and later finds water, he must perform ghusl if he was in a state of janabah
or wudu if he was not, but if he has already completed his prayer with tayammum
during its time, then his prayer is valid and does not need to be repeated.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER ON TAYAMMUM (DRY ABLUTION)
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ زُرَارَةُ وَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ: قُلْنَا لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ رَجُلٌ لَمْ يُصِبُ مَاءٌ وَ حَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَتَيَمَّمَ
وَ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمّ أَصَابَ الْمَاءَ أَيَنْقُضُ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ أَوْ يَقْطَعُهُمَا وَ يَتَوَضَّأُ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي قَالَ «لا وَلَكِنَّهُ يَمْضِي فِي
صَلاتِهِ فَيُتِمُهَا وَ لاَ يَنْقُضُهَا لِمَكَانِ الْمَاءِ لِأَنَّهُ دَخَلَهَا وَ هُوَ عَلَى طُهرٍ بِتَيَمُمِ» وَقَالَ زُرَارَةُ قُلْتُ لَهُ دَخَلَهَا وَ هُوَ مُتَيَمَمْ
فَصَلَّى رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ أَحْدَثَ فَأَصَابَ مَاءً قَالَ «يَخْرُجْ فَيَتَوَضَأْ ثُمَّ يَبْنِي عَلَى مَا مَضَى مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ الَّتِي صَلَّى بِالتَّيَمُمِ
english_text:
Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim said: We asked Abu Ja'far {a.s} about a man
who does not find water, and the time for prayer arrives, so he performs tayammum
and prays two rak'ahs. Then he finds water. Should he invalidate the two rak'ahs, does
he interrupt them, perform wudu, and then repeat the prayer?
Imam {a.s} said: 'No, he should continue his prayer and complete it, and the presence
of water does not invalidate it because he entered into it while in a state of purity
through tayammum.'
Zurarah also said: I asked him about a person who entered the prayer with tayammum,
prayed one rak'ah, then broke his wudu and now has also found water.
Imam {a.s} said: 'He should go out, perform wudu, and then continue from where he left
off in the prayer that he began with tayammum.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 205 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 167 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 3, p. 49 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 562

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER ON TAYAMMUM (DRY ABLUTION)
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ عَمَّارُ بْنُ مُوسَى السَّابَاطِيِّ أُبَا عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: عَنِ التَّيَمَّمِ مِنَ الْوُضُوءِ وَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ وَ مِنَ
الْحَيْض لِلنِّسَاءِ سَوَاءً فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ.
english_text:
Ammar ibn Musa al-Sabati asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}
about tayammum for wudu (ablution), janabah (major ritual impurity), and
menstruation for women.
Imam {a.s} said: 'Yes, it is the same.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 162 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 212 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 583 • Tafsir al-Safi, Part 1, p. 456 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 315 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 3, p. 362

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER ON TAYAMMUM (DRY ABLUTION)
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ بِهِ الْقُرُوحُ وَ الْجِرَاحَاتُ فَيُجْنِبُ فَقَالَ «لا
بَأَسَ بِأَنْ يَتَيَمَّمَ وَ لَا يَعْتَسِلَ.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Muslim asked Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} about a
man who has sores and wounds and becomes junub (ritually impure due to sexual
discharge).
Imam {a.s} said: 'There is no harm if he performs tayammum and does not make ghusl
(ritual bath).'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER ON TAYAMMUM (DRY ABLUTION)
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «ٱلْمَبْطُونُ وَ الْكَسِيرُ يُؤَمَّمَانٍ وَ لاَ يُغَسَّلَانٍ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
'One who is suffering from a severe stomach illness or has broken bones should
perform tayammum and should not perform ghusl (ritual bathing).'.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 3, p. 348

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER ON TAYAMMUM (DRY ABLUTION)
arabic_text:
وَ قِيلَ لِرَسُولِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ إِنَّ فُلاناً أَصَابَثْهُ جَنَابَةٌ وَ هُوَ مَجْدُورْ فَغَسَلُوهُ فَمَاتَ
فَقَالَ «قَتَلُوهُ ألاَ سَأَلُوا أَلاَ يَمَّمُوهُ إِنَّ شِفَاءَ الْعِيِّ ٱلسُوَالُ.
english_text:
It was said to the Messenger of Allah {saws}:
'O’ Messenger of Allah {saws}, so-and-so became junub (ritually impure due to sexual
discharge) and had smallpox, so they washed him and he died.'
Imam {a.s} said: 'They killed him! Why did they not ask? Why did they not perform
tayammum for him? Surely, the cure for ignorance is asking questions.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Sarayer, Part 3, p. 612 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 78, p. 154

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER ON TAYAMMUM (DRY ABLUTION)
arabic_text:
وَ سُبِلَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ: عَنْ مَجْدُورِ أَصَابَثهُ جَنَابَةً فَقَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ أَجْتَبَ هَوَ فَلْيَفْتَسِلْ وَ إِنْ كَانَ
اِحْتَلَمَ فَلْيَنَيَمّمُ.
والجنب إذا خاف على نفسه من البرد تيمم.
english_text:
It was asked of Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about a man
with smallpox who became junub (ritually impure due to sexual discharge).
Imam {a.s} said: 'If he became junub (through intercourse), he should perform ghusl, but
if he had a nocturnal emission (i.e., he experienced it while sleeping), he should
perform tayammum.'.
commentary:
And if a person in a state of janabah fears harm from the cold, they may perform
tayammum.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Vol 3, p. 68 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 198 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 162 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 3, p. 46 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 552 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 3, p.

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER ON TAYAMMUM (DRY ABLUTION)
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَهُ مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي السِّفَرِ فَلَا يَجِدُ ٱلْمَاءَ فَيَتَيَمَّمُ وَ يُصَلِّي ثُمَّ يَأْتِي عَلَى ٱلْمَاءِ
وَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءَ مِنَ الْوَقْتِ أَيَمْضِي عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ أَمْ يَتَوَضَّا وَ يُعِيدُ الصَّلاَةَ قَالَ «يَمْضِي عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ فَإِنَّ رَبَّ ٱلْمَاءِ
هُوَ رَبُّ التُّرَابِ.
english_text:
Mu'awiyah ibn Maythara asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about
a man who is traveling, does not find water, performs tayammum, and prays. Then he
finds water while there is still some time left (for the prayer). Should he continue with
his prayer or perform wudu and repeat the prayer?
Imam {a.s} said: 'He should continue with his prayer, for the Lord {AZJ} of the water is the
Lord {AZJ} of the earth.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER ON TAYAMMUM (DRY ABLUTION)
arabic_text:
وَ أَتَّى أُبُو ذَرِّ رَجِمَهُ اللَّهُ النَّبِيِّ صَ فَقَالَ: «يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلَكْتُ جَامَعْتُ عَلَى غَيْرِ مَاءِ قَالَ فَأْمَرَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى
اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ بِمَحْمِلٍ فَاسْتَتَزْنَا بِهِ وَ بِمَاءٍ فَاغْتَسَلْتُ أَنَا وَ هِيَ ثُمّ قَالَ «يَا أَبَا ذَرِّ يَكُفِيكَ الصَّعِيدُ عَشرَ سِنِينَ».
وإذا أجنب الرجل في سفر ومعه ماء قدر ما يتوضأ به تيمم ولم يتوضأ إلا أن يعلم أنه يدرك الماء قبل أن يفوته وقت
الصلاة.
english_text:
Abu Dharr came to the Prophet, and said: "O’ Messenger of Allah {saws}, I have
perished; I had relations (with a women) without water (for ghusl afterwards)."
The Prophet then ordered a canopy to be used for covering (privacy) and water for
bathing.
Abu Dharr said: 'We both (he and his wife) then performed ghusl.
Then He {saws} said: "'O’ Abu Dharr, clean earth (tayammum) is sufficient for you for ten
years.'
commentary:
If a man becomes junub (ritually impure due to sexual discharge) while traveling and
has only enough water for wudu (ablution), he should perform tayammum instead of
wudu unless he knows that he will find water before the prayer time expires.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 194 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 199 • Al-Arba‘ūn Ḥadīthan (Al-Shahīd al-Awwal) Vol. 1, p. 26 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 3, p. 47 • Al- Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 551 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 3, p. 369 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 78, p. 168 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 2, p. 541

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER ON TAYAMMUM (DRY ABLUTION)
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ نَفَرٍ كَانُوا فِي سَفَرِ
أَحَدُهُمْ جُنْبٌ وَ الثَّانِي مَيَّتُ وَ الثَّالِثُ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ وَ حَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ وَ مَعَهُمْ مِنَ الْمَاءِ قَدْرُ مَا يَكْفِي أَحَدَهُمْ
مَنْ يَأْخُذُ الْمَاءَ وَ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُونَ فَقَالَ «يَفْتَسِلُ الْجُنُبُ وَ يُدْفَنُ الْمَيِّتُ بِتَيَمَّمِ وَ يَتَيَمَّمُ الَّذِي هُوَ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ
لأَنَّ اَلْغُسْلَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ فَرِيضَةٌ وَ غُسْلَ الْمَيِّتِ سُنَّةٌ وَ التَّيَمُمَ لِلْآخَرِ جَائِزٌ.
english_text:
Abdul Rahman ibn Abi Najran asked Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-
Kadhim {a.s} about three people who were traveling: one was junub (in a state of major
ritual impurity), the second was dead, and the third was without wudu (ablution). The
time for prayer came, and they had only enough water for one of them. Who should
use the water and what should they do?
Imam {a.s} said: 'The one who is junub should perform ghusl (ritual bathing). The
deceased should be buried with tayammum, and the one without wudu should
perform tayammum because ghusl from janabah is a religious obligation, the washing
of the deceased is a recommended practice, and tayammum for the other is
permissible.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 3, p. 49 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 3, p. 375 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 78, p. 26

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER ON TAYAMMUM (DRY ABLUTION)
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمْرَانَ النَّهْدِيُ وَ جَمِيلُ بْنُ دَرَّاجٍ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنْ إمَامِ قَوْمِ أَصَابَثهُ جَنَابَةٌ
فِي السَّفْرِ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ مِنَ الْمَاءِ مَا يَكُفِيهِ لِلْغُسْلِ أَيَتَوَضَّأْ بَعْضُهُمْ وَ يُصَلِّي بِهِمْ فَقَالَ «لَا وَ لَكِنْ يَتَيَمَّمُ الْجُنْبُ وَ
يُصَلِّي بِهِمْ فَإِنَّ اللّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ جَعَلَ التُرَابَ طَهُوراً كَمَا جَعَلَ الْمَاءَ طَهُوراً.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Hamran al-Nahdi and Jamil ibn Darraj asked Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about an Imam leading a group in prayer who becomes junub
(in a state of major ritual impurity) while traveling and does not have enough water for
ghusl (ritual bathing). Should some of them perform wudu and then lead the prayer in
his place?
Imam {a.s} said: 'No, rather the junub should perform tayammum and lead them in
prayer, for Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, has made the earth (dust) a means of
purification just as He has made water a means of purification.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 66 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 167 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 425 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 543 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 3, p. 386 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 8, p. 327

Chapter Title: THE CHAPTER ON TAYAMMUM (DRY ABLUTION)
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سِنَانٍ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ تُصِيبُهُ الْجَنَابَةُ فِي اللَّيْلَةِ الْبَارِدَةِ وَ يَخَافُ
عَلَى نَفْسِهِ التَّلَفَ إِنِ اِغْتَسَلَ فَقَالَ «يَتَيَمْمُ وَ يُصَلِّي فَإِذَا أَمِنَ مِنَ الْبَرْدِ اِغْتَسَلَ وَ أَعَادَ الصَّلاَةَ.
وإذا كان الرجل في حال لا يقدر إلا على الطين يتيمم به فإن اللّٰه تبارك وتعالى أولى بالعذر إذا لم يكن معه ثوب جاف ولا
البد يقدر على أن ينفضه و يتيمم منه. ومن كان في وسط زحام يوم الجمعة أو يوم عرفة ولم يستطع الخروج من المسجد
من كثرة الناس تيمم وصلى معهم وليعد إذا انصرف.
ومن تيمم وكان معه ماء فنسي وصلى بتيمم، ثم ذكر قبل أن يخرج الوقت فليعد الوضوء والصلاة. ومن احتلم في مسجد
من المساجد خرج منه واغتسل، إلا أن يكون احتلامه في المسجد الحرام أو في مسجد الرسول صلى اللّٰه عليه وآله فإنه
إن احتلم في أحد هذين المسجدين تيمم وخرج ولم يمش فيهما إلا متيمما.
english_text:
Abdullah ibn Sinan asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man
who becomes junub (ritually impure) during a cold night and fears for his life if he
performs ghusl (ritual bathing).
Imam {a.s} said: 'He should perform tayammum and pray, and when he is safe from the
cold, he should perform ghusl and repeat the prayer.'
commentary:
If a person is in a situation where they only have access to mud, they should perform
tayammum with it, for Allah {SWT}, the Blessed and Exalted, is more deserving of granting
an excuse if they do not have dry clothing or anything they can shake off and use for
tayammum. If a person finds themselves in a crowded place on the day of Jumu'ah
(Jumu’ah prayer) or on the Day of Arafah and cannot leave the mosque due to the
crowd, they should perform tayammum, pray with the congregation, and then repeat
(the prayer) once they have left.
If a person performs tayammum but had water available and forgot, and prayed using
tayammum, then remembered before the prayer time ended, they should perform
wudu and repeat the prayer. If someone experiences a nocturnal emission (becomes
junub) while in a mosque, they should leave and perform ghusl, except if it occurs in
the Sacred Mosque (Masjid al-Haram) or the Mosque of the Messenger {saws}. In these
two mosques, they should perform tayammum and leave without walking in them
except while in a state of tayammum.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 3, p. 366 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 3, p. 372

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE
arabic_text:
باب - غسل يوم الجمعة ودخول الحمام وآدابه وما جاء في التنظيف والزينة
قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: « «مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللهِ وَ ٱلْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ» فَلاَ يَدْخُلِ الْحَمَّامَ إِلاَّ بِمِئْزَرٍ »
وَ نَهَى صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ عَنِ الْغُسْلِ تَحْتَ السَّمَاءِ إِلَّ بِمِنْزَرٍ وَ نَهَى عَنْ دُخُولِ الْأَنْهَارِ إِلاَّ بِمِنْزَرٍ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ لِلْمَاءِ
أهْلاً وَ سُكَّاناً.
وغسل يوم الجمعة واجب على الرجال والنساء في السفر والحضر إلا أنه رخص للنساء في السفر لقلة الماء.
ومن كان في سفر ووجد الماء يوم الخميس وخشي أن لا يجده يوم الجمعة فلا بأس بأن يغتسل يوم الخميس للجمعة،
فإن وجد الماء يوم الجمعة اغتسل، وإن لم يجد أجزأه.
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
‘Whoever believes in Allah {SWT} and the Last Day should not enter the bathhouse except
with a waistcloth (covering).’
And Prophet {saws} prohibited washing under the open sky without a covering and
prohibited entering rivers without a covering, saying:
'The water has inhabitants and dwellers.'
commentary:
The Jumu’ah (ghusl) is obligatory for both men and women, whether at home or while
traveling, though women are granted a pardon when traveling due to scarcity of water.
If a person is traveling and finds water on Thursday but fears they will not find it on
Jumu’ah, it is permissible to perform the ghusl for Jumu’ah on Thursday.
If they find water on Jumu’ah, they should perform the ghusl then, but if they do not,
the previous ghusl suffices.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
فَقَدْ رَوَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنْ أُمِّهِ وَ أُمَّ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَتَا: كُنّا
مَعَ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فِي البَادِيَةِ وَ نَحْنُ نُرِيدُ بَغْدَادَ فَقَالَ لَنَا يَوْمَ الْخَمِيسِ «اِغْتَسِلاَ
الْيَوْمَ لِغَدِ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ فَإِنَّ الْمَاءَ غَداً بِهَا قَلِيلٌ» قَالَتَا فَاغْتَسَلْنَا يَوْمَ الْخَمِيسِ لِلْجُمُعَةِ.
وغسل يوم الجمعة سنة واجبة، ويجوز من [وقت] طلوع الفجر يوم الجمعة إلى قرب الزوال، وأفضل ذلك ما قرب من
الزوال، ومن نسي الغسل أو فاته لعلة فليغتسل بعد العصر أو يوم السبت، ويجزي الغسل للجمعة كما يكون للرواح.
والوضوء فيه قبل الغسل، ويقول المغتسل للجمعة: " اللهم طهرني وطهر قلبي وأنق غسلي وأجر على لساني محبة منك.
english_text:
Al-Hasan ibn Musa ibn Jafar narrated from his mother and Umm Ahmad bint
Musa {a.s} who said:
"We were both with Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} in the desert while we were
heading to Baghdad, and on Thursday He {a.s} said to us,
'Perform ghusl today for tomorrow, Jumu’ah, because water will be scarce tomorrow.'
They said: So we performed ghusl on Thursday for Jumu’ah.
commentary:
The Jumu’ah bath (ghusl) is an emphasized recommended practice, and it can be
performed from the time of dawn (Fajr) on Jumu’ah until near the time of noon. The
best time being the most preferred time being close to noon. If one forgets or misses
the ghusl due to an excuse, they may perform it after the afternoon or even on
Saturday, and it will still suffice as the Jumu’ah bath as it serves the purpose of
purification and preparation.
Before performing ghusl, one should perform wudu (ablution), and when performing
the Jumu’ah bath, the person should say: 'O’ Allah {SWT}, purify me, purify my heart,
cleanse my body, and let love for You flow on my tongue.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «مَنِ اِغْتَسَلَ لِلْجُمُعَةِ فَقَالَ - أشهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَ أَنَ
مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَ رَسُولُهُ اللّهُمَّ صَلَّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَ اِجْعَلْنِي مِنَ ٱلْمُتَطَهَّرِينَ كَانَ
طُهْراً مِنَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Whoever performs the ghusl (ritual bath) for Jumu’ah and then says:
"I bear witness that there is no god but Allah {SWT}, alone without any partner, and that
Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. O’ Allah {SWT}, bless Muhammad and the
family of Muhammad, and make me among those who turn in repentance and make
me among those who purify themselves,"
It will serve as purification for them from (this) Jumu’ah to (next) Jumu’ah.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 10 • Jamal al-Usbu, Part 1, p. 368 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 513 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 3, p. 323 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 86, p. 352

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «غُسْلُ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ طَهُورٌ وَ كَفَّارَةٌ لِمَا بَيْنَهُمَا مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ مِنَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِلَى
الْجُمُعَةً.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
'The ghusl (ritual bath) of Jumu’ah is a purification and an expiation for the sins
committed between one Jumu’ah and the next (Jumu’ah).'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 395 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 3, p. 315 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 78, p. 128 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 2, p. 501

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: فِي عِلَّةٍ غُسْلٍ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ «إِنَّ الْأَنْصَارَ كَانَتْ تَعْمَلُ فِي نَوَاضِحِهَا وَ أَمْوَالِهَا
فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ حَضَرُوا الْمَسْجِدَ فَتَأَذَّى النَّاسُ بِأَرْوَاحِ آبَاطِهِمْ وَ أَجْسَادِهِمْ فَأَمَرَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ
عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ بِالْغُسْلِ فَجَرَتْ بِذَلِكَ السُّنَّةُ
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said regarding the reason for the
Jumu’ah (ritual bath):
'The Ansar (residents of Medina who supported the Prophet) used to work in their fields
and with their livestock. When Jumu’ah came, they would attend the mosque, and the
people were bothered by the odor from their armpits and bodies. So the Messenger of
Allah {saws} ordered them to perform ghusl, and thus it became a Sunnah (established
practice).'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 395 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 3, p. 315

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وتَعَالَى أَتَمَّ صَلاَةَ ٱلْفَرِيضَةِ بِصَلاَةِ ٱلنَّافِلَةِ وَ أَتَمَّ صِيَامَ الْفَرِيضَةِ بِصِيَامِ النَّافِلَةِ وَ
أَتَمّ الْوُضُوءَ بِغُسْلٍ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ.
english_text:
(Al-Hussain ibn Khalid asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Awwal {a.s}) narrates that:
‘It is narrated that 'Allah {SWT}, the Blessed and Exalted, completes the obligatory prayer
with the supererogatory prayer, completes the obligatory fasting with the
supererogatory fasting, and completes the wudu (ablution) with the ghusl (ritual bath)
of Jumu’ah.’.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 3, p. 315

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدِ الْأَهْوَازِيْ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حُمْرَانَ قَالَ الصَّادِقُ
جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «إِذَا دَخَلْتَ الْحَمَامَ فَقُلْ فِي الْوَقْتِ الَذِي تَنْزِعُ فِيهِ ثِيَابَكَ: اللَّهُمَ اِنْزِغْ عَنَّي رِبْقَةَ
اَلنَّفَاقِ وَ ثَبَّثْنِي عَلَى الْإِيمَانِ وَ إِذَا دَخَلْتَ اَلْبَيْتَ الْأَوْلَ فَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرَّ نَفْسِي وَ أَسْتَعِيذُ بِكَ مِنْ
أَذَاهُ وَ إِذَا دَخَلْتَ الْبَيْتَ الثَّانِيَ فَقُلٍ: اللَّهُمَّ أَذْهِبْ عَنِّي الرِّجْسَ النَّجْسَ وَ طَهَرْ جَسَدِي وَ قَلْبِي وَ خُذْ مِنَ الْمَاءِ
الْحَارِّ وَ ضَعْهُ عَلَى هَامَتِكَ وَ صُبَّ مِنْهُ عَلَى رِجْلَيْكَ وَ إِنْ أَمْكَنَ أَنْ تَبْلَعَ مِنْهُ جُرْعَةً فَافْعَلْ فَإِنَّهُ يُتَقِّي ٱلْمَثَانَةَ وَ
اِلْبَثْ فِي الْبَيْتِ الثَّانِي سَاعَةً وَ إِذَا دَخَلْتَ الْبَيْتَ اَلثَّالِتَ فَقُلْ نَعُوذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ النَّارِ وَ نَسْأْلُهُ الْجَنَّةَ تُرَدِّدُهَا إِلَى وَقْتِ
خُرُوجِكَ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ الْحَارِّ وَ إِيَّاكَ وَ شُرْبَ الْمَاءِ الْبَارِدِ وَ الْفُقَّاعِ فِي الْحَمَّامِ فَإِنَّهُ يُفْسِدُ الْمَعِدَةَ وَ لا تَصُبَّنَّ عَلَيْكَ
اَلْمَاءَ الْبَارِدَ فَإِنَّهُ يُضْعِفُ الْبَدَنَّ وَ صُبَّ الْمَاءَ الْبَارِدَ عَلَى قَدَمَيْكَ إِذَا خَرَجْتَ فَإِنَّهُ يَسُلُّ الدَّاءَ مِنْ جَسَدِكَ فَإِذَا لَبِسْتَ
ثِيَابَكَ فَقُلٍ: اللَّهُمَّ أَلْبِسْنِي التَّقْوَى وَ جَنَّبْنِي الرَّدَى فَإِذَا فَعَلْتَ ذَلِكَ أَمِنْتَ مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ».
ولا بأس بقراءة القرآن في الحمام ما لم ترد به الصوت إذا كان عليك مئزر.
english_text:
Yahya ibn Sa'id Al-Ahwazi narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr,
and him from Muhammad ibn Hamran who reported that Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
When you enter the bathhouse (hammam), at the time you remove your clothes, say:
'O’ Allah {SWT}, remove from me shackles of hypocrisy and establish me firmly on faith.'
And when you enter the first room (of bathhouse), say: 'O’ Allah {SWT}, I seek refuge with
You from the evil of my soul and seek protection from its harm.'"
And when you enter the second room (of bathhouse), say: 'O’ Allah {SWT}, remove
impurity and defilement from me, and purify my body and heart.'
Take some warm water and pour it over your head and pour it over your feet. If you can
drink a sip of it, then do so, as it cleanses the bladder. Remain in second room for a
while.
When you enter the third room (of bathhouse), say:
'We seek refuge in Allah {SWT} from the Fire and ask Him for Paradise,' and repeat it until
the time you leave the hot room (of bathhouse).
Be careful not to drink cold water or consuming ‘fuqqa'a’ (like carbonated drinks) in
the bathhouse, as it harms the stomach.
Do not pour cold water over yourself, as it weakens the body. However, pouring cold
water on your feet when leaving will drive away illness from your body.
When you put on your clothes, say: 'O’ Allah {SWT}, clothe me with piety and protect me
from ruin.' If you do this, you will be safe from all ailments.'
commentary:
There is no harm in reciting the Qur'an in the bathhouse as long as you do not raise
your voice and you are wearing a waistcloth.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Amali (by Al-Saduq) Vol. 1, p. 363 • Al-Waezin, volume 2, page 307 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 52 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 601 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 44 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 70 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 76

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فَقَالَ: أَكَانَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَنْهَى عَنْ قِرَاءَةٍ
الْقُرْآنِ فِي الْحَمَامِ فَقَالَ «لا إِنَّمَا نَهَى أنْ يَقْرَأُ الرَّجُلُ وَ هُوَ عُرْيَانْ فَإِذَا كَانَ عَلَيْهِ إِزَارٌ فَلاَ بَأْسَ.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Muslim asked Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} saying:
'Did Commander of the Faithful {a.s} prohibit recitation of the Qur'an in the bathhouse?'
Imam {a.s} said: 'No, he only prohibited a man from reciting while being naked. If he is
wearing a waistcloth (covering), then there is no harm.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 52

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ يَقْطِينٍ لِمُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: أَقْرَأْ فِي الْحَمَّامِ وَ أَنْكِحُ فِيهِ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ.
ويجب على الرجل أن يغض بصره ويستر فرجه من أن ينظر إليه.
english_text:
Ali ibn Yaqtin said to Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s}:
'May I recite (in the bathhouse) and marry (perform a marriage contract) there?'
Imam {a.s} said: 'There is no harm.'
commentary:
A man must lower his gaze and cover his private parts to prevent others from looking
at them (in bathhouse).
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, V.1, p. 53 • Bihar Al Anwar, V.73, p.

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَ سُئِلَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: « قُلْ لِلْمُوْمِنِينَ يَغَضُّوا مِنْ أَبْصَارِهِمْ وَ يَحْفَظُوا
فُرُوجَهُمْ ذَلِكَ أَزْكى لَهُمْ » فَقَالَ «كُلُ مَا كَانَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى مِنْ ذِكْرٍ حِفْظِ الْفَرْجِ فَهُوَ مِنَ الزَّنَا إِلاَّ فِي
هَذَا الْمَوْضِعِ فَإِنَّهُ لِلْحِفْظِ مِنْ أَنْ يُنْظَرَ إِلَيْهِ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about the saying of Allah
{SWT}, the Exalted: "Tell the believing men to lower their gaze and guard their private
parts; that is purer for them." (Surah An-Nur, 24:30).
Imam {a.s} said: 'Every mention of guarding the private parts in the Book of Allah {SWT}, the
Exalted, refers to guarding against fornication, except in this instance, where it refers
to guarding them from being looked at.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 595 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 300 • Al-Fusul al-Muhimmah, Part 1, p. 696

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيّ عَنِ الصَّادِقِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنْهُ قَالَ - «إِنَّمَا أَكْرَهُ النَّظَرَ إِلَى عَوْرَةِ ٱلْمُسْلِمِ فَأَمَّا النَّظَرُ إِلَى عَوْرَةِ مَنْ
لَيْسَ بِمُسْلِمٍ مِثْلُ النَّظَرِ إِلَى عَوْرَةِ الْحِمَارِ.
english_text:
On the authority of Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that He said:
"Indeed, looking at the private parts of a Muslim is disliked, and looking at the private
parts of a non-Muslim is like looking at the private parts of a donkey."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 56 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 596 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 36 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 80 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 101, p. 42 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Part 1, p. 378

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «نِعْمَ الْبَيْثُ الْحَمَّامُ تُذَكِّرُ فِيهِ النَّارُ وَ يَذْهَبُ بِالدَّرَنِ.
english_text:
The Commander of the Faithful {a.s} said: 'What a good place the bathhouse is,
where one is reminded of the Fire (Hellfire) and it removes filth.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, v.1, p. 53 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 2, p.

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «بِئْسَ اَلْبَيْتُ اَلْحَمَّامُ يَهْتِكُ السِّثْرَ وَ يَذْهَبُ بِالْحَيَاءِ.
english_text:
Imam {a.s} said: 'The bathhouse is an undesirable place; it removes coverings
(privacy) and takes away modesty.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 53 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 591 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 2, p. 30

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَ: «بِئسَ اَلْبَيْتُ اَلْحَمَّامُ يَهْتِكُ السِّثْرَ وَ يُبْدِي الْعَوْرَةَ وَ نِعْمَ الْبَيْتُ اَلْحَمَّامُ يُذَكَّرُ حَرَّ اَلنَّارِ.
ومن الآداب: أن لا يدخل الرجل ولده معه الحمام فينظر إلى عورته.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: 'The bathhouse is an undesirable
place; it removes coverings (privacy) and exposes the private parts.
However, it is a good place as it reminds one of the heats of the Fire (Hellfire).'.
commentary:
Among the etiquettes: a man should not enter the bathhouse with his child if it would
lead to the child seeing his private parts.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 591 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 2, p. 30

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: « «مَنْ كَانَ يُوْمِنُ بِاللهِ وَ الْيَوْمِ الْآجِرِ» فَلا يَبْعَثْ بِحَلِيلَتِهِ إِلَى
اَلْحَمَّامٍ.
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said: "Whoever believes in Allah {SWT} and the Last
Day (Qiyamah) should not send his wife to the bathhouse."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 53 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 49

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «مَنْ أَطَاعَ إِمْرَأَتَهُ أَكَبَّهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى مَنْخِرَيْهِ فِي النَّارِ » فَقِيلَ وَ مَا تِلْكَ الطَّاعَةُ قَالَ
«تَدْعُوهُ إِلَى النِّيَاحَاتِ وَ الْعُرُسَاتِ وَ الْحَمَامَاتِ وَ لُبْسِ التِّيَابِ الرِّقَاقِ فَيُجِيبُهَا.
english_text:
Imam {a.s} said:
'Whoever obeys his wife (in matters of disobedience) will be thrown by Allah {SWT}, the
Exalted, on his face in the Fire.'
It was said: 'What kind of obedience is that?'
Imam {a.s} said:
"When She invites him to go to congregation of lamentations to extravagant festivities
(weddings), or going to public bathhouses, and or to wear delicate (thin/revealing)
clothing; and he approves it for her."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 593 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 49

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ أَبُو بَصِيرٍ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَدَعُ غُسْلَ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ نَاسِياً أَوْ مُتَعَمِّداً فَقَالَ «إِذَا
كَانَ نَاسِياً فَقَدْ تَمَّتْ صَلاَتُهُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مُتَعَمَّداً فَلْيَسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ وَ لاَ يَعْذْ.
english_text:
Abu Basir asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man who
neglects the Jumu’ah ritual bath (ghusl) either forgetfully or intentionally.
Imam {a.s} said: 'If he was forgetful, his prayer is valid. But if he did so intentionally, then
he should seek forgiveness from Allah {SWT} and not repeat it.’
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: «لا تَتَكِ فِي الْحَمَّامِ فَإِنَّهُ يُذِيبُ شَحْمَ اَلْكُلْيَتَيْنِ وَ لا تُسَرَّحْ فِي الْحَمَّامِ فَإِنَّهُ
يُرَفَّقُ الشَّعْرَ وَ لَا تَغْسِلْ رَأْسَكَ بِالطّينِ فَإِنَّهُ يُسَمَّجُ الْوَجْهَ» وَ فِي حَدِيثٍ آخَرَ «يَذْهَبُ بِالْغَيْرَةِ وَ لا تَدَلَّكْ بِالْخَزَفِ
فَإِنَّهُ يُورِثُ اَلْبَرَصَ وَ لا تَمْسَحْ وَجْهَكَ بِالْإِزَارِ فَإِنَّهُ يَذْهَبُ بِمَاءِ الْوَجْهِ. وَ رُوِيَ «أَنَّ ذَلِكَ طِينُ مِصْرَ وَ خَزَفُ الشَّامِ.
والسواك في الحمام يورث وباء الأسنان. ولا يجوز التطهير والغسل بغسالة الحمام.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
'Do not recline in the bathhouse, for it melts the fat around the kidneys.
Do not comb your hair in the bathhouse, for it weakens the hair.
Do not wash your head with clay, for it disfigures the face,' and in another narration, 'it
removes protective modesty (ghayrah).
Do not scrub with pottery shards (khuzfah), for it causes leprosy,
Do not wipe your face with the izar (waistcloth), for it removes the glamour of the face.
And it is narrated that this refers to the clay of Egypt and the khuzfah (pottery) of
Sham."
commentary:
Using a toothstick (siwak) in the bathhouse causes tooth decay.
And it is not permissible to perform purification (taharah) and washing with water that
has been used in the bathhouse.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 501 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 603 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 45

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ: «لِيَتَزَيَّنَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَ يَعْتَسِلُ وَ يَتَطَيَّبُ وَ يَتَسَرَّحُ وَ يَلْبَسُ أَنظَفَ
ثِيَابِهِ وَ لَيَتَهَيَّا لِلْجُمُعَةِ وَ لَيَكُنْ عَلَيْهِ فِي ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ السَّكِينَةُ وَ الْوَقَارُ وَ لَيُحْسِنْ عِبَادَةَ رَبِّهِ وَ لَيَفْعَلِ الْخَيْرَ مَا
اِسْتَطَاعَ فَإِنَّ اللّهَ جَلَّ ذِكْرُهُ يَطَّلِعُ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ لِيُضَاعِفَ اَلْحَسَنَاتِ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
'Let each of you adorn himself on Jumu’ah; perform the ritual bath (ghusl), apply
perfume, comb your hair, and wear your cleanest clothes.
He should prepare for Jumu’ah and embody tranquility and dignity on that day.
He should enhance worship your Lord {AZJ} excellently and do as much good as you can,
for surely Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, looks upon the earth to multiply the good deeds (on
Jumu’ah)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَ: «لَا تَدْخُلُوا الْحَمَّامَ عَلَى الرِّيقِ وَ لا تَدْخُلُوهُ حَتَّى تَطْعَمُوا شَيْئاً.
english_text:
Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} said: 'Do not enter the
bathhouse on an empty stomach, and do not enter it until you have eaten something.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 53 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 4, p. 12 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 608 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 52 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 77

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: خَرَجَ ٱلصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ مِنَ الْحَمَّامِ فَلَبِسَ وَ تَعَمَّمَ قَالَ «فَمَا تَرَكْتُ ٱلْعِمَامَةَ عِنْدَ خُرُوجِي
مِنَ اَلْحَمَّامِ فِي الشَّتَاءِ وَ اَلصَّيْفِ.
english_text:
Some have narrated: "Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} exited the
bathhouse, dressed, and wrapped a turban upon his head.
Imam {a.s} said: 'I never leave off wearing a turban upon exiting the bathhouse, whether
in winter or summer.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 53

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَ: «الْحَمَّامُ يَوْمٌ وَ يَوْمٌ لا يُكْثِرُ اللَّحْمَ وَ إِدْمَانُهُ كُلَّ يَوْمِ يُذْهِبُ شَحْمَ اَلْكُلْيَتَيْنِ.
english_text:
Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} said: 'Bathing in the bathhouse every other
day does not increase fat. However, using it daily will deplete the fat of the kidneys.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 496 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 53 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 607 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 2, p. 31 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 78

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَ كَانَ الصَّادِقُ عَ يَطَلِي فِي الْحَمَّامِ فَإِذَا بَلَغَ مَوْضِعَ ٱلْعَوْرَةِ قَالَ لِلّذِي يَطْلِي تَنَحَ ثُمَّ يَظلِي هُوَ ذَلِكَ ٱلْمَوْضِعَ.
ومن اطلى فلا بأس أن يلقي الستر عنه لان النورة سترة.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} would apply Nuura (depilatory paste)
in the bathhouse, and when he reached the area of the private parts, he would instruct
the one applying it to move away, and then he would apply it himself to that area.
commentary:
And for those who use Nuura (depilatory paste), there is no issue in removing the
covering from oneself because Nuura itself serves as a form of covering.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 598 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 68

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَ دَخَلَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ الْحَمَّامَ فَقَالَ لَهُ صَاحِبُ الْحَمَّامِ نُخْلِيهِ لَكَ فَقَالَ «لا إِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ خَفِيفُ
اَلْمَثُونَةً.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} entered the bathhouse, the bathhouse
attendant offered to clear it for him.
Imam {a.s} said: 'No, a believer is light in their burdens.’
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 57

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُرَافِقِيّ قَالَ: دَخَلْتُ حَمَّاماً بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَإِذَا شَيْخٌ كَبِيرٌ وَ هُوَ قَيِّمُ ٱلْحَمَّامِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ يَا
شَيْخُ لِمَنْ هَذَا الْحَمَّامُ فَقَالَ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فَقُلْتُ أَكَانَ يَدْخُلُهُ قَالَ نَعَمْ فَقُلْتُ كَيْفَ كَانَ
يَصْنَعُ قَالَ كَانَ يَدْخُلُ فَيَبْدَأُ فَيَطْلِي عَانَتَهُ وَ مَا يَلِيهَا ثُمَّ يَلْفُ إِزَارَهُ عَلَى أَطْرَافِ إِحْلِيلِهِ وَ يَدْعُونِي فَأَظِلِي سَائِرَ
جَسَدِهِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ يَوْماً مِنَ الْأَيَّامِ الَّذِي تَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَرَاهُ قَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ قَالَ «كَلاً إِنَّ النُورَةَ سُثْرَةً.
english_text:
It was narrated by Ubaidullah Al-Marafiqi that he entered a bathhouse in
Medina and saw an elderly man who was the caretaker of the bathhouse.
(Al-Marafiqi) said to him: ‘O’ Shaykh, 'To whom does this bathhouse belong?'
(Old man) said: ‘It belongs to Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}’
(Al-Marafiqi) asked: 'Did he use to come here?'
(Old man) replied: 'Yes.'
So (Al-Marafiqi) asked: ‘And what does He do (in the bathhouse)?’
(Old man) said: 'He would enter and first anoint the area around his private parts and
what was near it. Then, he would wrap his waistcloth (izar) around the edges of his
private area and call me to anoint the rest of his body." One day, I said to him, "What
you would dislike for me to see, I have already seen.'
Imam {a.s} said: 'Not at all; the Nuura (depilatory paste) is a form of covering.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 497 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 597 • Awalim al-Ulum, Vol. 19, p. 237

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ ٱلْمَعْرُوفُ بِسَعْدَانَ: كُنْتُ فِي الْحَمَّامِ فِي الْبَيْتِ الْأَوْسَطِ فَدَخَلَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ
مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَ عَلَيْهِ إِزَارٌ قَوْقَ النُّورَةِ فَقَالَ «السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ» فَرَدَدْتُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمَ وَ دَخَلْتُ الْبَيْتَ
الّذِي فِيهِ الْحَوْضُ فَاغْتَسَلْتُ وَ خَرَجْتُ.
وفي هذا إطلاق في التسليم في الحمام لمن عليه مئزر، والنهي الوارد عن التسليم فيه هو لمن لا مئزر عليه.
english_text:
Abdur Rahman ibn Muslim, known as Sa'dan, said:
"I was in the middle room of the bathhouse when Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar
Al-Kadhim {a.s} entered, wearing a cloth over the Nuura (depilatory paste)."
Imam {a.s} said: 'Peace be upon you,'
I returned the greeting also. Then I entered the room with the basin, performed
ablution, and left.
commentary:
This narration indicates that greeting with 'peace' is permissible in a bathhouse for
someone who is appropriately covered. However, it is discouraged to greet in such
settings if one is not covered.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 53 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 78

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى حَنَانُ بْنُ سَدِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: دَخَلْتُ أَنَا وَ أَبِي وَ جَدِّي وَ عَمِّي حَمَّاماً فِي اَلْمَدِينَةِ فَإِذَا رَجُلٌ فِي
بَيْتِ الْمَسْلَخِ فَقَالَ لَنَا مِمَّنِ الْقَوْمُ فَقُلْنَا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِرَاقِ فَقَالَ وَ أَيْ الْعِرَاقِ فَقُلْنَا الْكُوفِيُونَ فَقَالَ «مَرْحَباً بِكُمْ يَا
أَهلَ الْكُوفَةِ وَ أَهْلا أَنْثُمُ الشَّعَارُ دُونَ الدِّثَارِ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «وَ مَا يَمْنَعْكُمْ مِنَ الْإِزَارِ » فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ
آلِهِ قَالَ «عَوْرَةُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِ حَرَامٌ» قَالَ فَبَعَثَ عَمِّي إِلَى كِرْبَاسَةٍ فَشَقَّهَا بِأَرْبَعَةٍ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنَّا
وَاجِداً ثُمَّ دَخَلْنَا فِيهَا فَلَمَّا كُنَّا فِي اَلْبَيْتِ الْحَارّ صَمَدَ لِجَدِّي فَقَالَ «يَا كَهْلُ مَا يَمْنَعْكَ مِنَ الْخِضَابِ» فَقَالَ لَهُ جَدِي
أَذرَكْتُ مَنْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنَّي وَ مِنْكَ لاَ يَخْتَصِبُ فَقَالَ »وَ مَنْ ذَاكَ الّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنَّي» فَقَالَ أَدْرَكْتُ عَلِيَ بْنَ أَبِي
طَالِبِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ وَ لا يَخْتَصِبُ فَنَكَسَ رَأْسَهُ وَ تَصَابَّ عَرَقاً وَقَالَ «صَدَقْتَ وَ بَرِزْتَ» ثُمّ قَالَ «يَا كَهْلُ إِنْ
تَخْتَضِبْ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَدْ خَضَبَ وَ هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ عَلِيّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ وَ إِنْ تَثَرُك فَلَكَ بِعَلِيّ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أُسْوَةً» قَالَ فَلَمَا خَرَجْنَا مِنَ الْحَمَّامِ سَأَلنَا عَنِ الرَّجُلِ فِي الْمَسْلَخِ فَإِذَا هُوَ عَلِيْ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ وَ مَعَهُ
اِبْتُهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ.
وفي هذا الخبر إطلاق للامام أن يدخل ولده معه الحمام دون من ليس بإمام وذلك أن الامام معصوم في صغره وكبر لا
يقع منه النظر إلى عورة في الحمام ولا غيره.
english_text:
Hanan ibn Sudayr narrated from his father:
He said: 'I entered a bathhouse in Medina with my father, grandfather, and uncle.
There was a man in the changing room.’
Imam {a.s} said: ”Where are you people from?" We replied: ”From the people of Al-Iraq”.
Imam {a.s} said: ”Which part of Al-Iraq?” We replied: ”From Al-Kufa”.
Imam {a.s} said: ”Welcome, O’ people of Kufa, you are the closest to us.”
Then He {a.s} said: ”Why are you not wearing a covering (waistcloth)? For Messenger of
Allah {saws} has said that 'The private parts of a believer are forbidden for another
believer to see.'"
My uncle then sent for a piece of cloth, cut it into four pieces, and each of us took one
before we entered (bathhouse). When we entered into the warm room (of bathhouse),
CLEANLINESS AND BEAUTIFICATION
the man turned to my grandfather and said: "O’ elderly man, why do you not use henna
(dye)?"
My grandfather said: "I have seen someone better than you and me who did not use
it."
Imam {a.s} said: "And Who is better than me?"
My grandfather replied: “I saw (Imam {a.s}) Ali ibn Abi Talib and he did not dye his hair."
He {a.s} lowered his head and sweat fell from him, and said: “You have spoken truth and
sincere.
Then Imam {a.s} said: "O’ elderly man, if you dye your hair, the Messenger of Allah {saws}
also dyed his hair, and He {saws} is better than (Imam {a.s}) Ali. And if you choose not to
dye, then you have Sunnah of (Imam {a.s}) Ali as an example."
When we left the bathhouse, we asked about the man in the room, and it was told they
are Imam Ali ibn Al-Hussain {a.s}, with his son Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}.”
commentary:
In this hadith, it is stated that a Holy Imam is allowed to take his son with him to the
bathhouse, unlike everyone else who are not Imams {a.s}. This is because the Imams
are infallible both in their youth and in their old age, and they do not gaze upon the
nakedness in bathhouse or elsewhere.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 497 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 639 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 46, p. 141 • Awalim al-Ulum, Vol. 18, p. 290

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «اَلْفَخِذُ لَيْسَ مِنَ ٱلْعَوْرَةِ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
'The thigh is not considered part of the 'awrah (private parts).'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 56 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 599 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 2, p. 35 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 80 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 101, p. 42

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «النُّورَةُ طَهُورٌ.
english_text:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"Nuura (depilatory paste) is a purifier."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 505 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 14 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 613 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 64

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «أَلْقُوا الشَّعْرَ عَنْكُمْ فَإِنَهُ يُحَسِّنُ.
english_text:
Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} said:
'Remove the hair from your bodies, for it enhances (your appearance).'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 505 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 376 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 62 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 70 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 620 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 104 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 83 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 93

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: «مَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَتَنَوَّرَ فَلْيَأْخُذْ مِنَ النُورَةِ وَ يَجْعَلُهُ عَلَى طَرَفِ أَنْفِهِ وَ يَقُولُ: اللَّهُمَّ
اِرْحَمْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ دَاوُدَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ كَمَا أَمَرَنَا بِالنُّورَةِ فَإِنَّهُ لا تُحْرِقُهُ النُّورَةُ إِنْ شَاءَ اَللهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ.»
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Whoever wishes to use Nuura
(depilatory paste), let him take some of it and place it on the tip of his nose and say:
Allāhumma irḥam Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd ‘alayhi al-salām kamā amarānā bil-nūrah
'O’ Allah {SWT}, have mercy on Solomon, son of David {a.s}, as he instructed us regarding
the depilatory paste (Nuura).'
If Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, wills, the paste will not cause him any harm.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 61 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 621 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 92

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّ مَنْ جَلَسَ وَ هُوَ مُتَنَوِّرْ خِيفَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْفَثْقُ.
english_text:
It was narrated that "Whoever sits while applying Nuura (depilatory paste), he
is at risk of developing a hernia."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 62 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 624 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 1, p. 352 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 78 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 92

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «أُجِبُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ أَنْ يَطْلِيَ فِي كُلِّ خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ يَوْماً.
english_text:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"I like for a believer to use Nuura (depilatory paste) every fifteen days."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 506 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 615 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 71 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 2, p. 72

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: «السُّنَّةُ فِي النُّورَةِ فِي كُلِّ خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ يَوْماً فَإِنْ أَنَتْ عَلَيْكَ عِشَرُونَ يَوْماً وَ
لَيْسَ عِنْدَكَ فَاسْتَقْرِضْ عَلَى اللهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ.
english_text:
Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "The practice (sunnah) for using Nuura (depilatory
paste) is every fifteen days. If twenty days pass without using it and you lack it, then
borrow for the sake of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 506 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 375 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 616 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 71 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 71

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: « «مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللهِ وَ الْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ» فَلاَ يَثْرُك عَانَتَهُ فَوْقَ أَرْبَعِينَ
يَوْماً وَ لاَ يَجِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللهِ وَ ٱلْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ أَنْ تَدَعَ ذَلِكَ مِنْهَا فَوْقَ عِشْرِينَ يَوْماً.
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said: "Whoever believes in Allah {SWT} and the Last
Day (Qiyamah) should not leave the hair of their pubic region untrimmed for more than
forty days, and it is not permissible for a woman who believes in Allah {SWT} and the Last
Day (Qiyamah) to leave it untrimmed for more than twenty days."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 506 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 59 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 616 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 139 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 91

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «اِحْلِقُوا شَعْرَ اَلْبَطْنِ لِلذَّكَرِ وَ الْأَنْثَى.
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said: "Shave the abdomen hair for both males and
females." (And in another version, it includes armpit hair).
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 59

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَ كَانَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَطْلِي إِبْطَيْهِ فِي الْحَمَّامِ وَ يَقُولُ «نَثْفُ ٱلْإِبْطِ يُضْعِفُ ٱلْمَنْكِبَيْنِ وَ يُوهِي وَ
يُضْعِفُ الْبَصَّرَ.
english_text:
And Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} would rub Nuura (depilatory
paste) to his armpits in the bathhouse and say: 'Plucking the armpit hair weakens the
shoulders and diminishes (weakens) the eyesight.'"
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 619 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 138

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «حَلْقُهُ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ نَثْفِهِ وَ طَلْيُهُ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ حَلْقِهِ.»
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Shaving (unwanted hair) is
better than plucking them and using Nuura (depilatory paste) is better than shaving
them."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 60 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 619 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 138

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ عَلِيْ عَ: «نَتْفُ الْإِبْطِ يَنْفِي الرَّائِحَةَ ٱلْمَكْرُوهَةَ وَ هُوَ طَهُورٌ وَ سُنَّةٌ مِمَّا أَمَرَ بِهِ الطَّيِّبُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
السَّلامُ.
english_text:
Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said: "Removing armpit hair eliminates unpleasant
odors and is a means of purification and a practice (Sunnah) that was commanded by
the Good and Pure Prophet {saws}."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 136

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «لاَ يُطَوِّلَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ شَعْرَ إِبْطَيْهِ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَتَّخِذُهُ مِجَنّاً يَسْتَتِرُ
بِهِ.
والجنب لا بأس بأن يطلي فإن النورة تزيده نظافة.
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said: 'None of you should allow the hair under his
armpits to grow long, for the devil takes it as a shield to hide behind.'
commentary:
And it is permissible for the one in a state of major impurity to apply it, as the Nuura
(depilatory paste) increases cleanliness.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 619

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «يَنْبَغِي لِلرَّجُلِ أَنْ يَتَوَقَّى النُّورَةَ يَوْمَ الْأَرْبِعَاءِ
' فَإِنَّهُ يَوْمُ نَحْسِ مُسْتَمِرِّ وَ يَجُوزُ النُورَةُ فِي سَائِرِ الْأَيَّامِ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
‘A man should avoid the use of Nuura (depilatory paste) on Wednesday, for it is a day
of continuous ill-omen, but otherwise the use of Nuura is permissible on all other
days.’"
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 623 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 80 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 7, p. 367

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّهَا فِي يَوْمِ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ تُورِثُ الْبَرَصَ.
english_text:
(Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Farisi Al-Fattal narrates from Messenger of Allah {saws} ):
“Applying Nuura (depilatory paste) on Jumu’ah, it is said that it can lead to leprosy."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى الرَّيَّانُ بْنُ الصِّلْتِ عَمّنْ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ - «مَنْ تَنَوَّرَ يَوْمَ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ فَأَصَابَهُ
اَلْبَرَصُ فَلاَ يَلَومَنَّ إِلاَّ نَفْسَهُ.
ولا باس بأن يتدلك الرجل فى الحمام بالسويق والدقيق والنخالة، ولا بأس بأن يتدلك بالدقيق الملتوت بالزيت، وليس فيما
ينفع البدن إسراف، إنما الاسراف فيما أتلف المال وأضر بالبدن.
english_text:
Al-Rayyan ibn Al-Salt narrated from someone, who narrated from Abu Al-
Hasan, Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s}, said:
"Whoever puts on Nuura (depilatory paste) on Jumu’ah and is afflicted with leprosy,
let him blame no one but himself."
commentary:
It is permissible for a man to use flour-based mixtures, oil-based pastes, or other
natural exfoliants for personal care in the hammam (public bathhouse).
There is no overindulgence in what benefits the body; rather, overindulgence lies in
what wastes money and harms the body.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 62 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 623 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 7, p. 367 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 92

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «مَنِ اِطَّلَى وَ اِخْتَضَبَ بِالْحِنَّاءِ آمَنَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى مِنْ ثَلاَثِ خِصَالٍ
الْجُذَامٍ وَ الْبَرَصِ وَ الْآَكِلَةِ إِلَى طَلْيَةٍ مِثْلِهَا.
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"Whoever applies depilatory substances (to remove body hair) and dyes with henna,
Allah {SWT}, the Most High, protects him from three things: leprosy, vitiligo (a skin
disorder), and ‘al-ākilah’ (a type of skin disease or severe wound infection) until the
next time he applies it."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al-A’mal, Part 1, p. 21 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 62 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 62 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 4, p. 14 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 628 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 2, p. 73 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 74 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 90 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 92

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «الْجِنَّاءُ عَلَى أَثَّرِ النُّورَةِ أَمَانُ مِنَ الْجُذَامِ وَ ٱَلْبَرَصِ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Applying henna after the use of
Nuura (depilatory paste) is a protection against leprosy and vitiligo."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 62 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 628 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 74 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 92

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّ مَنِ اِطَّلَى وَ تَدَلَّكَ بِالْحِنَّاءِ مِنْ قَرْنِهِ إِلَى قَدَمِهِ نَفَى اللَّهُ عَنْهُ ٱلْفَقْرَ.
english_text:
It is narrated (from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah) that he narrates:
"Whoever applies a depilatory substance and massages himself with henna from head
to toe, Allah {SWT} removes poverty from him."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 74

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «اِخْتَصِبُوا بِالْحِنَّاءِ فَإِنَّهُ يَجْلُو الْبَصَرَ وَ يُنْبِتُ الشَّعْرَ وَ يُطَيِّبُ الرِّيحَ
وَ يُسَكّنُ الزَّوْجَةَ»
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said: "Dye with henna, for it improves eyesight,
promotes hair growth, gives a pleasant fragrance, and calms the wife”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 483 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 78 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 640 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 95 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 99

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «الْجِنَّاءُ يَذْهَبُ بِالسَّهَكِ وَ يَزِيدُ فِي مَاءِ الْوَجْهِ وَ يُطَيّبُ النَّكُهَةَ وَ يُحَسِّنُ ٱلْوَلَدَ.
ولا بأس أن يمس الرجل الخلوق في الحمام، ويمسح به يده من شقاق يداويه ، ولا يستحب إدمانه، ولا أن يرى أثره عليه.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Henna removes the odors,
increases radiance in the face, improves breath, and beautifies one's offspring."
commentary:
There is no issue if a man applies perfumed ointment in the bathhouse and rubs his
hand with it to treat cracks, but it is not recommended to make it a habit or for the
effect to be seen on him consistently.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 484 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 78 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 641 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 95 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 99

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «الْخِضَابُ هَذيُ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ هُوَ مِنَ السُّنَّةِ.
english_text:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"Dyeing (the hair or beard) is the tradition of Muhammad {saws} and it is part of the
Sunnah."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 78 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 643 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 83 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 99

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «لاَ بَأْسَ بِالْخِضَابِ كُلَّهِ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"There is no harm in any kind of dyeing."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 78 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 644 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 77 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 83 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 99

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَ دَخَلَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ الْجَهْمِ عَلَى أَبِي الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: وَ قَدِ اِخْتَضَبَ بِالسَّوَادِ فَقَالَ
«إِنَّ فِي الْخِضَابِ أَجْراً وَ الْخِضَابُ وَ التَّهْيِئَةُ مِمَّا يَزِيدُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فِي عِفَّةِ النَّسَاءِ وَ لَقَدْ تَرَكَتْ نِسَاءُ الْعِفَّةَ
بِتَرْكِ أَزْوَاجِهِنَّ التَّهْيِئَةَ» فَقَالَ لَهُ بَلَغَنَا أَنْ الْجِنَّاءَ تَزِيدُ فِي الشَّيْبِ فَقَالَ «أَيُ شَيْءٍ يَزِيدُ فِي الشَّيْبِ وَ الشَّيْبُ
يَزِيدُ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ»
english_text:
Al-Hasan ibn al-Jahm entered upon Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-
Kadhim {a.s} who had dyed his hair with black dye.
Imam {a.s} said: "Indeed, there is a reward in dyeing.
Dyeing and grooming are among those things which increase the chastity of women,
and some women have abandoned chastity because their husbands have neglected
grooming themselves."
(ibn Al-Jahm) replied to Him: "We have heard that henna increases grey hair?”
Imam {a.s} said: “What increases grey hair? Grey hair increases every day."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: عَنِ الْخِضَابِ فَقَالَ «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
يَخْتَصِبُ وَ هَذَا شَعْرُهُ عِنْدَنَا.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Muslim asked Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} about
dyeing the hair, and He said:
"The Messenger of Allah {saws} used to dye, and we still have some of his hair with us."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 84 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 103

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنّهُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ كَانَ فِي رَأْسِهِ وَ لِحْيَتِهِ سَبْعَ عَشَرَةَ شَيْبَةً.
english_text:
It is reported that The Prophet {saws} had seventeen gray hairs in his head and
beard.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَ كَانَ النَّبِيُ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ وَ أَبُو جَعْفَرِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ يَخْتَصِبُونَ
بِالْكَتَمِ.
english_text:
The Prophet, Imam Hussain ibn Ali {a.s} and Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir
{a.s} used to dye their hair with katam (a plant-based dye often used in combination with
henna to produce a darker color).
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 122 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 644 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 92

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَكَانَ عَلِيْ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ يَخْتَصِبُ بِالْحِنَّاءِ وَ الْكَتَمِ.
english_text:
And Imam Ali ibn Al-Hussain {a.s} used to dye his hair with both henna and Al-
Katam (plant-based black)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ: «الْخِضَابُ بِالسَّوَادِ أُنْسٌ لِلنِّسَاءِ وَ مَهَابَةٌ لِلْعَدُوِّ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Dyeing (the hair or beard) with
black brings comfort to women and inspires awe in enemies."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 483 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 122 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 80 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 4, p. 14 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 642 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 89 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 100

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: فِي قَوْلِ اللّهِ تَعَالَى «® وَأَعِدُوا لَهُمْ مَا اِسْتَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ قُوَّةِ » قَالَ «مِنْهُ اَلْخِضَابُ
بِالسِّوَادِ وَ إِنَّ رَجُلاً دَخَلَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ قَدْ صَفَّرَ لِحْيَتَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ
عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ «مَا أَحْسَنَ هَذَا» ثُمَّ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ بَعْدَ هَذَا وَ قَدْ أَقْنَى بِالْحِنَّاءِ فَتَبَسَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
وَقَالَ «هَذَا أَحْسَنُ مِنْ ذَاكَ» ثُمَّ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ وَ قَدْ خَضَبَ بِالسَّوَادِ فَضَحِكَ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ «هَذَا أَحْسَنُ مِنْ ذَاكَ
وَ ذَاكَ».
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} commented on the verse of Allah {SWT},
the Exalted, "And prepare for them whatever force you can muster"
(Surah Al-Anfal; 8:60).
Imam {a.s} said: "Among it is dyeing with black”.
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} narrated;
“A man entered upon the Messenger of Allah {saws} with his beard dyed yellow (light
color), and the Messenger of Allah {saws} said to him, "How good this is."
Then he entered again after that with his beard dyed with henna (reddish color), and
the Messenger of Allah {saws} smiled and said: "This is better than the previous."
Then he entered again after having dyed it black, and the Prophet smiled and said:
"This is better than both of the previous”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 123 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 643

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: «لا يَنْبَغِي لِلْمَرْأَةِ أَنْ تُعَطَّلَ نَفْسَهَا وَ لَوْ أَنْ تُعَلَّقَ فِي عُنْقِهَا قِلاَدَةً وَ لا يَنْبَغِي
لَهَا أَنْ تَدَعَ يَدَهَا مِنَ الْخِضَابِ وَ لَوْ أَنْ تَمْسَحَهَا بِالْحِنَّاءِ مَسْحاً وَ إِنْ كَانَتْ مُسِنَّةً.
english_text:
Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "A woman should not neglect herself, even if it means
wearing a necklace around her neck, Nor should She leave her hands without dyeing,
even if it is by lightly applying henna, even if She is elderly."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 5, p. 509 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 123 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 645 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 22, p. 858 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 97 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’a, vol. 4, p. 459 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 20, p. 166

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرِ الْبَاقِرُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «إِنَّ الْأَظَافِيرَ إِذَا أَصَابَثْهَا النُورَةُ غَيَّرَتْهَا حَتَّى أَنَّهَا تُشْبِهُ أَظَافِيرَ ٱلْمَوْتَى
فَلاَ بَأْسَ بِتَغْيِيرِهَا.
وقد خضب الأئمة عليهم السلام بالوسمة، والخضاب بالصفرة خضاب الايمان، والاقناء خضاب الاسلام وبالسواد إسلام
وإيمان ونور.
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"When nails are affected by Nuura (depilatory paste), they can change their
appearance, such that they may resemble the nails of the deceased. Therefore, there
is no harm in changing (their appearance)."
commentary:
The Imams have used wasmah (a natural dye), and dyeing with yellow (or light colors)
is considered the dye of faith. Dyeing dark is the dye of Islam, and dyeing with black is
both Islam, faith, and light.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 123 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 645 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p.

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ لِعَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «يَا عَلِيُّ دِرْهَمْ فِي الْخِضَابِ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ أَلْفِ
دِرْهَمِ فِي غَيْرِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ فِيهِ أَرْبَعَ عَشَرَةَ خَصْلَةً يَطْرُدُ الرِّيحَ مِنَ ٱلْأَذُنَيْنِ وَ يَجْلُو الْبَصَرَ وَ يُلَيِّنُ
اَلْخَيَاشِيمَ وَ يُطَيِّبُ النَّكْهَةَ وَ يَشُدُ اللَّثَةَ وَ يَذْهَبُ بِالضَّنَى وَ يُقِلُ وَسْوَسَةَ الشَّيْطَانِ وَ تَفْرَحُ بِهِ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ وَ يَسْتَبْشِرُ
بِهِ الْمُؤْمِنُ وَ يَغِيظُ بِهِ الْكَافِرَ وَ هُوَ زِينَةٌ وَ طِيبٌ وَ يَسْتَجِي مِنْهُ مُنكَرْ وَ نَكِيرٌ وَ هُوَ بَرَاءَةٌ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ.
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said to Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s}:
"O’ Ali, spending a dirham on dyeing is better than spending a thousand dirhams in
other paths for the sake of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Glorious. It has fourteen benefits:
it repels odors from the ears, improves eyesight, softens the nostrils, freshens breath,
strengthens the gums, removes ailments, reduces the whispering of Satan, brings joy
CLEANLINESS AND BEAUTIFICATION
to the angels, gladdens the believer, enrages the disbeliever, it is a form of adornment,
a fragrance, it makes Munkar and Nakir (the angels who question the dead in their
graves) feel shy, and it is a source of innocence (purity) in one's grave”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 123 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al-A’mal, Part 1, p. 21 • Al-Khisal, Part 2, p. 497 • Al-Khisal, Part 2, p. 497 • Al-Waezin, volume 2, page 474 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 78 • Aʿlām al-Dīn, Part 1, p. 363 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 97 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 99

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «إِنِّي لَأَحْلِقُ فِي كُلِّ جُمُعَةٍ فِيمَا بَيْنَ الطَّلْيَةِ إِلَى ٱلطَّلْيَةِ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"I indeed shave (the head) every Jumu’ah, from one washing to the next."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 485 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 124 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 648 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 107

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ لِرَجْلٍ: «اِحْلِقْ فَإِنَّهُ يَزِيدُ فِي جَمَالِكَ.
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said to a man:
"Shave (the head) for it enhances your beauty."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «حَلْقُ ٱلرَّاْسِ فِي غَيْرِ حَجِّ وَ لاَ عُمْرَةٍ مُثْلَةٌ لِأَعْدَائِكُمْ وَ جَمَالْ لَكُمْ.
وَ مَعْنَى هَذَا فِي قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: جِينَ وَصَفَ الْخَوَارِجَ فَقَالَ «إِنَّهُمْ يَمْرُقُونَ مِنَ آلدِّينِ كَمَا يَمْرُقُ
السَّهَمُ مِنَ الرَّمِيَّةِ وَ عَلاَمَتُهُمُ التَّسْبِيدُ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Shaving the head outside of Hajj or 'Umrah is a form of humiliation for your enemies
and a source of beauty for you."
The meaning of these words the Prophet became apparent, when He described the
Khawarij, saying:
"They will exit from the religion as an arrow exits from the bow, and their sign is shaving
(the head) completely.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 124 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 2, p. 523 • Al- Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 649 • Al-Wasail al-Shia, Vol. 2, p. 106 • Al-Wasail al-Shia vol. 14 p. 232

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «أَخْذُ ٱلشَّعْرِ مِنَ ٱلْأَنْفِ يُحَسِّنُ ٱلْوَجْهَ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Removing hair from the nose enhances the appearance of the face."
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 488 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 124 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 59 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 4, p. 14 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 660 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 118 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 91 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 109

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ: «غَسْلُ ٱلرَّأْسِ بِالْخِطْمِيّ فِي كُلِّ جُمُعَةِ " أَمَانْ مِنَ ٱلْبَرَصِ وَ ٱلْجُنُونِ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Washing the head with Al-khatmi (a type of herbal shampoo or a plant known as
marshmallow root) every Jumu’ah provides protection from vitiligo and insanity."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 418 • Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 504 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 124 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 236 • Al-Waezin, volume 2, page 307 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 60 • Jamal al-Usbu, Part 1, p. 362 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 631 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’a, vol. 7, p. 354 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 87
