دِرْهَمِ وَ الْكُوفَةُ حَرَمُ اللهِ وَ حَرَمُ رَسُولِهِ وَ حَرَمُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَ الصَّلاَةُ فِيهَا بِألْفِ صَلاَةِ » وَ
سَكَتَ عَنِ الدَّرْهَمِ.
english_text:
Khalid ibn Maad al-Qalanisi narrated from Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} that He said:
"Makkah is the sanctuary of Allah {SWT}, the sanctuary of His Messenger, and the
sanctuary of Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s}. A prayer performed therein is equivalent to one
hundred thousand prayers, and one dirham spent there is equivalent to one hundred
thousand dirhams.
Madinah is the sanctuary of Allah {SWT}, the sanctuary of His Messenger, and the
sanctuary of Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s}. A prayer performed therein is equivalent to ten
thousand prayers, and one dirham spent there is equivalent to ten thousand dirhams.
Kufa is the sanctuary of Allah {SWT}, the sanctuary of His Messenger, and the sanctuary
of Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s}. A prayer performed therein is equivalent to one thousand
prayers." Imam {a.s} remained silent about the dirham (spent there).
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 228 • Al-Mazar Volume 1, page 5 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol. 6, p. 31 • The Great Shrine, Part 1, p. 114 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 256

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى أَبُو حَمْزَةَ التُمَالِيُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنّهُ قَالَ - «مَنْ صَلَّى فِي ٱلْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ صَلاةً
مَكْتُوبَةً قَبِلَ اللهُ بِهَا مِنْهُ كُلَّ صَلاَةٍ صَلاَهَا مُنْذُ يَوْمَ وَجَبَثْ عَلَيْهِ الصَّلاَةُ وَ كُلَّ صَلاَةٍ يُصَلَّيهَا إِلَى أَنْ يَمُوتَ».
english_text:
Abu Hamza al-Thumali narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}
that He said:
"Whoever performs an obligatory prayer in the Sacred Mosque (Masjid al-Haram),
Allah {SWT} accepts it as equivalent to every prayer they have performed since the day
prayer became obligatory upon them, and every prayer they will perform until they
die."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 228 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 12, p. 47 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p.

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «الصَّلاَةُ فِي مَسْجِدِي كَأْلْفِ صَلَاَةٍ فِي غَيْرِهِ إِلاَّا الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ
فَإِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ تَعْدِلُ أَلْفَ صَلاَةٍ فِي مَسْجِدِي.
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"A prayer performed in my mosque (Masjid al-Nabawi) is equivalent to one thousand
prayers in any other mosque, except for the Sacred Mosque (Masjid al-Haram), for a
prayer performed in the Sacred Mosque is equivalent to one thousand prayers
performed in my mosque”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 228 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 12, p. 48 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p.

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ عَبْدُ الْأَعْلَى مَوْلَى آلِ سَامٍ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: كَمْ كَانَ طُولُ مَسْجِدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ
عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَالَ «كَانَ ثَلاَثَةَ آلاَفِ وَ سِتَّمِائَةِ ذِرَاعِ مُكَسَّرَةْ.
english_text:
Abd al-Ala, the freedman of Ale Saam, asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-
Sadiq {a.s} about the dimensions of the Mosque of the Messenger of Allah {saws}.
Imam {a.s} said: "It was three thousand and six hundred cubits, broken up (its measured
parts)”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ لأَبِي حَمْرَةَ التّمَالِيّ: «ٱلْمَسَاجِدُ ٱلْأَرْبَعَةُ ٱلْمَسْجِدُ الْحَرَامُ وَ مَسْجِدُ الرَّسُولِ
صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ مَسْجِدُ بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ وَ مَسْجِدُ الْكُوفَةِ يَا أَبَا حَمْرَةَ الْفَرِيضَةُ فِيهَا تَعْدِلُ حَجَّةً وَ النَّافِلَةُ
تَعْدِلُ عُمْرَةً.
english_text:
Abu Ja'far, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, said to Abu Hamzah al-
Thumali:
"The four (sacred) mosques are:
the Sacred Mosque (Masjid al-Haram),
the Mosque of the Messenger (Masjid al-Nabawi),
the Mosque of Bayt al-Maqdis (Jerusalem),
and the Mosque of Kufa.
O’ Abu Hamzah, performing an obligatory prayer in any of these mosques is equivalent
to performing a pilgrimage (Hajj), and a supererogatory (optional) prayer in them is
equivalent to performing an ‘Umrah (minor pilgrimage)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 229 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 289

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَ سُبِلَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنْ قَبْرِ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ فَقَالَ «دُفِنَتْ فِي بَيْتِهَا فَلَمَّا زَادَتْ بَنُو
أُمَيَّةً فِي الْمَسْجِدِ صَارَثْ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ.
english_text:
Abu Al-Hasan, Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha {a.s} was asked about the grave of
Sayyida Fatimah Al-Zahra {S.A}, and Imam {a.s} said:
"She was buried in her house, but when the Umayyads expanded the mosque, her
grave became part of the mosque."
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 1, p. 461 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 229 • Tasliyat al-Majalis, Part 1, p. 572 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 14, p. 1366 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 97, p. 191

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «مَنْ أَنَّى مَسْجِدِي مَسْجِدَ قُبَا فَصَلَّى فِيهِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ رَجَعَ بِعَمْرَةٍ.
وكان عليه السلام يأتيه فيصلي فيه بأذان وإقامة. ويستحب إتيان المساجد بالمدينة مسجد قبا فإنه المسجد الذي أسس
على التقوى من أول يوم، ومشربة أم إبراهيم، ومسجد الفضيخ، وقبور الشهداء بأحد، ومسجد الأحزاب وهو مسجد الفتح.
ويستحب الصلاة في مسجد الغدير في ميسرة المسجد، فإن ذلك موضع قدم رسول اللّٰه صلى اللّٰه عليه واله حيث قال:
مَنْ كُنْتُ مَوْلاَهُ فَعَلِيٌّ مَوْلَاهُ ٱللَّهُمّ وَالِ مَنْ وَالاَهُ وَ عَادٍ مَنْ عَادَاهُ.
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"Whoever comes to my mosque, the Mosque of Quba, and prays two rak'ahs in it, it is
as if they have performed an ‘Umrah."
commentary:
He {a.s} would go there and pray in it with adhan and iqamah (call to commence prayer).
It is recommended to visit the mosques in Madinah, particularly the Mosque of Quba,
for it is the mosque founded upon piety from the first day. Also recommended are
Mashrabat Umm Ibrahim, the Mosque of al-Fadikh, the graves of the martyrs at Uhud,
and the Mosque of al-Ahzab.
Additionally, it is recommended to pray in the Mosque of Ghadir on the left side, for it
is the place where the Messenger of Allah {saws} stood when He said: 'Whomsoever I am
his master (mawla), Ali is his master. O’ Allah {SWT}, befriend those who befriend him,
and be hostile to those who are hostile to him.'"
references: Kamil al-Ziyarat, Part 1, p. 24 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 229 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 286 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 14, p. 355 • Manaqib of Imam Amir al-Mu'minin {a.s}, Vol. 2, p. 413 • Explanation of the News, Part 1, p. 100 • Explanation of the News, Part 2, p. 102 • Man La Yahduruhu Al- Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 229 • The Mayor, Part 1, p. 109 • Building the Fatimid Article, Part 1, p. 296 • Ithbāt al-Hudāt, Part 3, p. 103 • Ithbāt al-Hudāt, Part 3, p. 248 • Ithbāt al-Hudāt, Part 3, p. 255 • Ithbāt al-Hudāt, Part 3, p.

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَ أَمَّا الْجَانِبُ الْآخَرُ: «فَذَلِكَ مَوْضِعُ فُسْطَاطِ ٱلْمُنَافِقِينَ آلَّذِينَ لَمَّا رَأَوْهُ رَافِعاً يَدَهُ قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضِ أنْظُرُوا
إِلَى عَيْنَيْهِ تَدُورَانٍ كَأَنَّهُمَا عَيْنَا مَجْنُونٍ فَنَزَلَ جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ بِهَذِهِ الْآَيَةِ: « وَ إِنْ يَكَادُ اَلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا
لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصارِهِمْ لَمَا سَمِعُوا الذِّكْرَ وَ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُ لَمَجْنُونْ وَ مَا هُوَ إِلا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ )
أَخْبَرَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ بِذَلِكَ حَسَّانَ الْجَمَّالَ لَمَّا حَمَلَهُ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ إِلَى مَكَّةَ فَقَالَ لَهُ «يَا حَسَّانُ لَوْ لا أَنَّكَ جَمَّالِي
مَا حَدَّثُتُكَ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ.
english_text:
As for the other side (of Mosque of Quba),
"That is the location of the tent of the hypocrites. When they saw him (the Prophet)
raising his hand, some of them said to one another,
'Look at his eyes; they are turning as if he were a madman.'
Then Archangel Jibril {a.s} descended with this verse: 'Indeed, those who disbelieve
would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message and they say,
"He is indeed mad." But it is nothing except a reminder to the worlds.'
(Surah Al-Qalam, 68:51-52)"
Al-Sadiq {a.s} narrated this incident to Hassan al-Jammal when he accompanied him
from Madinah to Makkah.
Imam {a.s} said to him: "O’ Hassan, if you were not my camel driver, I would not have
narrated this story to you."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَ أَمَّا مَسْجِدُ الْخَيْفِ بِمِنَّى فَإِنَّهُ رَوَى جَابِرٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ - «صَلّى فِي مَسْجِدِ الْخَيْفِ
سَبْعُمَائَةً نَبِيّ
english_text:
As for the Mosque of Al-Khayf in Mina, it has been narrated by Jabir from Imam
Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} that He said:
"Seven hundred prophets prayed in the Mosque of al-Khayf."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Volume 1, p. 230 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 14, p. 1266 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 269

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى أَبُو حَمْزَةَ الثُمَالِيُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مَنْ صَلَّى فِي مَسْجِدِ الْخَيْفِ بِمِنِّى مِائَةَ
رَكْعَةٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ مِنْهُ عَدَلَتْ عِبَارَةَ سَبْعِينَ عَاماً وَ مَنْ سَبَّحَ اللهَ فِيهِ مِائَةَ تَسْبِيحَةٍ كَتَبَ اللهُ لَهُ كَأْجَرٍ عِثْقٍ
رَقَبَةٍ وَ مَنْ هَلَّلَ اللّهَ فِيهِ مِائَةَ تَهْلِيلَةٍ عَدَلَتْ أَجْرَ إِحْيَاءِ نَسَمَةٍ وَ مَنْ حَمَّدَ اللَّهَ فِيهِ مِائَةَ تَحْمِيدَةٍ عَدَلَتْ أَجْرَ خَرَاجٍ
الْعِرَاقَيْنِ يُتَصَدَّقُ بِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ
english_text:
Abu Hamza al-Thumali narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}
that He said: "Whoever prays one hundred rak'ahs in the Mosque of al-Khayf in Mina
before leaving it, it is equivalent to the worship of seventy years.
Whoever glorifies (says 'SubhanAllah {SWT}') one hundred times in it, Allah {SWT} records
for them the reward of freeing a slave.
Whoever declares the oneness of Allah {SWT} (says 'La ilaha illa Allah {SWT}') one hundred
times in it, it is equivalent to the reward of reviving a soul.
Whoever praises Allah {SWT} (says 'Alhamdulillah') one hundred times in it, it is as if they
have given in charity the value of the entire wealth of Iraq and its surroundings in the
path of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Volume 1, p. 230 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 14, p. 1266 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 269

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: «كَانَ مَسْجِدُ رَسُولِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ عَلَى عَهْدِهِ عِنْدَ ٱلْمَنَارَةِ الَّتِي فِي
وَسَطِ الْمَسْجِدِ وَ فَوْقُهَا إِلَى الْقِبْلَةِ نَحْواً مِنْ ثَلاَثِينَ ذِرَاعاً وَ عَنْ يَمِينِهَا وَ عَنْ يَسَارِهَا وَ خَلْفِهَا نَحْوْ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَتَحَرَّ
ذَلِكَ وَ إِنِ اِسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ يَكُونَ مُصَلاَكَ فِيهِ فَافْعَلْ فَإِنَّهُ صَلَّى فِيهِ أَلْفُ نَبِيَّ وَ إِنَّمَا سُمِّيَ الْخَيْفَ لِأَنَّهُ مُرْتَفِعْ عَنِ
اَلْوَادِي وَ مَا اِرْتَفَعَ عَنْهُ يُسَمَّى خَيْفاً.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"The Mosque of the Messenger of Allah {saws} during his time extended near the minaret
located at the center of the mosque, and above it towards the Qibla, approximately
thirty cubits, as well as a similar distance to its right, left, and behind. So, focus on this
area, and if you can make your place of prayer within it, then do so, for one thousand
prophets have prayed there. It was called 'al-Khayf' because it is elevated above the
valley, and anything that rises above it is called 'Khayf.'"
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «حَدُّ مَسْجِدِ ٱلْكُوفَةِ آخِرُ السَّرَاجِينَ خَطَّهُ آدَمُ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ وَ أَنَا أَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَدْخُلَهُ
رَاكِباً» قِيلَ لَهُ فَمَنْ غَيَّرَهُ عَنْ خِطَّتِهِ قَالَ «أَمَا أَوْلُ ذَلِكَ فَالطُوفَانْ فِي زَمَنِ نُوحِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلاَمُ ثُمَّ غَيَّرَهُ أَصْحَابُ
كِسْرَى وَ النُعْمَانِ ثُمَّ غَيَّرَهُ زِيَادُ بْنُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"The boundary of the Mosque of Kufa extends to the end of the lamp-makers' area. It
was originally marked by Adam {a.s}, and I dislike entering it while riding."
He was asked: "Who altered its original boundaries?"
Imam {a.s} said: "The first change occurred due to the flood during the time of Noah {a.s},
followed by changes made by the companions of Khosrow (the Persian rulers) and al-
Nu'man, and then later by Ziyad ibn Abi Sufyan."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Volume 1, p. 230 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 14, p. 1444 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 254

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ: «كَأَنِّي أَنظَرُ إِلَى دَيْرَانِيّ فِي مَسْجِدِ الْكُوفَةِ فِي دَيْرٍ لَهُ فِيمَا بَيْنَ ٱلزَّاوِيَةِ وَ الْمِنْبَرِ فِيهِ
سَبْعُ نَخَلاتٍ وَ هُوَ مُشرِفَ مِنْ دَيْرِهِ عَلَى نُوحِ يُكَلَمُهُ.
english_text:
Imam {a.s} said: "It is as if I can see a monk in the Mosque of Kufa, in his
monastery, between the corner and the pulpit, where there are seven date palms,
watching and conversing with Noah {a.s} from his elevated position."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 231 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 14, p. 1444

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ أَبُو بَصِيرٍ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «نِعْمَ ٱلْمَسْجِدُ مَسْجِدُ الْكُوفَةِ صَلَّى فِيهِ أَلْفُ نَبِيَّ
وَأَلْفُ وَصِيَّ وَ مِنْهُ «فَارَ التَّنُورُ» وَ فِيهِ نُجِرَتِ السَّفِينَةُ مَيْمَنَتُهُ رِضْوَانُ اللّهِ وَ وَسَطْهُ رَوْضَةٌ مِنْ رِيَاضِ الْجَنَّةِ وَ
مَيْسَرَتُهُ مَكْرٌ يَعْنِي مَنَازِلَ الشَّيَاطِينِ.
english_text:
Abu Basir said: "I heard Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} say:
"What a blessed mosque is the Mosque of Kufa!
A thousand prophets and a thousand successors (of prophets) have prayed in it.
From it 'the oven gushed forth' (a reference to the flood of Noah). In it, the Ark was built.
Its right side is the Ridwan of Allah {SWT}, its center is a garden from the gardens of
Paradise, and its left side is a place of deceit, meaning the abodes of the devils”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 231 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al-A’mal, Part 1, p. 30

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «لا تُشَدُ ٱلرِّحَالُ إِلاَّ إِلَى ثَلاَثَةٍ مَسَاجِدَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَ مَسْجِدِ رَسُولٍ
اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ مَسْجِدِ الْكُوفَةِ.
english_text:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"Journeys should not be undertaken except to three mosques: the Sacred Mosque
(Masjid al-Haram), the Mosque of the Messenger of Allah {saws}, and the Mosque of
Kufa."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 231 • Al-Khisal, Part 1, p. 143 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 14, p. 1447 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 257 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 262 • Al-Fusul al-Muhimmah, Part 2, p. 84 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 96, p. 240 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 96, p. 379

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «لَمَا أُسْرِيَ بِي مَرَزْتُ بِمَوْضِعِ مَسْجِدِ الْكُوفَةِ وَ أَنَا عَلَى الْبُرَاقِ وَ مَعِي
جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فَقَالَ لِي يَا مُحَمَّدُ اِنْزِلْ فَصَلَ فِي هَذَا الْمَكَانِ قَالَ فَنَزَلْتُ فَصَلَيْتُ فَقُلْتُ يَا جَبْرَئِيلُ أَيّ شَيْءٍ
هَذَا الْمَوْضِعُ قَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ هَذِهِ كُوفَانُ وَ هَذَا مَسْجِدُهَا أَمّا أَنَا فَقَدْ رَأَيْتُهَا عِشْرِينَ مَرَّةً خَرَاباً وَ عِشرِينَ مَرَّةً عُمْرَاناً
بَيْنَ كُلِّ مَرَّتَيْنِ خَمْسُمِائَةٍ سَنَةٍ.
english_text:
The Prophet, said: "When I was taken on the Night Journey (Isra'), I passed by
the site of the Mosque of Kufa while I was on al-Buraq, with Archangel Jibril {a.s}
accompanying me.
Archangel Jibril {a.s} said to me, 'O’ Muhammad, descend and pray at this place.'
So, I descended and prayed. Then I asked: 'O’ Archangel Jibril {a.s}, what is this place?'
Archangel Jibril {a.s} said: 'O’ Muhammad, this is Kufa, and this is its mosque. As for me,
I have seen it twenty times in a state of ruin and twenty times in a state of prosperity,
with five hundred years between each state.'"
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 231 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 14, p. 1447

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنِ الْأَصْبَعِ بْنِ نُبَاتَةَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: بَيْنَا نَحْنُ ذَاتَ يَوْمِ حَوْلَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُوْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فِي مَسْجِدِ
اَلْكُوفَةِ إِذْ قَالَ «يَا أَهْلَ الْكُوفَةِ لَقَدْ حَبَاكُمُ اللّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بِمَا لَمْ يَحْبُ بِهِ أَحَداً مِنْ فَضْلٍ مُصَلاَكُمْ بَيْتِ آدَمَ وَ بَيْتِ
نُوجِ وَ بَيْتِ إِدْرِيسَ وَ مُصَلَّى إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْخَلِيلِ وَ مُصَلَّى أَخِي الْخَصِرِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَ مُصَلاَيَ وَ إِنَّ مَسْجِدَكُمْ هَذَا
لَأَحَدُ الْأَرْبَعَةِ الْمَسَاجِدِ الَّتِي اِخْتَارَهَا اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلّ لِأَهْلِهَا وَ كَأَنِّي بِهِ قَدْ أَتِيَ بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي ثَوْبَيْنِ أَبْيَضَيْنِ
يَتَشَبَّهُ بِالْمُحْرِمِ وَ يَشفَعُ لِأَهْلِهِ وَ لِمَنْ يُصَلِّي فِيهِ فَلاَ تُرَدُّ شَفَاعَتُهُ وَ لا تَذْهَبُ الْأَيَّامُ وَ اللَّيَالِي حَتَّى يُنْصَبَ اَلْحَجَرُ
الْأَسْوَدُ فِيهِ وَ لَيَأْتِيَنَّ عَلَيْهِ زَمَانْ يَكُونُ مُصَلَّى الْمَهْدِيِّ مِنْ وُلْدِي وَ مُصَلَّى كُلِّ مُؤْمِنٍ وَ لا يَبْقَى عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُؤْمِنْ
إلاَّ كَانَ بِهِ أَوْ حَنَّ قَلْبُهُ إِلَيْهِ فَلاَ تَهْجُرُوهُ وَ تَقَرَّبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بِالصَّلاَةِ فِيهِ وَ إِرْغَبُوا إِلَيْهِ فِي قَضَاءِ حَوَائِجِكُمْ
فَلَوْ يَعْلَمُ النَّاسُ مَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْبَرَكَةِ لَأَتَوْهُ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ الْأَرْضِ وَ لَوْ حَبْواً عَلَى الثَّلْجِ.
english_text:
It has been reported from Al-Asbagh ibn Nubata that He said:
One day while we were with Amir al-Mu'minin {a.s} in the Mosque of Kufa, Imam {a.s} said:
"O’ people of Kufa, Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, has blessed you with something
no one else has been blessed with - the virtue of your place of prayer, which was the
house of Adam, the house of Noah, the house of Idris, the place of prayer of Ibrahim
{a.s} the Friend (Khalil), the place of prayer of my brother al-Khidr {a.s}, and my place of
prayer.
This mosque of yours is one of the four mosques chosen by Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and
Majestic, for its people.
I can see it on the Day of Judgment, coming in two white garments, resembling a
pilgrim in ihram, and it will intercede for its people and for those who pray in it; its
intercession will not be rejected. The days and nights will not pass until the Black
Stone is placed in it. A time will come when it will be the place of prayer for the Mahdi
from my descendants and the place of prayer for every believer. No believer will
remain on the earth without either being there or having their heart yearn toward it.
So, do not abandon it. Seek nearness to Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, by praying
in it, and turn to Him to fulfil your needs in it.
If people knew the blessings it contains, they would come to it from all corners of the
earth, even if they had to crawl on ice."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 231 • Al-Wafi, V. 14, p. 1447 • Wasail Al-Shia, V. 5, p.

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَ أَمّا مَسْجِدُ السَّهْلَةِ فَقَدْ قَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ «لَوِ اِسْتَجَارَ عَمِّي رَيْدٌ بِهِ لَأَجَارَهُ اللَهُ سَنَةً ذَلِكَ مَوْضِعُ
بَيْتِ إِذْرِيسَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ اَلَّذِي كَانَ يَخِيطُ فِيهِ وَ هُوَ الْمَوْضِعُ ٱلَّذِي خَرَجَ مِنْهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ إِلَى ٱلْعَمَالِقَةِ
وَ هُوَ الْمَوْضِعُ اَلَذِي خَرَجَ مِنْهُ دَاوُدُ إِلَى جَالُوتَ وَ تَحْتَهُ صَخْرَةُ خَضْرَاءُ فِيهَا صُورَةُ وَجْهِ كُلِّ نَبِيِّ خَلَقَهُ اَللهُ عَزَّ وَ
جَلَّ وَ مِنْ تَحْتِهِ أُخِذَتْ طِينَةُ كُلِّ نَبِيٍّ وَ هَوَ مَوْضِعُ ٱلرَّاكِبِ» فَقِيلَ لَهُ وَ مَا الرَّاكِبُ قَالَ « ٱلْخَصِرُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ.
وأما مسجد براثا ببغداد فصلى فيه أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام لما رجع من قتال أهل النهروان.
english_text:
As for the Mosque of Al-Sahla, Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"If my uncle Zayd had sought refuge in it, Allah {SWT} would have protected him for a year.
This is the location of the house of Idris {a.s}, where he used to sew, and it is the place
from which Ibrahim {a.s} departed to the Amalekites.
It is also the place from which David {a.s} set out to confront Goliath. Beneath it lies a
green stone that contains the image of the face of every prophet created by Allah {SWT},
the Mighty and Majestic. From beneath it, the clay (substance) of every prophet was
taken. It is also the place of the Rider."
He was asked: "And who is the Rider?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Al-Khidr {a.s}."
commentary:
As for the Mosque of Baratha in Baghdad, Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi
Talib {a.s} prayed there when he returned from the battle against the people of
Nahrawan.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 232 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 14, p. 1452

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: صَلَّى بِنَا عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ بِبَرَاثَا بَعْدَ رُجُوعِهِ مِنْ قِتَالِ
اَلشُّرَاةِ وَ نَحْنُ زُهَاءُ مِائَةِ أَلْفِ رَجُلٍ فَنَزَلَ نَصْرَانِي مِنْ صَوْمَعَتِهِ فَقَالَ مَنْ عَمِيدُ هَذَا الْجَيْشِ فَقُلْنَا هَذَا فَأَقْبَلَ إِلَيْهِ
فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ يَا سَيِّدِي أَنْتَ نَبِيٍّ فَقَالَ «لا النَّبِيُّ سَيِّدِي قَدْ مَاتَ» قَالَ فَأَنْتَ وَصِيْ نَبِيَّ قَالَ «نَعَمْ»
ثُمّ قَالَ لَهُ «اِجْلِسْ كَيْفَ سَأَلْتَ عَنْ هَذَا» قَالَ أَنَا بَنَيْتُ هَذِهِ الصَّوْمَعَةَ مِنْ أَجْلِ هَذَا ٱلْمَوْضِعِ وَ هَوَ بَرَاثًا وَ قَرَأْتُ
فِي الْكُتُبِ الْمُنزَّلَةِ أَنَّهُ لا يُصَلِّي فِي هَذَا الْمَوْضِعِ بِهَذَا الْجَمْعِ إِلاّ نَبِيَّ أَوْ وَصِيْ نَبِيِّ وَ قَدْ جِئْتُ أُسْلِمُ فَأَسْلَمَ وَ خَرَجَ
مَعَنَا إِلَى الْكُوفَةِ فَقَالَ لَهُ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ «فَمَنْ صَلَّى هَاهْنَا» قَالَ صَلَّى عِيسَى اِبْنُ مَرْيَمَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ وَ أَمُّهُ
فَقَالَ لَهُ عَلِيْ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلامُ «أَ فَأْخِبِرُكَ مَنْ صَلَّى هَاهُنَا» قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ » ٱلْخَلِيلُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ.
english_text:
It was narrated from Jabir ibn Abdullah Al-Ansari that He said:
"Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} led us in prayer at Baratha after returning from the battle
with the Khawarij, and we were about one hundred thousand men.
A Christian descended from his monastery and asked: "Who is the leader of this
army?"
We said: "This man (referring to Imam Ali {a.s})."
He approached him, greeted him, and said: "O’ my master, are you a prophet?"
Imam Ali {a.s} replied: "No, the Prophet, my master, has passed away."
The man asked: "Then you are the successor of a prophet?"
Imam Ali {a.s} said: "Yes."
Imam Ali {a.s} then asked him, "Sit down; why do you ask this?"
The man replied: "I built this monastery because of this place, which is Baratha, and I
have read in the revealed books that no one will pray here with such a large gathering
except for a prophet or the successor of a prophet. So, I have come to accept Islam."
He then embraced Islam and accompanied us to Kufa.
Imam Ali {a.s} asked him, "Who else has prayed here?"
The man replied: "Jesus, the son of Mary {a.s}, and his mother."
Ali said to him, "Shall I inform you of who else has prayed here?"
The man said: "Yes."
Imam Ali {a.s} said: "Ibrahim {a.s}."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 232 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 287 • Madīnat Maʿājiz al-Aʾimma ʿAlayhim al-Salām, Part 1, p. 491

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ تَنَخَّمَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ ثُمَّ رَدَّهَا فِي جَوْفِهِ لَمْ تَمُرّ بِدَاءٍ إِلَّ أَبْرَأَتْهُ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Whoever clears his throat in the mosque and then swallows it back, no disease will
pass through them without it curing them."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 233 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al-A’mal, Part 1, p. 18 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 256 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 442 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 500 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 223 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 81, p. 13

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «مَنْ كَنَسَ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ يَوْمَ الْخَمِيسِ وَ لَيْلَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَأَخْرَجَ مِنْهُ مِنَ
التُّرَابٍ مَا يُذَرّ فِي الْعَيْنِ غَفَرَ اللّهُ تَعَالَى لَهُ.
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"Whoever sweeps the mosque on Thursday and the night of Jumu’ah (Thursday night)
and removes from it even the dust that could irritate the eye, Allah {SWT}, the Exalted,
will forgive them."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 233 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 254 • Rawdat al- Wa’izin, Vol. 2, p. 336 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 509 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 238 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 80, p.

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ مَشَى إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ لَمْ يَضَعْ رِجْلَيْهِ عَلَى رَطْبٍ وَ لاَ يَابِسِ إِلاَّ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ
إِلَى الْأَرَضِينَ السَّابِعَةِ.
وقد أخرجت هذه الأخبار مسندة وما رويت في معناها في كتاب فضل المساجد وحرمتها وما جاء فيها.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Whoever walks to the mosque, every step they take - whether it falls upon something
moist or dry - glorifies Allah {SWT} for them down to the seventh earth”.
commentary:
These reports have been narrated with their chain of transmission, and what has been
narrated in their meaning can be found in the book of the virtues and sanctity of the
mosques and what has been mentioned therein.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ عَلِيّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: «صَلَاَةٌ فِي بَيْتِ ٱلْمَقْدِسِ تَعْدِلُ أَلْفَ صَلاَةٍ وَ صَلاَةً فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْأَعْظَمِ تَعْدِلُ
مِائَةَ أَلْفِ صَلاَةٍ وَ صَلاَةً فِي مَسْجِدِ الْقَبِيلَةِ تَعْدِلُ خَمْساً وَ عِشَرِينَ صَلاَةً وَ صَلاَةً فِي مَسْجِدِ السُّوقِ، تَعْدِلُ اِثْنَتَيْ
عَشرَةَ صَلاَةً وَ صَلاَةُ الرّجُلِ فِي بَيْتِهِ تَعْدِلُ صَلاَةً وَاحِدَةً.
english_text:
Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said :
"A prayer in Bayt al-Maqdis (Jerusalem) is equivalent to one thousand prayers. A prayer
in the Great Mosque (Masjid al-Haram) is equivalent to one hundred thousand prayers.
A prayer in the Mosque of the Tribe (Masjid al-Qabilah) is equivalent to twenty-five
prayers. A prayer in the market mosque is equivalent to twelve prayers. A man's prayer
in his home is equivalent to one prayer."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 233 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al-A’mal, Part 1, p. 30 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 253 • Al-Wa'ezin School, Vol. 2, p. 338 • Jami’ al-Akhbar, Part 1, p. 70 • Falah Al-Sael, Part 1, p. 91 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 513 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 289 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 81, p. 15 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 270

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ بَنَّى مَسْجِداً كَمَفُحَصٍ قَطَاةٍ بَنَّى اللَّهُ لَهُ بَيْتاً فِي الْجَنَّةِ.
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said: "Whoever builds a mosque as small
as a sandgrouse’s nest, Allah {SWT} will build for them a house in Paradise."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 235 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 2, p. 30 • Al-Masbah (Lalkafami) Vol. 1, p. 13 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 81, p. 4 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 3, p. 366

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ الْحَذَّاءُ: وَ مَرَّ بِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ وَ أَنَا بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَ الْمَدِينَةِ أَضَعُ الْأَحْجَارَ فَقُلْتُ
هَذَا مِنْ ذَاكَ فَقَالَ »نَعَمْ.
english_text:
Abu Ubaidah Al-Hadha’ said: "Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} passed
by me while I was between Makkah and Madinah placing stones. I asked: 'Is this from
that?'
Imam {a.s} said: 'Yes.'"
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَلِيَّ الْحَلَبِيْ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ ٱلْمَسَاجِدِ الْمُظَلِّلَةِ يُكْرَهُ اَلْقِيَامُ فِيهَا قَالَ
«نَعَمْ وَ لَكِنْ لاَ تَضُرُّكُمُ الصَّلاَةُ فِيهَا.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «أَوَّلُ مَا يَبْدَأُ بِهِ قَائِمُنَا سُقُوفُ ٱلْمَسَاجِدِ فَيُكَسِّرُهَا وَ يَأْمُرُ بِهَا فَيُجْعَلُ عَرِيشاً
كعرِيشِ مُوسَى،
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"The first thing our Qa'im (the awaited savior Imam Muhammad ibn Hassan Al-Mahdi
{a.s} ) will do is to break the roofs of the mosques and order them to be made as an open
canopy (like the canopy of Musa {a.s})”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 236 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 491 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 207 • Ithbāt al-Hudāt, Part 5, p. 65

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text: - وَ كَانَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِذَا رَأْى الْمَحَارِيبَ فِي ٱلْمَسَاجِدِ كَسَّرَهَا وَ يَقُولُ «كَأْنَّهَا مَذَابِحُ ٱلْيَهُودِ.
english_text:
When Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} saw the niches (mihrabs) in mosques, he would
break them and say,
"It is as if they are the altars of the Jews."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text: - وَ رَأَى عَلِيّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ مَسْجِداً بِالْكُوفَةِ قَدْ شُرِّفَ قَالَ «كَأْنَّهُ بِيعَةٌ إِنَّ ٱلْمَسَاجِدَ لاَ تُشَرَفُ تُبْنَى جُمّاً.
english_text:
Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} saw a mosque in Kufa that had been decorated or
elevated and said:
"It is as if it is a church. Mosques are not to be adorned; they should be built plain
(simple)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 236 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 2, p. 320 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 253 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 493 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 215 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 80, p. 352

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَ سُئِلَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الْأَوْلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الطّينِ فِيهِ التَّبْنُ يُطَيَّنُ بِهِ الْمَسْجِدُ أَوِ الْبَيْتُ اَلَّذِي يُصَلَّى فِيهِ
فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ
english_text:
Abu Al-Hasan al-Awwal, Imam Musa Al-Kadhim {a.s}, was asked about using
clay mixed with straw to plaster the mosque or the house where prayers are offered.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in it."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text: - وَ سُيْلَ: عَنْ بَيْتٍ قَدْ كَانَ الْجِصُ يُطبَخُ بِالْعَذِرَةِ أَيَضْلُحُ أَنْ يُجَصَّصَ بِهِ الْمَسْجِدُ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ.
english_text:
Imam {a.s} was asked about using plaster that had been prepared with dung for
plastering a mosque. Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text: - وَ سُئِلَ: عَنْ بَيْتِ قَدْ كَانَ حَشَّاً زَمَاناً هَلْ يَصْلُحُ أَنْ يُجْعَلَ مَسْجِداً فَقَالَ «إِذَا نُظَفَ وَ أُصْلِحَ فَلاَ بَأْسَ.
english_text:
Abu Al-Hasan al-Awwal, Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} was asked about
a house that had been used as a latrine for a period of time and whether it would be
suitable to make it into a mosque.
Imam {a.s} said: "If it is cleaned and repaired, then there is no harm."
references: Masa’il Ali ibn Ja’far, Part 1, p. 229 • Qurb al-Isnad, Part 1, p. 289 • Man La Yahduruhu Al- Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 236 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 211 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 80, p. 358

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ عُبَيْدُ اللّهِ بْنُ عَلِيَّ الْحَلَبِيْ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: فِي مَسْجِدٍ يَكُونُ فِي الدَّارِ فَيَبْدُو لِأَهْلِهِ أَنْ
يَتَوَسِّعُوا بِطَائِفَةِ مِنْهُ أَوْ يُحَوِّلُوهُ عَنْ مَكَانِهِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ» قَالَ فَقُلْتُ فَيَصْلُحُ ٱلْمَكَانُ آَلَّذِي كَانَ حَشَاً زَمَاناً
أَنْ يُنَظَّفَ وَ يُتَّخَذَ مَسْجِداً، قَالَ «نَعَمْ إِذَا أَلْقِيَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ التُّرَابِ مَا يُوَارِيهِ فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ يُنَظَّفُهُ وَ يُطَهِّرُهُ.
english_text:
Ubaidullah ibn Ali Al-Halabi asked Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a mosque within a
house, where the owners might wish to expand part of it or move it from its original
location. Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in that."
Ubaydullah then asked: "Would it be suitable for a place that was previously used as
a latrine for a period of time to be cleaned and made into a mosque?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, if soil is placed over it to cover it, as this cleanses and purifies it."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَ كَانَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «مَنِ اِخْتَلَفَ إِلَى ٱلْمَسَاجِدِ أَصَابَ إِحْدَى الثَّمَانِ أَخاً مُسْتَفَاداً فِي
اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَوْ عِلْمَا مُسْتَطْرَفاً أَوْ آيَةً مُحْكَمَةً أَوْ رَحْمَةً مُنتَظَرَةَ أَوْ كَلِمَةً تَرُدُّهُ عَنْ رَدِّى أَوْ يَسْمَعُ كَلِمَةً تَدُلُهُ عَلَى
هُدَّى أَوْ يَثْرُكَ ذَنْباً خَشْيَةً أَوْ حَيَاءً.
english_text:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} used to say:
"Whoever frequently visits the mosques will attain one of eight benefits: a brother
(friend) beneficial in the cause of Allah {SWT}, newly acquired knowledge, a definitive
verse (of guidance), a mercy awaited, a word that turns him away from misguidance,
hearing a word that leads him to guidance, abandoning a sin out of fear (of Allah {SWT})
or out of shame”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 237 • Thawāb al-Aʿmāl wa ʿIqāb al-Aʿmāl, Part 1, p. 27 • Al-Khisal, Part 2, p. 409 • Al-Amali (by Al-Saduq) Vol. 1, p. 389 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 248 • Amali (by Al-Tusi) Vol. 1, p. 432 • Al-Wa'ezin School, Vol. 2, p. 338 • Falah Al-Sael, Part 1, p. 90 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 1, p. 407 • Al-Masbah (Lalkafami) Vol. 1, p. 13

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَ سَمِعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ رَجْلاً يُنْشِدُ ضَالَةً فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ «قُولُوا لَهُ لا رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ ضَالّتَكَ
فَإِنَّهَا لِغَيْرِ هَذَا بُنِيَتْ.
english_text:
The Prophet {saws}, heard a man searching for a lost item in the mosque and
said:
"Say to him, 'May Allah {SWT} not return your lost item to you,' for the mosque was not
built for this purpose."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 237 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 235 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 80, p. 362

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «جَنِّبُوا مَسَاجِدَكُمْ صِبْيَانَكُمْ وَ مَجَانِينَكُمْ وَ رَفْعَ أَصْوَاتِكُمْ وَ شِرَاءَكُمْ وَ بَيْعَكُمْ وَ الضَّالَةَ
وَ الْحُدُودَ وَ اَلْأَحْكَامَ.
وينبغي أن تجنب المساجد إنشاد الشعر فيها وجلوس المعلم للتأديب فيها، وجلوس الخياط فيها للخياطة.
english_text:
Imam {a.s} said: "Keep your children, the insane, raising of voices, buying and
selling, seeking lost items, and administering legal punishments and rulings away
from your mosques”.
commentary:
It is also recommended to avoid reciting poetry, having teachers sit for disciplining,
and tailors sitting for sewing in the mosques.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 237 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 234

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «مَنْ أَسْرَجَ فِي مَسْجِدٍ مِنْ مَسَاجِدِ اللَّهِ سِرَاجا لَمْ تَزَلِ ٱلْمَلاَئِكَةُ وَ
حَمَلَةُ اَلْعَرْشِ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لَهُ مَا دَامَ فِي ذَلِكَ الْمَسْجِدِ ضَوْءُ مِنَ السِّرَاجِ.
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"Whoever lights a lamp in one of the mosques of Allah {SWT}, the angels and the bearers
of the Throne will continue to seek forgiveness for them as long as there remains any
light from that lamp in the mosque."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 237 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al-A’mal, Part 1, p. 29 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 261 • Jami’ al-Akhbar, Part 1, p. 71 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 1, p. 351 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 509 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 241 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 81, p. 15

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «إِذَا أَخْرَجَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْحَصَاةَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ فَلْيَرُدَّهَا فِي مَكَانِهَا أَوْ فِي مَسْجِدٍ
اخَرَ فَإِنَّهَا تُسَبِّحُ.
ولا يجوز للحائض والجنب أن يدخلا المسجد إلا مجتازين.
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"If any of you takes a pebble from the mosque, let them return it to its place or to
another mosque, for it glorifies Allah {SWT}”.
commentary:
Additionally, it is not permissible for a menstruating woman or someone in a state of
major ritual impurity (janabah) to enter the mosque, except by passing through.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 237 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 2, p. 320 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 256 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 503 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 232 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 81, p. 7

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ اَلصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «خَيْرُ مَسَاجِدِ نِسَائِكُمُ اَلْبُيُوتُ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"The best mosques for your women are their homes."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 238 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 252 • Al-Wa'ezin School, Vol. 2, p. 338 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 514 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 237 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 237 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 80, p. 371

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text: - وَ سُئِلَ: عَنِ الْوُقُوفِ عَلَى الْمَسَاجِدِ فَقَالَ «لَاَ يَجُوزُ فَإِنَّ الْمَجُوسَ أَوْقَفُوا عَلَى بُيُوتِ النَّارِ.
english_text:
Imam {a.s} was asked about endowing property to mosques, and He said:
"It is not permissible, for the Magians endowed property for their fire temples”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنّ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ مَكْتُوبا أَنَ بُيُوتِي فِي الْأَرْضِ الْمَسَاجِدُ فَطُوبَى لِعَبْدِ تَطَهَّرَ فِي بَيْتِهِ ثُمَّ زَارَنِي فِي
بَيْتِي أَلا إِنَّ عَلَى ٱلْمَزُورِ كَرَامَةَ اَلزَّائِرِ أَلا بَشَّرِ الْمَشَاءِينَ فِي الظُلُمَاتِ إِلَى الْمَسَاجِدِ بِالنُّورِ السَّاطِعِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ.
english_text:
It is narrated "In the Torah, it is written that 'My houses on earth are the
mosques. Glad tidings to the servant who purifies themselves in their home and then
visits Me in My house. Surely, it is incumbent upon the host to honor their guest. Give
glad tidings to those who walk in the darkness to the mosques of a radiant light on the
Day of Judgment.'"
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 239 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al-A’mal, Part 1, p. 26 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 512 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 244 • Kulliyat Hadith Qudsi, Vol. 1, p. 126 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 80, p. 373 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Part 1, p. 298

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّ الْبُيُوتَ الَّتِي يُصَلَّى فِيهَا بِاللَّيْلِ يُضِيءُ نُورُهَا لِأَهْلِ السِّمَاءِ كَمَا يُضِيءُ نُورُ الْكَوَاكِبِ لِأَهْلِ
الأَرضٍ
english_text:
It is narrated: "The houses in which prayers are offered at night shine with light
for the inhabitants of the heavens just as the stars shine with light for the inhabitants
of the earth."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ مَرَّ عَلَى مَنَارَةٍ طَوِيلَةٍ فَأَمَرَ بِهَدْمِهَا، ثُمَّ قَالَ « لا تُرْفَعُ ٱلْمَنَارَةُ إِلاَّ مَعَ سَطْحِ
المَسْجِدٍ».
english_text:
It is narrated that Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s}, passed by a tall minaret and
ordered it to be demolished.
He then said: "The minaret should not be raised higher than the roof of the mosque”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 239 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 256 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 494 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 230

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES, THEIR SANCTITY AND THE REWARD FOR THOSE WHO PRAY IN THEM
arabic_text:
«وَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وتَعَالَى لَيُرِيدُ عَذَابَ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعاً حَتَّى لا يُحَاشِيَ مِنْهُمْ أَحَداً فَإِذَا نَظَرَ إِلَى الشِّيبِ
نَاقِلِي أَقْدَامِهِمْ إِلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ وَ الْوِلْدَانِ يَتَعَلَّمُونَ الْقُرْآنَ رَجِمَهُمُ اللّهُ فَأَخَرَ ذَلِكَ عَنْهُمْ.
ومن أراد دخول المسجد فليدخل على سكون ووقار فإن المساجد بيوت اللّٰه وأحب البقاع إليه، وأحبهم إلى اللّٰه عز وجل
[رجلا] أولهم دخولا وآخرهم خروجا. ومن دخل المسجد فليدخل رجله اليمنى قبل اليسرى، وليقل " بسم اللّٰه وبالله السلام
عليك أيها النبي ورحمة اللّٰه وبركاته، اللهم صل على محمد وآل محمد وافتح لنا أبواب رحمتك، واجعلنا من عمار مساجدك،
جل ثناء وجهك. وإذا خرج فليخرج رجله اليسرى قبل اليمنى وليقل: " اللهم صل على محمد وآل محمد، وافتح لنا باب
رحمتك.
english_text:
"And indeed, Allah {SWT}, Blessed and Exalted, intends to bring punishment
upon all the people of the earth without exception. But when He looks at the elderly,
who move their feet to the prayers and the children learning the Qur'an, He has mercy
on them and withholds that punishment”.
commentary:
One who wishes to enter the mosque should do so with calmness and dignity, for
mosques are the houses of Allah {SWT} and the most beloved places to Him. The people
most beloved to Allah {SWT}, the Almighty, are those who enter first and leave last.
When entering the mosque, one should step in with the right foot before the left and say;
"In the name of Allah {SWT}, and by Allah {SWT}, peace be upon you, O’ Prophet, and the
mercy and blessings of Allah {SWT}. O’ Allah {SWT}, bless Muhammad and the family of
Muhammad. Open for us the doors of Your mercy, and make us among those who
maintain Your mosques. Exalted is Your praise, O’ Lord {AZJ}."
When leaving, one should step out with the left foot before the right and say:
"O’ Allah {SWT}, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and open for us the
door of Your mercy”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 239 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 512 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 198

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND
arabic_text:
باب - المواضع التي تجوز الصلاة فيها والمواضع التي لا تجوز فيها
قَالَ النَّبِيْ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «أُعْطِيتُ خَمْساً لَمْ يُعْطَهَا أَحَدٌ قَبْلِي جُعِلَتْ لِيَ الْأَرْضُ مَسْجِداً وَ طَهُوراً
وَ نُصِرْتُ بِالرُّغْبِ وَ أُجِلَّ لِيَ الْمَغْنَمُ وَ أُعْطِيتُ جَوَامِعَ الْكَلِمِ وَ أُعْطِيتُ الشَّفَاعَةَ.
وتجوز الصلاة فى الأرض كلها إلا فى المواضع التى خصت بالنهى عن الصلاة فيها.
english_text:
The Prophet, said:
"I was given five things that no one was given before me: The entire earth was made a
place of prayer and a means of purification for me, I was aided with fear (cast into the
hearts of my enemies), war booty was made lawful for me, I was given concise speech
(Jawaami' al-Kalim), and I was granted intercession."
commentary:
It is permissible to pray on the entire earth except in places specifically designated as
prohibited for prayer.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 240 • Al-Khisal, Part 1, p. 292 • Al-Amali (by Al-Saduq) Vol. 1, p. 216 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 573 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 350 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 117 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 8, p. 38 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 16, p. 313 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 16, p. 323 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 80, p. 276

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «عَشَرَةُ مَوَاضِعَ لاَ يُصَلَّى فِيهَا الطَّينُ وَ الْمَاءُ وَ الْحَمَّامُ وَ الْقُبُورُ وَ مَسَانُ
الطَّرِيقٍ وَقْرَى النَّمْلِ وَ مَعَاطِنُ ٱلْإِبِلِ وَ مَجْرَى ٱلْمَاءِ، وَ السَّبَخَةُ وَ الثّلْجُ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"There are ten places where prayer should not be performed: mud, water, baths,
graves, paths frequently used by travelers, ant hills, camel resting places,
watercourses, salty land (sabkha), and snow”.
references: Al Mahasin, Part 1, p. 13 • Al Mahasin, Part 2, p. 366 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 390 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 241 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 394 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 445 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 80, p. 305

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيّ: «أَنَّهُ لا يُصَلَّى فِي الْبَيْدَاءِ وَ لا ذَاتِ الصَّلاَصِلِ وَ لاَ فِي وَادِي الشُقْرَةِ وَلاَ فِي وَادِي ضَجْنَانَ».
فإذا حصل الرجل في الطين أو الماء وقد دخل وقت الصلاة ولم يمكنه الخروج منه صلى إيماء ويكون سجوده أخفض من
ركوعه ولا بأس بالصلاة في مسلخ الحمام وإنما يكره في الحمام لأنه مأوى الشياطين.
english_text:
It is narrated that prayer should not be performed in al-Bayda', Dhat al-Salasil,
the valley of al-Shaqra, or the valley of Dajnan.
commentary:
If a person finds themselves in mud or water and the time for prayer has entered, and
they are unable to leave, they should pray by making gestures, ensuring that their
prostration is lower than their bowing. There is no harm in praying in a bathhouse
changing area, but it is disliked to pray in the main bath area because it is a dwelling
place for devils.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 242 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 469 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p.

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ عَلِيْ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ أَخَاهُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ: عَنِ الصَّلاةِ فِي بَيْتِ الْحَمَّامِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ
الْمَوْضِعُ نَظِيفاً فَلا بَأْسَ بِالصَّلاَةِ» - يَعْنِي الْمَسْلَخَ.
وأما القبور فلا يجوز أن تتخذ قبلة ولا مسجدا، ولا بأس بالصلاة بين خللها ما لم يتخذ شئ منها قبلة والمستحب أن يكون
بين المصلى وبين القبور عشرة أذرع من كل جانب. وأما مسان الطريق فلا يجوز الصلاة فيها، ولا على الجواد فأما على
الظواهر التي بين الجواد فلا بأس.
english_text:
Ali ibn Ja'far asked his brother Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} about
praying in the bathhouse.
Imam {a.s} said: "If the place is clean, then there is no harm in praying” (referring
specifically to the changing area (maslakh)).”
commentary:
As for graves, it is not permissible to use them as a direction of prayer or to turn them
into mosques. However, there is no harm in praying between graves, as long as none
of them are taken as a direction of prayer. It is recommended that there be a distance
of ten cubits between the person praying and the graves on all sides.
Regarding paths, it is not permissible to pray in the main pathways or on roads, but
there is no harm in praying on areas adjacent to the roads.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «كُلُّ طَرِيقٍ يُوطَأ وَ يُتَطَرِّقُ كَانَتْ فِيهِ جَادَةً أَوْ لَمْ تَكُنُ لا يَنْبَغِي الصَّلاةُ فِيهِ»
قِيلَ فَأَيْنَ يُصَلَّى قَالَ «يَمْنَةً وَ يَسْرَةً.
english_text:
Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha {a.s} said:
"Any path that is trodden and commonly used, whether it has a main road or not,
should not be used for prayer."
He was asked: "Then where should one pray?"
Imam {a.s} said: "To the right or to the left (of the path)."
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 389 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 243 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 220 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 448 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 147

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ الْحَلَبِيِّ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الصَّلاةِ فِي مَرَابِضِ الْغَنَمِ فَقَالَ «صَلِّ وَ لا تُصَلّ فِي أَعْطَانٍ
اَلْإِبِلِ إِلَّ أَنْ تَخَافَ عَلَى مَتَاعِكَ الضَّيْعَةَ فَاكْتُسْهُ وَ رُشَّهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَ صَلِّ فِيهِ» قَالَ «وَكُرِهَ الصَّلاَةُ فِي السَّبَخَةِ إِلَّ أنْ
يَكُونَ مَكَاناً لَيُّناً تَقَعُ عَلَيْهِ الْجَبْهَةُ مُسْتَوِيَةً.
english_text:
And Halabi asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about praying in
sheep pens, and Imam {a.s} said:
"Pray there, but do not pray in camel enclosures unless you fear for the safety of your
belongings; in that case, sweep it and sprinkle it with water, then pray there."
He also said: "Prayer in a salty land (sabkha) is disliked unless it is a soft, level place
where the forehead can rest properly."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text:
وَ سُئِلَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ فِي بُيُوتِ الْمَجُوسِ وَ هِيَ تُرَشُ بِالْمَاءِ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهِ » ثُمَّ قَالَ
وَ رَأَيْتُهُ فِي طَرِيقٍ مَكَّةَ أَحْيَاناً يَرُشُ مَوْضِعَ جَبْهَتِهِ ثُمَّ يَسْجُدُ عَلَيْهِ رَطْباً كَمَا هُوَ وَ رُبَّمَا لَمْ يَرُشَّ الْمَكَانَ اَلَّذِي
يَرَى أَنَّهُ نَظِيفٌ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about praying in the houses
of the Magians (Zoroastrians) if they are sprinkled with water, and He said:
"There is no harm in it."
He then mentioned that he sometimes saw someone on the road to Makkah sprinkling
water on the spot where they placed their forehead before prostrating, while at other
times, they did not sprinkle water if they deemed the place to be clean.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ صَالِحُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ سُئِلَ ٱلصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: عَنِ ٱلصَّلاَةِ فِي الْبِيَعِ وَ الْكَنَائِسِ فَقَالَ «صَلَّ فِيهَا» قَالَ
فَقُلْتُ وَ إِنْ كَانُوا يُصَلُونَ فِيهَا أُصَلِّي فِيهَا قَالَ «نَعَمْ أَمَا تَقْرَأُ اَلْقُرْآنَ:
• قُلْ كُلُّ يَعْمَلُ عَلىٰ شاكِلَتِهِ فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ هُوَ أَهْدىٰ سَبِيلاً » صَلِّ إِلَى ٱلْقِبْلَةِ وَ دَعْهُمْ.
english_text:
Saleh ibn Al-Hakam reported that Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was
asked about praying in synagogues and churches. Imam {a.s} said: "Pray in them."
Salih then asked: "Even if they (non-Muslims) are praying there?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes. Do you not recite the Qur'an: 'Say, each acts according to their
manner, but your Lord {AZJ} knows best who is rightly guided' (Surah Al-Isra, 17:84)?
Pray facing the Qibla and leave them (to their practices)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ زُرَارَةُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الْبَوْلِ يَكُونُ عَلَى السَّطْحِ أَوْ فِي الْمَكَانِ الَّذِي يُصَلَّى فِيهِ فَقَالَ
«إِذَا جَفَّفَتْهُ الشَّمْسُ فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ فَهُوَ طَاهِرٌ.
english_text:
Zurarah asked Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} about urine that is present
on a rooftop or in a place where one prays.
Imam {a.s} said: "If the sun dries it, then you may pray on it, for it is purified”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 244 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 3, p. 59

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ عَامِرُ بْنُ نُعَيْمِ الْقُمِّيْ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الْمَنَازِلِ اَلَّتِي يَنْزِلُهَا النَّاسُ فِيهَا أَبْوَالُ الدَّوَابِّ وَ
السِّرْجِينُ وَ يَدْخُلُهَا الْيَهُودُ وَ النَّصَارَى كَيْفَ نَصْنَعُ بِالصَّلاَةِ فِيهَا فَقَالَ «صَلِّ عَلَى ثَوْبِكَ.
english_text:
Amir ibn Nuaym al-Qummi asked Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} about places where
people stay that contain the urine of animals, manure, and are frequented by Jews and
Christians.
He asked: "What should we do about praying in such places?"
Abu 'Abdillah replied: "Pray on your garment."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ عَلِيْ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الثَالِثَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَصِيرُ فِي الْبَيْدَاءِ فَتُدْرِكُهُ صَلاَةً فَرِيضَةٌ
فَلَاَ يَخْرُجُ مِنَ الْبَيْدَاءِ حَتَّى يَخْرُجَ وَقْتُهَا كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ بِالصَّلاَةِ وَ قَدْ نُهِيَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ بِالبَيْدَاءِ فَقَالَ «يُصَلِّي فِيهَا وَ
يَتَجَنَّبُ قَارِعَةَ الطَّرِيقِ.
english_text:
Ali ibn Mahziyar asked Abu Al-Hasan the Third, Imam Ali ibn Muhammad Al-
Hadi {a.s}, about a man who finds himself in the desert (al-Bayda') when the time for an
obligatory prayer comes and does not leave the desert until the prayer's time has
passed.
He asked: "What should he do about the prayer, given that it is prohibited to pray in al-
Bayda'?"
Imam {a.s} said: "He should pray there, but he should avoid the main path (road)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 244 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 156

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text: - وَ رَوَى عَنْهُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَيُوبُ بْنُ نُوحِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ - «يَتَنَحَى عَنِ ٱلْجَوَادَ يَمْنَةً وَ يَسْرَةً وَ يُصَلِّي.
english_text:
It was narrated from Imam {a.s} said, by Ayyub ibn Nuh that He said:
"One should move away from the main roads to the right or to the left and pray."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 244 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 156

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ عَلِيْ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ أَخَاهُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السِّلَاَمُ: عَنِ اَلْبَيْتِ وَ الدَّارِ لا تُصِيبُهُمَا الشَّمْسُ وَ
يُصِيبُهُمَا الْبَوْلُ وَ يُعْتَسَلُ فِيهِمَا مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ أَيُصَلَّى فِيهِمَا إِذَا جَفًا قَالَ «نَعَمْ» قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الصَّلَاَةِ بَيْنَ ٱلْقُبُورِ
هَلْ تَصْلُحْ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهِ.
english_text:
Ali ibn Ja'far asked his brother Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} about a
house or room that does not receive sunlight and in which urine might be present and
where one bathes after major ritual impurity (janabah). He asked if it is permissible to
pray there once it has dried?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
Ali ibn Ja'far also asked about praying between graves?
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in it."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ عَمَّارُ بْنُ مُوسَى السَّابَاطِيُّ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الْبَارِيَّةِ يُبَلُّ قَصَبُهَا بِمَاءِ قَذِرٍ هَلْ تَجُوزُ
الصَّلاَةُ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ «إِذَا جُفِّفَتْ فَلاَ بَأْسَ بِالصَّلاةِ عَلَيْهَا.
english_text:
Ammar ibn Musa al-Sabati asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}
about a mat made of reeds that had been wetted with impure water, and whether it is
permissible to pray on it.
Imam {a.s} said: "If it has dried, then there is no harm in praying on it”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ زُرَارَةُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: عَنِ الشَّادَكُونَةِ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهَا الْجَنَابَةُ أَيُصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا فِي الْمَحْمِلِ فَقَالَ
«لا بَأْسَ بِالصَّلاَةِ عَلَيْهَا.
english_text:
Zurarah asked Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} about a cushion
(shadhakunah) that may have come into contact with major ritual impurity (janabah)
and whether it is permissible to pray on it while it is in a carriage (mahmil).
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in praying on it."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text: - وَ رَوَى مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرِ عَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: « لا بَأْسَ بِأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى كُلِّ التَّمَاثِيلِ إِذَا جَعَلْتَهَا تَحْتَكَ.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Al-Baqir {a.s} that He said:
"There is no harm in praying on any images (representations) if you place them
beneath you."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 245 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 363 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 464 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 4, p. 439 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 171

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ لَيْثُ الْمُرَادِيِّ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ: عَنِ الْوَسَائِدِ تَكُونُ فِي الْبَيْتِ فِيهَا التَّمَاثِيلُ عَنْ يَمِينٍ أَوْ
عَنْ شِمَالٍ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهِ مَا لَمْ تَكُنْ تُجَاهَ الْقِبْلَةِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ شَيْءُ مِنْهَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ مِمَّا يَلِي الْقِبْلَةَ فَغَطَّهِ وَ صَلٍّ.
english_text:
Laith al-Muradi asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about cushions
in the house that have images on them, whether they are to the right or to the left.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in it as long as they are not facing the Qibla. If any of
them are in front of you, facing the Qibla, then cover them and pray."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text:
وَ سُبِلَ: عَنِ التَّمَاثِيلِ تَكُونُ فِي الْبِسَاطِ لَهَا عَيْنَانٍ وَ أَنتَ تُصَلِّي فَقَالَ «إنْ كَانَ لَهَا عَيْنَ وَاحِدَةً فَلا بَأْسَ وَ
إنْ كَانَ لَهَا عَيْنَانِ وَ أَنْتَ تُصَلِّي فَلاَ.
english_text:
He, Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}, was asked about images on a
carpet that have two eyes while you are praying.
Imam {a.s} said: "If it has one eye, then there is no harm, but if it has two eyes and you
are praying, then it is not permissible."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 245 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 363 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 4, p. 438 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 80, p. 245

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلاَمُ: «لا بَأْسَ بِالصَّلاةِ وَ أَنْتَ تَنظُرُ إِلَى التَصَاوِيرِ إِذَا كَانَتْ بِعَيْنٍ وَاحِدَةٍ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"There is no harm in praying while looking at images if they have only one eye."
references: Al Mahasin, Part 2, p. 620 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 246 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 465 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 172 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 173 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 76, p. 288 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol. 80, p. 293

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ: «لا تُصَلَّ فِي دَارٍ فِيهَا كَلْبٌ إِلَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ كَلْبَ صَيْدٍ وَ أَغْلَقْتَ دُونَهُ بَاباً فَلاَ
بَأْسَ وَ إِنَّ الْمَلائِكَةَ لا تَدْخُلُ بَيْتاً فِيهِ كَلْبٌ وَ لا بَيْتاً فِيهِ تَمَاثِيلُ وَ لا بَيْتاً فِيهِ بَوْل مَجْمُوعٌ فِي آَنِيَةٍ.
ولا يجوز الصلاة في بيت فيه خمر محصورة في أنية
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Do not pray in a house where there is a dog, except if it is a hunting dog and you have
closed a door between you and it, then there is no harm. Indeed, the angels do not
enter a house where there is a dog, nor a house with images, nor a house with urine
collected in a container."
commentary:
Additionally, it is not permissible to pray in a house where there is wine stored in
containers.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 246 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 459 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 175 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 62, p. 53

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى أَبُو بَصِيرٍ عَنِ الصَّادِقِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ - «مَنْ كَانَ فِي مَوْضِعٍ لاَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَلْيُومِ إِيمَاءً
وَ إن كَانَ فِي أَرْضِ مُنْقَطِعَةٍ.
english_text:
Abu Basir narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that He said:
"Whoever is in a place where they cannot reach the ground should make gestures (for
prayer), even if they are in a remote area”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 246 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 441

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَهُ سَمَاعَةُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ: عَنِ الْأَسِيرِ يَأْسِرُهُ الْمُشرِكُونَ فَتَحْضُرُهُ الصَّلاةُ فَيَمْنَعُهُ ٱلَّذِي أَسَرَهُ مِنْهَا فَقَالَ
«يُومِئُ إِيمَاءً.
english_text:
Sama’a ibn Mehran asked Him about a captive taken by the polytheists who is
prevented from performing prayer by his captor.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should make gestures (for prayer)."
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 411 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 457 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 246 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 175 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 299 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1071 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 448

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ وَهْبٍ أَبَا عَبْدِ آللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسِّلاَمُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ وَ ٱلْمَرْأَةِ يُصَلَّيَانٍ فِي بَيْتِ وَاحِدٍ فَقَالَ «إِذَا
كَانَ بَيْنَهُمَا قَدْرُ شِبْرٍ صَلَّتْ بِحِذَاهُ وَحْدَهَا وَ هَوَ وَحْدَهُ لاَ بَأْسَ.
english_text:
Muawiya ibn Wahb asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man
and a woman praying in the same room.
Imam {a.s} said: "If there is a space of about a handspan (shibr) between them, She may
pray beside him alone and he alone; there is no harm."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 247 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 125

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَامُ: «إِذَا كَانَ بَيْنَهَا وَ بَيْنَهُ قَدْرُ مَا يُتَخَطَّى أَوْ قَدْرُ عَظْمِ ذِرَاعِ
فَصَاعِداً فَلاَ بَأْسَ إِنْ صَلّتْ بِحِذَاهُ وَحْدَهَا.
english_text:
In the narration of Zurarah from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}, said:
"If there is a distance between her and him that is about the length of a step or about
the length of a cubit or more, then there is no harm if She prays beside him alone."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: PLACES WHERE PRAYER IS PERMISSABLE AND WHERE IT IS NOT
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى جَمِيلْ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ - «لا بَأْسَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ الْمَرْأَةُ بِحِذَاءِ الرَّجُلِ وَ هُوَ يُصَلِّي
فَإِنّ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَانَ يُصَلِّي وَ عَائِشَةُ مُضْطَجِعَةً بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَ هِيَ حَائِض وَ كَانَ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ
غَمَزَ رِجْلَيْهَا فَرَفَعَتْ رِجْلَيْهَا حَتَّى يَسْجُدَ.
ولا بأس أن يكون بين يدي الرجل والمرأة وهما يصليان مرفقة أو شئ.
english_text:
Jamil narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} in which He said:
"There is no harm if a woman prays beside a man while he is praying. Indeed, The
Prophet {saws} would pray while Aisha was lying down in front of him, even though She
was menstruating. When he wanted to prostrate, he would touch her legs, and She
would move them so that he could prostrate."
commentary:
There is also no harm if there is a small object, such as an armrest or something
similar, in front of a man and woman while they are praying.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 247 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 479 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 122

Chapter Title: GARMENTS PERMISSIBLE FOR PRAYER AND WHAT
arabic_text:
باب - ما يصلى فيه وما لا يصلى فيه من الثياب وجميع الأنواع
رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ سَأَلَهُ: عَنْ جِلْدِ ٱلْمَيْتَةِ يُلْبَسُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ إِذَا دُبِغَ فَقَالَ
«لا وَ إِنْ دُبِغَ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}
that he asked him about wearing the skin of a dead animal (carrion) during prayer if it
has been tanned.
Imam {a.s} said: "No, even if it has been tanned seventy times."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 247 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 1, p. 321 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 501 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 2, p. 592

Chapter Title: GARMENTS PERMISSIBLE FOR PRAYER AND WHAT
arabic_text:
وَ سُئِلَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لِمُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «) فَاخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ إِنّكَ بِالْوَادِ
الْمُقَدَّسِ طُوىّ » قَالَ «كَانَتَا مِنْ جِلْدِ حِمَارٍ مَيِّتٍ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about the verse in which
Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, said to Musa {a.s}:
"Remove your sandals, for you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa" (Surah Taha 20:12).
Imam {a.s} said: "They were made from the skin of a dead donkey."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 248 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 417 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 4, p. 343 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 3, p. 374

Chapter Title: GARMENTS PERMISSIBLE FOR PRAYER AND WHAT
arabic_text:
وَ سُئِلَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ وَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَ فَقِيلَ لَهُمَا إِنَّا نَشْتَرِي ثِيَاباً يُصِيبُهَا الْخَمْرُ وَ وَدَكُ الْخِنْزِيرِ عِنْدَ حَاكَتِهَا أَ
نُصَلِّي فِيهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ نَغْسِلَهَا فَقَلا « نَعَمْ لا بَأْسَ إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ اللّهُ أَكْلَهُ وَ شُرْبَهُ وَ لَمْ يُحَرِّمْ لُبْسَهُ وَ مَسَّهُ وَ الصَّلاَةَ فِيهِ.
english_text:
Imam Al-Baqir {a.s} and Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} were asked:
"We buy clothes that may have come into contact with wine or the fat of a pig during
their tailoring. Should we pray in them before washing them?"
They replied: "Yes, there is no harm. Allah {SWT} has only forbidden eating and drinking
it (pork and wine) but has not forbidden wearing it, touching it, or praying in it."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 248 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 220 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p.

Chapter Title: GARMENTS PERMISSIBLE FOR PRAYER AND WHAT GARMENTS ARE NOT
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ الْحَلَبِيْ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ لَهُ التَّوْبُ الْوَاجِدُ فِيهِ بَوْلْ لا
يَقْدِرُ عَلَى غَسْلِهِ قَالَ «يُصَلِّي فِيهِ.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Halabi asked Imam Jafar Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man who
has only one garment, and it has urine on it, but he is unable to wash it.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should pray in it."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: GARMENTS PERMISSIBLE FOR PRAYER AND WHAT GARMENTS ARE NOT
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَهُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُجْنِبُ فِي ثَوْبٍ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ غَيْرُهُ وَ لا
يَقْدِرُ عَلَى غَسْلِهِ قَالَ «يُصَلِّي فِيهِ.
english_text:
He was asked by Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi 'Abdillah about a man who becomes
ritually impure (junub) in a garment and has no other garment and is unable to wash it.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should pray in it."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 248 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 224 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 169 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 3, p. 58 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 440 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 485

Chapter Title: GARMENTS PERMISSIBLE FOR PRAYER AND WHAT GARMENTS ARE NOT
arabic_text: - وَ فِي خَبَرٍ آخَرَ قَالَ: «يُصَلِّي فِيهِ فَإِذَا وَجَدَ ٱلْمَاءَ غَسَلَهُ وَ أَعَادَ الصَّلاةَ.
english_text:
In another narration, Imam {a.s} said:
"He should pray in it, and when he finds water, he should wash it and repeat the
prayer."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: GARMENTS PERMISSIBLE FOR PRAYER AND WHAT GARMENTS ARE NOT
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ عَلِيْ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ أَخَاهُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرِ عَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عُزْيَانٍ وَ حَضَرَتِ ٱلصَّلاَةُ فَأَصَابَ ثَوْباً نِصْفُهُ دَمْ
أَوْ كُلّهُ دَمْ يُصَلِّي فِيهِ أَوْ يُصَلِّي عُرْيَاناً قَالَ «إِنْ وَجَدَ مَاءَ غَسَلَهُ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ مَاءً صَلَّى فِيهِ وَ لا يُصَلِّ عُزْيَاناً.
english_text:
Ali ibn Ja'far asked his brother Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} about a man
who is without clothing and the time for prayer arrives, and he finds a garment that is
half covered in blood or entirely covered in blood. Should he pray in it, or should he
pray without clothing?
Imam {a.s} said: "If he finds water, he should wash it; if he does not find water, he should
pray in it and should not pray without clothing”.
references: Masa’il Ali ibn Ja’far, Part 1, p. 219 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 248

Chapter Title: GARMENTS PERMISSIBLE FOR PRAYER AND WHAT GARMENTS ARE NOT
arabic_text:
وَ كَتَبَ صَفَوَانُ بْنُ يَحْيَى إِلَى أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: يَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ مَعَهُ ثَوْبَانٍ فَأَصَابَ أَحَدَهُمَا بَوْلٌ
وَ لَمْ يَذْرٍ أَيُّهُمَا هُوَ وَ حَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ وَ خَافَ فَوْتَهَا وَ لَيْسَ عِنْدَهُ مَاءُ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ «يُصَلِّي فِيهِمَا جَمِيعا.
قال مصنف هذا الكتاب رحمه الله: يعني على الانفراد.
english_text:
Safwan ibn Yahya wrote to Abu Al-Hasan, Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s}
asking about a man who has two garments, one of which has been contaminated with
urine, but he does not know which one. When the time for prayer arrives and he fears
missing it, and he has no water available, what should he do?
Imam {a.s} said: "He should pray in both of them."
commentary:
The compiler of this book (may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him) clarified that this means
praying in each of them separately.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 249 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 225 • Awaali al- La’aali, Part 3, p. 55 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 442 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 505

Chapter Title: GARMENTS PERMISSIBLE FOR PRAYER AND WHAT GARMENTS ARE NOT
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ مُحَمَدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ لأَبِي جَعْفَرِ عَ: الدَّمُ يَكُونُ فِي الثَّوْبِ عَلَيَّ وَ أَنَا فِي الصَّلاةِ فَقَالَ «إِنْ رَأْيْتَهُ وَ عَلَيْكَ
ثَوْبٌ غَيْرُهُ فَاطْرَحْهُ وَ صَلِّ فِي غَيْرِهِ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْكَ ثَوْبٌ غَيْرُهُ فَامْضٍ فِي صَلاَتِكَ وَ لاَ إِعَادَةَ عَلَيْكَ مَا لَمْ
يَزِذْ عَلَى مِقْدَارِ دِرْهَمِ فَإِنْ كَانَ أَقَلَّ مِنْ دِرْهَمِ فَلَيْسَ بِشَيْءٍ رَأَيْتَهُ أَوْ لَمْ تَرَهُ وَ إِذَا كُنْتَ قَدْ رَأَيْتَهُ وَ هُوَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ
مِقْدَارِ الدِّرْهَمِ فَضَيَّعْتَ غَسْلَهُ وَ صَلِّيْتَ فِيهِ صَلَوَاتُ كَثِيرَةً فَأَعِدْ مَا صَلِّيْتَ فِيهِ وَ لَيْسَ ذَلِكَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ ٱلْمَنِيَّ وَ ٱلْبَوْلِ»
ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ الْمَنِيَّ فَشَدَّدَ فِيهِ وَ جَعَلَهُ أَشَدَّ مِنَ الْبَوْلِ ثُمَّ قَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ «إِنْ رَأَيْتَ اَلْمَنِيَّ قَبْلُ أَوْ بَعْدُ
فَعَلَيْكَ الْإِعَادَةُ إِعَادَةُ الصَّلاةِ وَ إِنْ أَنْتَ نَظَرْتَ فِي ثَوْبِكَ فَلَمْ تُصِبْهُ وَ صَلَّيْتَ فِيهِ فَلاَ إِعَادَةَ عَلَيْكَ وَ كَذَا اَلْبَوْلُ.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Muslim said to Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} about the
presence of blood on a garment while in prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "If you see it and have another garment with you, remove it and pray in
the other garment. If you do not have another garment, continue your prayer, and you
do not have to repeat it, provided that the blood does not exceed the size of a dirham.
If it is less than a dirham, it is of no consequence whether you see it or not. But if you
saw it and it was more than a dirham's size and neglected to wash it, and you prayed
multiple prayers in that state, then repeat all prayers you performed in that garment.
However, this is not the same ruling as for semen or urine."
Imam {a.s} then emphasized that the impurity of semen is more severe than urine and
said: "If you see semen before or after, you must repeat the prayer. If you inspected
your garment and did not find it and prayed, there is no need for repetition, and the
same applies for urine”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: GARMENTS PERMISSIBLE FOR PRAYER AND WHAT GARMENTS ARE NOT
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُوْمِنِينَ صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ: «السَّيْفُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الرِّدَاءِ تُصَلَّي فِيهِ مَا لَمْ تَرَ فِيهِ دَمَاً وَ الْقَوْسُ
بِمَنْزِلَةِ الرِّدَاءِ.
english_text:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"A sword is like a garment; you may pray with it as long as you do not see any blood on
it. A bow is also like a garment."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 249 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 371 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 529 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 4, p. 458 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 80, p. 189 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 80, p. 261

Chapter Title: GARMENTS PERMISSIBLE FOR PRAYER AND WHAT GARMENTS ARE NOT
arabic_text:
«إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ لا يَجُوزُ لِلرَّجُلِ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ وَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ سَيْفٌ لِأَنّ الْقِبْلَةَ أَمْنَ » رُوِيَ ذَلِكَ عَنْ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ.
english_text:
"It is not permissible for a man to pray while there is a sword in front of him,
because the Qibla is a place of security."
This was narrated from The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s}.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: GARMENTS PERMISSIBLE FOR PRAYER AND WHAT GARMENTS ARE NOT
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ عَلِيْ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ أَخَاهُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السِّلاَمُ عَنِ الرّجُلِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ وَ أَمَامَهُ
مِشجَبٌ عَلَيْهِ ثِيَابٌ فَقَالَ «لاَ بَأْسَ.
english_text:
Ali ibn Ja'far asked his brother Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} about
whether it is permissible for a man to pray while there is a rack with clothes hanging
on it in front of him.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
references: Masa’il Ali ibn Ja’far, Part 1, p. 222 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 250

Chapter Title: GARMENTS PERMISSIBLE FOR PRAYER AND WHAT GARMENTS ARE NOT
arabic_text: - وَ سَأْلَهُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي وَ أَمَامَهُ ثُومٌ أَوْ بَصَلٌ قَالَ «لَاَ بَأْسَ.
english_text:
He (Ali ibn Ja'far) asked him (Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s}) about a man
praying while there is garlic or onion in front of him.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: GARMENTS PERMISSIBLE FOR PRAYER AND WHAT GARMENTS ARE NOT
arabic_text: - وَ سَأَلَهُ: عَنِ الرَّجْلِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَى الرَّطْبَةِ النَّابِئَةِ قَالَ «إِذَا أَلْصَقَ جَبْهَتَهُ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ فَلاَ بَأْسَ.
english_text:
He (Ali ibn Ja'far) asked him (Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s}) about
whether it is permissible for a man to pray on growing vegetation (fresh grass).
Imam {a.s} said: "If he places his forehead on the ground, then there is no harm."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: GARMENTS PERMISSIBLE FOR PRAYER AND WHAT GARMENTS ARE NOT
arabic_text: - وَ سَأَلَهُ: عَنِ الصَّلاةِ عَلَى ٱلْحَشِيشِ النَّابِتِ أَوِ التِّيَّلِ وَ هُوَ يُصِيبُ أَرْضاً جَدَداً قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ.
english_text:
He (Ali ibn Ja'far) asked him (Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s}) about praying
on growing grass or lush greenery that covers fresh ground.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: GARMENTS PERMISSIBLE FOR PRAYER AND WHAT GARMENTS ARE NOT
arabic_text:
وَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ وَ السِّرَاجُ مَوْضُوعُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فِي الْقِبْلَةِ قَالَ «لا يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَسْتَقْبِلَ
اَلنَّارَ.
هذا هو الأصل الذي يجب أن يعمل به.
english_text:
He (Ali ibn Ja'far) asked about whether it is permissible for a man to pray with
a lamp (or flame) placed in front of him in the direction of the Qibla.
Imam {a.s} said: "It is not permissible for him to face the fire."
commentary: This is the principle that should be adhered to.
references: Masa’il Ali ibn Ja’far, Part 1, p. 226 • Qurb al-Isnad, Part 1, p. 187 • Man La Yahduruhu Al- Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 250 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 225 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 396 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 461 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 166

Chapter Title: GARMENTS PERMISSIBLE FOR PRAYER AND WHAT GARMENTS ARE NOT
arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا الْحَدِيثُ الَّذِي رُوِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ الرَّجُلُ وَ النَّارُ وَ السِّرَاجُ
وَ الصُّورَةُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ لِأَنَّ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي لَهُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنَ الَّذِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ.
فهو حديث يروى عن ثلاثة من المجهولين باسناد منقطع يرويه الحسن بن علي الكوفي وهو معروف، عن الحسين بن
عمرو، عن أبيه، عن عمرو بن إبراهيم الهمداني وهم مجهولون يرفع الحديث قال: قال أبو عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام ذلك، ولكنها
رخصة اقترنت بها علة صدرت عن ثقات ثم اتصلت بالمجهولين والانقطاع فمن أخذ بها لم يكن مخطئا، بعد أن يعلم أن
الأصل هو النهي، وأن الاطلاق هو رخصة، والرخصة رحمة.
english_text:
As for the narration reported from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}
stating: "There is no harm if a man prays while the fire, the lamp, or an image is in front
of him, for the One to whom he is praying is closer to him than that which is in front of
him,"
commentary:
It is a narration transmitted through three unknown individuals with an interrupted
chain. It is narrated by Hasan ibn Ali al-Kufi, from Hussain ibn Amr, from his father,
from Amr ibn Ibrahim al-Hamdani, all of whom are unknown.
The narration is attributed to Abu 'Abdillah {a.s}. However, it is considered a concession
accompanied by a justification given by trustworthy sources but later connected
through unknown and interrupted chains. Thus, whoever acts upon it is not mistaken,
knowing that the default rule is to avoid it, while the permissibility is a concession, and
the concession is a mercy.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 250 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 2, p. 342 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 226 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 396 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 461 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 167 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 80, p. 296

Chapter Title: GARMENTS PERMISSIBLE FOR PRAYER AND WHAT GARMENTS ARE NOT
arabic_text: - وَ سُئِلَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: عَنِ الصَّلَاَةِ فِي الْقَلَنْسُوَةِ السَّوْدَاءِ فَقَالَ «لا تُصَلَّ فِيهَا فَإِنَّهَا لِبَاسُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ.
english_text:
Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about praying while wearing a black cap.
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not pray in it, for it is the attire of the people of the Fire”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: GARMENTS PERMISSIBLE FOR PRAYER AND WHAT GARMENTS ARE NOT
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فِيمَا عَلْمَ أَصْحَابَهُ: «لا تَلْبَسُوا السِّوَادَ فَإِنَّهُ لِبَاسُ فِرْعَوْنَ.
english_text:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said in what he taught
his companions: "Do not wear black, for it is the clothing of Pharaoh."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 251 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 2, p. 346 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 4, p. 383 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 80, p. 248

Chapter Title: GARMENTS PERMISSIBLE FOR PRAYER AND WHAT GARMENTS ARE NOT
arabic_text: - وَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يَكْرَهُ السَّوَادَ إِلاَّ فِي ثَلاَثَةِ ٱلْعِمَامَةِ وَ الْخُفَّ وَ ٱلْكِسَاءِ.
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} disliked wearing black except in three cases: the
turban, the shoes, and the cloak.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 251 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 2, p. 347 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 80, p. 249
