اَلنَّبِيِّينَ وَ إِلَهِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَ رَبِّ الْمُسْتَصْعَفِينَ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَهِ الَّذِي يُحْيِ الْمَوْتى وَ هُوَ عَلى كُلَّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرً» فَإِنَّهُ إِذَا
قَالَ ذَلِكَ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وتَعَالَى صَدَقَ عَبْدِي وَ شَكَرَ.
english_text:
Jarraḥ al-Mada'ini reported from Abu Abdullah {a.s} who said: "When one of you
rises (from sleep), let him say:
'Glory be to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of the Prophets, the God of the Messengers, and the
Lord {AZJ} of the oppressed. All praise is due to Allah {SWT}, who gives life to the dead and
who has power over all things.'
When he says this, Allah {SWT}, Blessed and Exalted, says,
'My servant has spoken the truth and expressed gratitude.'"
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 2, p. 538 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 480 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 9, p. 1591 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 84, p. 187 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 4, p. 151

Chapter Title: WHAT A PERSON SHOULD SAY UPON WAKING FROM SLEEP
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْحَجَّاجِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا قَامَ آخِرَ اللَّيْلِ رَفَعَ صَوْتَهُ
حَتَى يَسْمَعَ أَهْلُ الدَّارِ وَ يَقُولُ: اللّهُمْ أَعِنِّي عَلَى هَوْلِ ٱلْمُطَّلَعِ وَ وَسِّعْ عَلَيَ ٱلْمَضْجَعَ وَ أرْزَقْنِي خَيْرَ مَا قَبْلَ ٱلْمَوْتِ
وَأَرْزُقْنِي خَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَ ٱلْمَوْتِ.
english_text:
Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj reports from Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} that when he
would rise in the last part of the night, he would raise his voice such that the people of
the household could hear and say: "O’ Allah {SWT}, help me with the terror of the Rising
(on the Day of Judgment), make my resting place spacious, grant me the best of what
comes before death, and grant me the best of what comes after death."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, V. 1, p. 480 • Al-Wafi, V. 9, p. 1592 • Bihar Al-Anwar, V. 84, p. 192

Chapter Title: WHAT A PERSON SHOULD SAY UPON WAKING FROM SLEEP
arabic_text:
وَ فِي خَبَرٍ آخَرَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا قُمْتَ مِنْ فِرَاشِكَ فَانْظُرْ فِي أُفُقِ السِّمَاءِ وَ قُلِ
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ اَلَّذِي رَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوجِي أَعْبُدُهُ وَ أَحْمَدُهُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ لا يُوَارِي مِنْكَ لَيْلٌ سَاجٍ وَ لا سَمَاءُ ذَاتُ أَبْرَاجِ وَ لاَ أَرْضٌ
ذَاتُ مِهَادٍ وَ لا «كَظُلُماتٍ بَعْضُها قَوْقَ بَعْضٍ» وَ لاَ بَحْرْ لُجِّيّ يُذْلِجُ بَيْنَ يَدَي الْمُذْلِحِ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ تَعلَمُ «خَائِئَةَ ٱلْأَعِيْنِ
وَ مَا ثَخْفِي الصُّدُورُ» غَارَتِ النُجُومُ وَ نَامَتِ الْعُيُونُ وَ أَنْتَ «آَلْحَيْ الْقَيُومُ» لاَ تَأْخُذُكَ «سِنَةٌ وَ لا نَوْمْ» «سُبْحَانَ
اللهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ» وَ إِلَهِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَ خَالِقِ النّبِيِّينَ «وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلْهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ» اللَّهُمَّ اِغْفِزْ لِي وَ اِرْحَمْنِي وَ ثُبْ
عَلَيَّ «إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ» ثُمَّ اِقْرَأْ خَمْسَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ آخِرٍ آلِ عِمْرَانَ «إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السِّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ» إلَى
قَوْلِهِ «إِنَّكَ لا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعادَ»
وعليك بالسواك فإن السواك في السحر قبل الوضوء من السنة، ثم توضأ.
english_text:
In another report from Abu Ja'far {a.s}, He said:
"When you rise from your bed, look to the horizon of the sky and say:
'All praise is due to Allah {SWT}, who has returned my soul to me; I worship Him and
praise Him. O’ Allah {SWT}, neither a dark night nor a sky full of constellations nor an
earth with layers nor layers of darkness nor a vast sea that flows can conceal from You.
You know the betrayal of the eyes and what the hearts conceal. The stars have set, and
the eyes have closed, yet You are the Living, the Self-subsisting, whom neither
slumber nor sleep overtakes. Glory be to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of the worlds, the God
of the Messengers, the Creator of the Prophets, and all praise is due to Him, Allah {SWT},
the Lord {AZJ} of the worlds. O’ Allah {SWT}, forgive me, have mercy on me, and accept my
repentance; surely, You are the Most Accepting of Repentance, the Most Merciful.'
Then recite the last five verses of Surah Al-Imran:
Inna fī khalqi as-samāwāti wa al-arḍi ' to Innaka lā tukhlifu al-mī‘ād "
commentary:
He also emphasized using a siwak (tooth-stick) before ablution during the pre-dawn
hours, as it is a sunnah, then perform ablution.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: WHAT A PERSON SHOULD SAY UPON WAKING FROM SLEEP
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ الْحَذَّاءُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: فِي قَوْلِ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ «تَتَجَافِى جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ
الْمَضاجِعِ » فَقَالَ «لَعَلَّكَ تَرَى أَنَّ الْقَوْمَ لَمْ يَكُونُوا يَنَامُونَ» فَقُلْتُ اللهُ وَ رَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ فَقَالَ «لا بُدَّ لِهَذَا الْبَدَنِ أَنْ
تُرِيحَهُ حَتَّى يَخْرُجَ نَفْسُهُ فَإِذَا خَرَجَ النَّفْسُ اِسْتَرَاحَ الْبَدَنُ وَ رَجَعَتِ الرُوحُ فِيهِ وَ فِيهِ قُوَّةُ عَلَى الْعَمَلِ فَإِنَّمَا
ذَكَرَهُمْ فَقَالَ: «تَتَجَافِى جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفاً وَ طَمَعاً» أَنْزِلَتْ فِي أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ ٱَلسِّلاَمُ
وَ أَثْبَاعِهِ مِنْ شِيعَتِنَا يَنَامُونَ فِي أَوَّلِ اللّيْلِ فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ ثُلُثَا اللَّيْلِ أَوْ مَا شَاءَ اللّهُ فَزِعُوا إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ رَاغِبِينَ رَاهِبِينَ
طَامِعِينَ فِيمَا عِنْدَهُ فَذَكَرَهُمُ اللّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فِي كِتَابِهِ لِنَبِيِّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَ أَخْبَرَهُمْ بِمَا أَعْطَاهُمْ وَ أَنَّهُ أَسْكَنَهُمْ فِي
جِوَارِهِ وَ أَدْخَلَهُمْ جَنّتَهُ وَ آمَنَ خَوْفَهُمْ وَ آمَنَ رَوْعَتَهُمْ» قُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنْ أَنَا قُمْتُ فِي آجِرِ اللَّيْلِ أَيِّ شَيْءٍ
أَقُولُ إِذَا قُمْتُ فَقَالَ «قُلِ «الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ» وَ إِلَهِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ اَلَّذِي «يُحي الْمَوْتى» وَ «يَبْعَثُ
مَنْ فِي الْقُبُورِ» فَإِنَّكَ إِذَا قُلْتَهَا ذَهَبَ عَنْكَ رِجْزُ الشَّيْطَانِ وَ وَسْوَاسُهُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى.
english_text:
Abu Ubaydah al-Haddha’ reported from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}
regarding the verse of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted,
"Their sides forsake their beds" (Surah As-Sajdah 32:16).
Abu Ja’far {a.s} said: "Perhaps you think that these people did not sleep?"
I replied: "Allah {SWT} and His Messenger know best."
Imam {a.s} said: "This body must be allowed rest so that the soul can depart and the
body can rejuvenate. When the soul returns, it restores the body's strength for action.
This verse refers to those who rest their bodies but then rise in devotion, praying to
their Lord {AZJ} out of fear and hope.
This was revealed concerning The Commander of the Faithful {a.s} and his followers
among our Shia. They sleep in the early part of the night, then when two-thirds of the
night have passed or as much as Allah {SWT} wills, they hasten to their Lord {AZJ}, desiring
Him, fearing Him, and hoping for what He has. Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic,
mentioned them in His Book to His Prophet {saws} and informed them of what He had
granted them - settling them near Him, entering them into His Paradise, granting them
security from fear, and calming their dread."
I said: "May I be your ransom, if I rise during the last part of the night, what should I
say?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Say, 'All praise is due to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of the worlds, the God
of the Messengers. All praise is due to Allah {SWT}, who gives life to the dead and
resurrects those in the graves.' When you say this, the evil whisperings of Shaytan will
depart from you, if Allah {SWT} wills."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 481 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 9, p. 1593 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, vol. 4, p. 393

Chapter Title: THE SAYING WHEN THE ROOSTER CROWS
arabic_text:
باب - القول عند صراخ الديك
قَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «إِذَا سَمِعْتَ صُرَاخَ الدِّيكِ فَقُلْ، سُبُوحْ قُدُّوس رَبُّ ٱلْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَ الرُّوحِ سَبَقَتْ
رَحْمَتُكَ عَضَّبَكَ لا إِلَهَ إِلا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ وَ بِحَمْدِكَ عَمِلْتُ سُوءاً وَ «ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي» إِنَّهُ لا يَغْفِرُ الذُنُوبَ
إلاَّ أَنْتَ.
english_text:
Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "When you hear the crowing of the rooster, say:
'Glorified and Holy is the Lord {AZJ} of the angels and the spirit; Your mercy has preceded
Your wrath; there is no god but You; glory and praise be to You. I have acted badly and
wronged myself, so forgive me. Indeed, no one forgives sins except You.'".
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 482 • Makarem al-Akhlaq, Part 1, p. 293 • Meftah al- Falah, Part 1, p. 285 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 9, p. 1593 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 20, p. 863 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p. 35 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 84, p. 184

Chapter Title: THE SAYING WHEN THE ROOSTER CROWS
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: «تَعَلِّمُوا مِنَ الدِّيكِ خَمْسَ خِصَالٍ مُحَافَظَتَهُ عَلَى أَوْقَاتِ الصّلاَةِ وَ الْغَيْرَةَ وَ ٱلسَّخَاءَ
وَ الشَّجَاعَةَ وَ كَثْرَةَ الطَّرُوقَةِ.
english_text:
Imam {a.s} said: "Learn five qualities from the rooster: its adherence to the
timing of prayers, its protective jealousy (for its mate), its generosity, its courage, and
its frequent crowing (indicating vigilance)”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 482 • Makarem al-Akhlaq, Part 1, p. 293 • Wasail Al- Shia, Vol. 20, p. 242 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 62, p. 3

Chapter Title: THE SAYING WHEN THE ROOSTER CROWS
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ: «تَعَلَّمُوا مِنَ ٱلْغُرَابِ ثَلاَثَ خِصَالٍ اِسْتِتَارَهُ بِالسِّفَادِ وَ بُكُورَهُ فِي طَلَبِ الرِّزْقِ وَ حَذَرَهُ.
english_text:
Imam {a.s} said: "Learn three qualities from the crow: its concealment when
mating, its early rising in seeking sustenance, and its cautiousness."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 482 • Al-Khasal, Part 1, p. 99 • Uyūn al-Akhbār, Part 1, p. 257 • Al-Waezin, volume 2, page 456 • Makarem al-Akhlaq, Part 1, p. 293 • Kashf al-Ghummah, Part 2, p. 293 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 4, p. 266 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 17, p. 78 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 20, p. 133 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 20, p. 133

Chapter Title: THE SAYING WHEN THE ROOSTER CROWS
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ: «إِنَّ لِلَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وتَعَالَى مَلَكاً عَلَى صُورَةِ دِيكٍ أَبْيَضَ رَأْسُهُ تَحْتَ ٱلْعَرْشِ وَ
رِجْلَاَهُ فِي تُخُومِ الْأَرْضِ السَّابِعَةِ لَهُ جَنَاحْ فِي الْمَشِرِقِ وَ جَنَاحٌ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ لا تَصِيحُ الدُّيُوكُ حَتَّى يَصِيحَ فَإِذَا
صَاحَ خَفَقَ بِجَنَاحَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ سُبْحَانَ اللّهِ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْعَظِيمِ الَّذِي «لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ» قَالَ فَيُجِيبُهُ
اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وتَعَالَى وَ يَقُولُ لاَ يَحْلِفُ بِي كَاذِباً مَنْ يَعْرِفُ مَا تَقُولُ.
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"Indeed, Allah {SWT}, Blessed and Exalted, has an angel in the form of a white rooster. Its
head is beneath the Throne, and its feet are in the depths of the seventh earth. It has a
wing in the east and a wing in the west. The earthly roosters do not crow until this angel
crows. When it crows, it flaps its wings and says,
'Glory be to Allah {SWT}, Glory be to Allah {SWT}, Glory be to Allah {SWT}, the Great, who is
unlike anything.'
Allah {SWT}, Blessed and Exalted, responds and says;
'One who knows what you say will not swear falsely by Me.'".
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 482 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 26, p. 505 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 3, p. 613 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol. 9, p. 325

Chapter Title: THE SAYING WHEN THE ROOSTER CROWS
arabic_text: - وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّ فِيهِ نَزَلَتْ «وَ الطَّيْرُ صَافَاتٍ كُلُّ قَدْ عَلِمَ صَلاتَهُ وَ تَسْبِيحَهُ» »
english_text:
It is narrated: "Concerning this, the verse was revealed: 'And the birds with
wings outspread; each knows its prayer and its glorification.'".
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 483 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol. 9, p. 325

Chapter Title: THE SAYING WHEN STANDING UP FOR THE NIGHT PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّ حَمَلَةَ الْعَرْشِ الْيَوْمَ أَرْبَعَةٌ وَاحِدٌ مِنْهُمْ عَلَى صُورَةِ الدِّيكِ يَسْتَرْزِقُ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لِلطَّيْرِ وَ
وَاجِدٌ عَلَى صُورَةِ الْأَسَدِ يَسْتَرْزِقُ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى لِلسِّبَاعِ وَ وَاجِدٌ عَلَى صُورَةِ اَلثَّوْرِ يَسْتَرْزِقُ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى لِلْبَهَائِمِ وَ وَاحِدٌ
مِنْهُمْ عَلَى صُورَةِ بَنِي آدَمَ يَسْتَرْزِقُ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى لِوُلْدِ آدَمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ صَارُوا ثَمَانِيَةً قَالَ اللَّهُ
عَزَّ وَ جَلّ: « وَ يَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَانِيَةَ »
english_text:
It is narrated: "The carriers of the Throne today are four:
One of them is in the form of a rooster, who seeks sustenance from Allah {SWT}, the
Exalted, for the birds;
Another is in the form of a lion, who seeks sustenance from Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, for
the wild animals;
Another is in the form of a bull, who seeks sustenance from Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, for
the livestock;
And one is in the form of a human being, who seeks sustenance from Allah {SWT}, the
Exalted, for the children of Adam.
On the Day of Resurrection, they will become eight, as Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, has said:
'And the Throne of your Lord {AZJ} will be borne above them, on that Day, by eight' (Surah
Al-Haqqah 69:17)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 483 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 26, p. 506

Chapter Title: THE SAYING WHEN STANDING UP FOR THE NIGHT
arabic_text:
باب - القول عند القيام إلى صلاة الليل
قَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «إِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَقُومَ إلَى صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ فَقُلِ: اَللَّهُمَ إِنِّي أَتَوَجَهُ إِلَيْكَ بِنَبِيَّكَ نَبِيّ
الرَّحْمَةِ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَقَدَّمُهُمْ بَيْنَ يَدَي حَوَائِجِي فَاجْعَلْنِي بِهِمْ «وَجِيها فِي الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ وَ مِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ» اللّهُمْ
اِرْحَمْنِي بِهِمْ وَلَا تُعَذَّبْنِي بِهِمْ، وَ اِهْدِنِي بِهِمْ وَلَا تُصِلِّنِي بِهِمْ وَ أُرْزُقْنِي بِهِمْ وَ لَا تَحْرِمْنِي بِهِمْ وَ اِقْضِ لِي حَوَائِجِي
لِلدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ «إِنَّكَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ» وَ «بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ».
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"When you wish to stand for the night prayer, say:
'O’ Allah {SWT}, I turn to You by Your Prophet, the Prophet of Mercy, and his family, and I
present them before my needs. Make me, through them, 'honorable in this world and
the Hereafter, and among those brought near (to You).'
‘ O’ Allah {SWT}, have mercy on me through them, do not punish me through them, guide
me through them, do not lead me astray through them, provide for me through them,
and do not deprive me through them. Fulfil my needs for this world and the Hereafter,
for indeed, You have power over all things and You have knowledge of all things.'"
commentary:
It is from the Sunnah to face the Qiblah in six prayers: the first unit (Rak'ah) of the night
prayer (Salat al-Layl), the single unit (Rak'ah) of Witr, the first unit of the two Rak'ahs
of noon (Zawal), the first unit of the two Rak'ahs of Ihram, the first unit of the Nawafil
(supererogatory) prayers after Maghrib, and the first unit of the obligatory (fardh)
prayer, as mentioned by my father (may Allah {SWT} be pleased with him) in his message
to me.
Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, said to His Prophet {saws}:
"And during the night, pray Tahajjud beyond what is obligatory for you, so that your Lord
{AZJ} may raise you to a praised station" (Surah Al-Isra 17:79).
Thus, the night prayer (Tahajjud) became an obligation upon the Messenger of Allah
{saws} due to the command of Allah {SWT}: 'And during the night, pray Tahajjud.' For others,
however, it remains a Sunnah and a supererogatory act.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 483 • Meftah al- Falah, Part 1, p. 307 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 345 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 636 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 84, p. 243 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 4, p. 152 Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 484 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 102 Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE NIGHT PRAYER
arabic_text:
باب - الصلوات التي جرت السنة بالتوجه فيهن
من السنة التوجه في ست صلوات وهي أول ركعة من صلاة الليل، والمفردة من الوتر وأول ركعة من ركعتي الزوال، وأول
ركعة من ركعتي الاحرام، و أول ركعة من نوافل المغرب، وأول ركعة من الفريضة كذلك ذكره أبي رضي اللّٰه عنه في رسالته
إلي.
باب - صلاة الليل
قال الله تبارك وتعالى لنبيه صلى اللّٰه عليه وآله: " ومن الليل فتهجد به نافلة لك عسى أن يبعثك ربك مقاما محمودا "
فصارت صلاة الليل فريضة على رسول اللّٰه صلى اللّٰه عليه وآله لقول اللّٰه عز وجل فتهجد، وهي لغيرة سنة ونافلة.
وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فِي وَصِيَّتِهِ لِعَلِيّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «يَا عَلِيّ عَلَيْكَ بِصَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ وَ عَلَيْكَ
بِصَلَاَةِ اللّيْلِ وَ عَلَيْكَ بِصَلاَةِ ٱَللَّيْلِ.
فإذا أردت أن تصليها فكبر اللّٰه عز وجل سبعا، واحمده سبعا، ثم توجه ثم صل ركعتين تقرأ في الأولى الحمد وقل هو اللّٰه
أحد، وفي الثانية الحمد وقل يا أيها الكافرون، وتقرأ في الست الركعات بما أحببت إن شئت طولت وإن شئت قصرت.
english_text:
The Prophet {saws} said in his advice to Imam Ali {a.s}: "O’ Ali, adhere to the night
prayer, adhere to the night prayer, adhere to the night prayer”.
commentary:
When you intend to perform it, begin by saying "Allahu Akbar" (God is the Greatest)
seven times, praise Him seven times, then recite the opening supplication (Du'a
Iftitah), and proceed to pray two units (Rak'ahs).
In the first Rak'ah, recite Surah Al-Fatiha followed by Surah Al-Ikhlas ("Say: He is Allah
{SWT}, the One").
In the second Rak'ah, recite Surah Al-Fatiha followed by Surah Al-Kafirun ("Say: O’
disbelievers"). For the remaining six Rak'ahs, you may recite whatever you wish; you
may lengthen or shorten as you like.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE NIGHT PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّ مَنْ قَرَأَ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَوْلَتَيْنِ مِنْ صَلاةِ اللَّيْلِ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ مِنْهُمَا الْحَمْدَ مَرَّةً وَ «قُلْ هُوَ
اللهُ أَحَدٌ» ثَلاَثِينَ مَرَّةً اِنْفَتَلَ وَ لَيْسَ بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ ذَنْبٌ إِلَّ غَفَرَ لَهُ.
وتقر في ركعتي الشفع وركعة الوتر قل هو اللّٰه أحد، وافصل بين الشفع والوتر بتسليمة.
english_text:
It is narrated:
"Whoever recites Surah Al-Fatiha once and 'Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad' (Surah Al-Ikhlas)
thirty times in each of the first two Rak'ahs of the night prayer, he will finish his prayer
without any sin remaining between him and Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Glorious, except
that He forgives it”.
commentary:
In the two Rak'ahs of Shaf' (a pair prayer) and the single Rak'ah of Witr, recite 'Qul
Huwa Allahu Ahad' (Surah Al-Ikhlas), and separate between the Shaf' and Witr prayers
with the concluding Tasleem (salutation of peace).
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 485 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 124 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 668 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p. 129 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, vol. 5, p. 796

Chapter Title: THE NIGHT PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيّ: «أَنَّ مَنْ قَرَأَ فِي الْوَثْرِ بِالْمُعَوِّدَّتَيْنِ وَ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» قِيلَ لَهُ أَبْشِرْ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ فَقَدْ قَبِلَ اللَّهُ
وَثْرَكَ.
والقنوت في كل ركعتين في الثانية قبل الركوع وبعد القراءة، والقراءة بها جهارا. والقنوت في الوتر قبل الركوع. وإن قمت
ولم يكن عليك من الوقت بقدر ما تصلي فيه صلاة الليل على ما تريد فصلها وأدرجها إدراجا ، والادراج أن تقرأ في كل
ركعة الحمد وحدها، فإن خشيت طلوع الفجر فصل ركعتين وأوتر بالثالثة، وإن طلع الفجر فصل ركعتي الفجر وقد مضى
الوقت بما فيه. وإذا صليت من صلاة الليل أربع ركعات من قبل طلوع الفجر فأتم الصلاة طلع الفجر أو لم يطلع. وقد رويت
رخصة في أن يصلي الرجل صلاة الليل بعد طلوع الفجر المرة بعد المرة، ولا يتخذ ذلك عادة. وإذا كان عليك قضاء صلاة
الليل فقمت وعليك من الوقت بقدر ما تصلي الفائتة وصلاة ليلتك فابدأ بالفائتة فصل ثم صل صلاة ليلتك، فإن كان الوقت
بقدر ما تصلي واحدة فصل صلاة ليلتك لئلا تصيرا جميعا قضاء، ثم اقض الصلاة الفائتة من الغد أو بعد ذلك.
english_text:
It is narrated :
"Whoever recites in the Witr prayer the two protective chapters (Surah Al-Falaq and
Surah An-Nas) and 'Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad' (Surah Al-Ikhlas), it will be said to him,
'Rejoice, O’ servant of Allah {SWT}, for Allah {SWT} has accepted your Witr.'"
commentary:
The Qunoot (supplication) is to be performed in every two Rak'ahs, specifically in the
second Rak'ah, before bowing (Ruku') and after the recitation, and it should be done
aloud. The Qunoot is also performed in the Witr prayer before bowing.
If you stand for prayer but do not have enough time to perform the entire night prayer
as intended, then perform it in a summarized form, meaning recite only Surah Al-
Fatiha in each Rak'ah. If you fear the approach of Fajr, perform two Rak'ahs and
complete the Witr with a third. If Fajr has begun, perform the two Rak'ahs of Fajr
prayer as soon as time permits.
If you have managed to pray four Rak'ahs of the night prayer before Fajr, continue
and complete the remaining prayers, whether Fajr has begun or not. There is a
concession for offering the night prayer after Fajr has begun on occasion, but it
should not become habitual.
If you have missed the night prayer and have enough time upon waking to perform both
the missed and current night's prayer, begin with the missed prayer and then perform
the current one. If there is only enough time for one, perform the current night prayer
so that neither becomes overdue, and then make up the missed prayer later, either on
the next day or thereafter.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 485 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 668

Chapter Title: THE SUPPLICATION OF QUNOOT IN WITR PRAYER
arabic_text:
باب - دعاء قنوت الوتر
كَانَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يَقُولُ فِي قُنُوتِ الْوَثْرِ « اللَّهُمَّ اِهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ وَ عَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَاقَيْتَ
وَتَوَلِّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلِّيْتَ وَ بَارِك لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَ قِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ فَإِنَّكَ نَقْضِي وَ لاَ يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ سُبْحَانَكَ رَبِّ
الْبَيْتِ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَ أَثُوبُ إِلَيْكَ وَ أُومِنُ بِكَ وَ أَتَوَكِّلُ عَلَيْكَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لا قُوْةَ إِلاَّ بِكَ يَا رَجِيمُ.
english_text:
The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him and his family, would say in
the Qunoot (supplication) of the Witr prayer:
"O’ Allah {SWT}, guide me among those You have guided, and grant me well-being among
those You have granted well-being to, and take me under Your care among those You
have taken into Your care, and bless me in what You have given, and protect me from
the evil of what You have decreed. Indeed, You decree and no one can decree over
You. Glory be to You, Lord {AZJ} of the House. I seek Your forgiveness and I turn to You in
repentance. I believe in You and rely upon You. There is no power nor strength except
with You, O’ Most Merciful."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 487 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 761

Chapter Title: THE SUPPLICATION OF QUNOOT IN WITR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «أَطْوَلُكُمْ قُنُوتاً فِي دَارِ الدُّنْيَا أَطْوَلُكُمْ رَاحَةً يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ فِي
الْمَوْقِفن
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws}, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"The one who prolongs their Qunoot (supplication during prayer) the longest in this
worldly life will be granted the longest rest on the Day of Resurrection at the Standing
(before Allah {SWT})”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 487 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al-A’mal, Part 1, p. 33 • Al-Amali (by Al-Saduq) Vol. 1, p. 509 • Al-Waezin, volume 2, page 328 • Sulwat al-Hazin, Part 1, p. 254 • Meftah al-Falah, Part 1, p. 309 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 757 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p. 291 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p. 292 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 7, p. 303

Chapter Title: THE SUPPLICATION OF QUNOOT IN WITR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «الْقُنُوتُ فِي يَوْمِ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ تَمْجِيدُ اللَّهِ وَ الصَّلاَةُ عَلَى نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ وَ كَلِمَاتُ
اَلْفَرَجِن
ثم هذا الدعاء .والقنوت في الوتر كقنوتك يوم الجمعة، ثم تقول قبل دعائك لنفسك:" اللهم تم نورك فهديت فلك الحمد
ربنا ، وبسطت يدك فأعطيت فلك الحمد ربنا، وعظم حلمك فعفوت فلك الحمد ربنا، وجهك أكرم الوجوه وجهتك خير
الجهات وعطيتك أفضل العطيات وأهنؤها، تطاع ربنا فتشكر، وتعصى ربنا فتغفر لمن شئت، تجيب المضطر وتكشف الضر
وتشفي السقيم وتنجي من الكرب العظيم، لا يجزي بالآئك أحد ولا يحصي نعمائك قول قائل، اللهم إليك رفعت الابصار
ونقلت الاقدام، ومدت الأعناق، ورفعت الأيدي، ودعيت بالألسن وإليك سرهم ونجواهم في الأعمال ، ربنا اغفر لنا وارحمنا
وافتح بيننا وبين قومنا بالحق وأنت خير الفاتحين، اللهم إنا نشكو إليك غيبة نبينا عنا ، وشدة الزمان علينا، ووقوع الفتن
بنا، وتظاهر الأعداء علينا وكثرة عدونا وقلة عددنا فرج ذلك يا رب بفتح منك تعجله، ونصر منك تعزه، وإمام عدل تظهره
إليه الحق رب العالمين " ثم تقول: أستغفر اللّٰه ربي وأتوب إليه سبعين مرة وتعوذ باللّه من النار كثيرا.
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"The Qunoot (supplication during prayer) on the Day of Jumu’ah consists of glorifying
Allah {SWT}, sending blessings upon the Prophet of Allah {SWT}, and words of relief
(Kalimatu-l-Faraj)”.
commentary:
In the Qunoot of Witr prayer, say as you do on Jumu’ah, and then say before
supplicating for yourself:
'O’ Allah {SWT}, Your Light has completed and guided, so for You is praise, our Lord {AZJ}.
You have extended Your Hand and granted, so for You is praise, our Lord {AZJ}. Your
forbearance has magnified, so You forgave, for You is praise, our Lord {AZJ}.
Your Face (The Aimmah {a.s}) is the most honored of faces, Your direction the best of
directions, and Your gifts the finest and most delightful. You are obeyed, our Lord {AZJ},
and You are thankful; You are disobeyed, our Lord {AZJ}, and You forgive whom You wish.
You respond to the distressed, relieve hardship, cure the ill, and save from severe
trials. None can fully recompense Your blessings or enumerate Your gifts,
O’ Allah {SWT}. To You the eyes have turned, the steps have walked, the necks have been
raised, the hands have been lifted, and tongues have called You. And to You belongs
their secrets and declarations in deeds.
Our Lord {AZJ}, forgive us and have mercy upon us, and decide between us and our
people in truth, for You are the best of deciders. O’ Allah {SWT}, we complain to You of
the absence of our Prophet from among us, the difficulty of the time upon us, the
occurrence of trials with us, the intensification of enemies against us, and our few
numbers against their many.
Grant relief, O’ Lord {AZJ}, through a hastened opening from You, a victory You make
strong, and a just Imam to whom You show truth, O’ Lord {AZJ} of the worlds.'"
Then, say: "I seek Allah’s {SWT} forgiveness, my Lord {AZJ}, and I repent to Him" seventy
times and seek refuge in Allah {SWT} often from the Fire.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE SUPPLICATION OF QUNOOT IN WITR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى عُمَرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مَنْ قَالَ فِي وَثْرِهِ إِذَا أَوْتَرَ: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
رَبِّي وَ أَثُوبُ إِلَيْهِ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً وَ وَاظَبَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ حَتَّى تَمْضِيَ سَنَةً كَتَبَهُ اللَّهُ عِنْدَهُ مِنَ «الْمُسْتَغْفِرِينَ بِالْأَسْحَارِ»
وَ وَجَبَثْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةُ وَ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةُ مِنَ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ.
english_text:
It is narrated from Umar ibn Yazid that Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Whoever says during his Witr prayer (while performing the single-unit prayer of Witr)
'Astaghfirullah Rabbi wa Atubu Ilayh' (I seek forgiveness from Allah {SWT}, my Lord {AZJ},
and I turn to Him in repentance) seventy times, and continues to do so regularly until
a year passes, Allah {SWT} will write him among 'those who seek forgiveness in the early
hours of the morning,' and Paradise and forgiveness from Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and
Glorious, will become obligatory for him."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 489 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p. 279

Chapter Title: THE SUPPLICATION OF QUNOOT IN WITR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى عَبْدُ اللّهِ بْنُ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «اِسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ فِي الْوَثْرِ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً
تَنْصِبُ يَدَكَ الْيُسْرَى وَ تَعُدُّ بِالْيُمْنَى الإِسْتِغْفَارَ وَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ فِي الْوَثْرِ
سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً وَ يَقُولُ» «هَذَا مَقَامُ ٱلْعَائِذِ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ.
english_text:
It is narrated from Abdullah ibn Abi Ya’fur that Abu Abdullah {a.s} said:
"Seek forgiveness from Allah {SWT} during the Witr prayer seventy times, while raising
your left hand and counting the invocations with your right hand.
The Messenger of Allah {saws} and his family, used to seek forgiveness from Allah {SWT} in
the Witr prayer seventy times and would say,
'This is the position of one seeking refuge in You from the Fire,' seven times."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 489 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 759

Chapter Title: THE SUPPLICATION OF QUNOOT IN WITR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «تَدْعُو فِي الْوَثْرِ عَلَى الْعَدُوِّ وَ إِنْ شِئْتَ
سَمَّيْتَهُمْ وَ تَسْتَغْفِرُ وَ تَرْفَعُ يَدَيْكَ فِي الْوَثْرِ جِيَالَ وَجْهِكَ وَ إِنْ شِئْتَ فَتَحْتَ ثَوْبَكَ.
english_text:
It is narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan that Abu Abdullah Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s}
said: "You may supplicate against the enemy during the Witr prayer, and if you wish,
you may name them specifically. You should seek forgiveness, raising your hands
during the Witr prayer level with your face, or, if you wish, you may open your cloak
(covering) while doing so”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 489 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 131 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 758

Chapter Title: THE SUPPLICATION OF QUNOOT IN WITR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ كَانَ عَلِي بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ سَيِّدُ الْعَابِدِينَ يَقُولُ: «الْعَفْوَ الْعَفْوَ» تَلاَثَمِائَةِ مَرَّةٍ فِي الْوَثْرِ فِي
السَّحر
english_text:
It is narrated that Imam Ali ibn al-Hussain {a.s}, the Master of Worshippers (Zain
al-Abidin), used to say, "Al-‘Afw, Al-‘Afw (Pardon, Pardon)" three hundred times during
the Witr prayer at the time of Suhoor (the pre-dawn hours).
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 489 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 759

Chapter Title: THE SUPPLICATION OF QUNOOT IN WITR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى مَعْرُوفُ بْنُ خَرَّبُوذَ عَنْ أحَدِهِمَا يَعْنِي أَبَا جَعْفَرِ وَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «قُلْ فِي قُنُوتِ
الْوَثْرِ: لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللَّهُ الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللَّهُ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَ رَبِّ الْأَرَضِينَ
السَّبْعِ وَ مَا فِيهِنَّ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُنَّ وَ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ «اَللهُ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ» وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ زَيْنُ
السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ وَ أَنْتَ اللهُ جَمَالُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ عِمَادُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ قِوَامُ
السِّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ وَ أَنْتَ اللّهُ صَرِيخُ الْمُسْتَصْرِخِينَ وَ أَنْتَ اللّهُ غِيَاتُ الْمُسْتَفِيثِينَ وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ الْمُفَرِّجُ عَنِ
اَلْمَكْرُوبِينَ وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ الْمُرَوَّحُ عَنِ الْمَغْمُومِينَ وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ مُجِيبُ دَعْوَةِ الْمُضْطَرِّينَ وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ إِلَهُ الْعَالَمِينَ وَ أَنْتَ
اللهُ الرَّحْمَنُ الرَّحِيمُ وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ كَاشِفُ السُّوءِ وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ بِكَ مُنْزَلٌ كُلُ حَاجَةٍ يَا اللّهُ لَيْسَ يَرُدْ غَضَبَكَ إِلاَّ حِلْمُكَ
وَ لَاَ يُنْجِي مِنْ عَذَابِكَ إِلاَّ رَحْمَتُكَ وَ لا يُنْجِي مِنْكَ إِلاَّ التَّضَرُّعُ إِلَيْكَ فَهَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ يَا إِلَهِي رَحْمَةً تُغْنِينِي بِهَا
عَنْ رَحْمَةٍ مَنْ سِوَاكٍ بِالْقُدْرَةِ الَّتِي بِهَا أَحْيِيْتَ جَمِيعَ مَا فِي الْبِلادِ وَ بِهَا تَنْشُرُ مَيْتَ الْعِبَادِ وَ لا تُهْلِكْنِي غَمّاً حَتَّى
تَغْفِرَ لِي وَ تَرْحَمَنِي وَ تُعَرَّقَنِي الإِسْتِجَابَةَ فِي دُعَائِي وَ أُرْزُقْنِي اَلْعَافِيَةَ إِلَى مُنْتَهَى أَجَلِي وَ أَقِلْنِي عَثِرَتِي وَ لا
تُشِمِثْ بِي عَدُوِّي وَ لاَ تُمَكِّنْهُ مِنْ رَقَبَتِي اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ رَقَعْتَنِي قَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَضَعُنِي وَ إِنْ وَضَعْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي
يَرْفَعُنِي وَ إِنْ أَهْلَكْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا آلَّذِي يَحُولُ بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنِي أَوْ يَتَعَرَّضُ لَكَ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنْ أَمْرِي وَ قَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنْ لَيْسَ
فِي حُكْمِكَ ظُلُمٌ وَ لا فِي نَقِمَتِكَ عَجَلَةٌ إِنَّمَا يَعْجَلُ مَنْ يَخَافُ الْفَوْتَ وَ إِنَّمَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى الظُّلْمِ الضَّعِيفُ وَ قَدْ
تَعَالَيْتَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ يَا إِلَهِي فَلا تَجْعَلْنِي لِلْبَلاَءِ غَرَضاً وَ لاَ لِنَقِمَتِكَ نَصَباً وَ مَهْلْنِي وَ نَفْسْنِي وَ أَقِلْنِي عَثِرَتِي وَ لا
نُثبِغْنِي بِبَلاَءِ عَلَى أَثَرِ بَلاَءِ فَقَدْ تَرَى ضَعْفِي وَ قِلَّةَ جِيلَتِي أَسْتَعِيذُ بِكَ اللَّيْلَةَ فَأَعِذْنِي وَ أَسْتَجِيرُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
فَأَجِزْنِي وَ أَسْأَلْكَ الْجَنَّةَ فَلا تَحْرِمْنِي ثُمّ أُدْعُ اللَّهَ بِمَا أَحْبَبْتَ وَ اِسْتَغْفِرِ اللّهَ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً.
english_text:
It is narrated by Ma'ruf ibn Kharbudh from one of them, meaning Imam
Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} and Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}:
"Recite in the Qunoot of Witr:
'There is no god but Allah {SWT}, the Forbearing, the Generous. There is no god but Allah
{SWT}, the Most High, the Mighty. Glory be to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of the seven heavens
and the seven earths, and whatever is within them and between them, and Lord {AZJ} of
the Great Throne. O’ Allah {SWT}, You are the Light of the heavens and the earth. You are
Allah {SWT}, the Ornament of the heavens and the earth. You are Allah {SWT}, the Beauty of
the heavens and the earth. You are Allah {SWT}, the Pillar of the heavens and the earth.
You are Allah {SWT}, the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth. You are Allah {SWT}, the
Helper of those who cry for help. You are Allah {SWT}, the Reliever of the distressed. You
are Allah {SWT}, the One who answers the prayer of the distressed. You are Allah {SWT}, the
God of the worlds. You are Allah {SWT}, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate. You
are Allah {SWT}, the Remover of hardship. You are Allah {SWT}; with You every need is
resolved.
O’ Allah {SWT}, nothing repels Your anger except Your forbearance. Nothing delivers from
Your punishment except Your mercy, and nothing can rescue me from You except
pleading with You. So grant me, O’ my God, mercy from You that suffices me from the
mercy of any other than You, by the power which You revived all in the lands and by
which You revive the dead among Your servants.
Do not destroy me with anguish until You forgive me, have mercy on me, and make
known to me the response to my supplication. Grant me well-being until the end of my
life.
Overlook my missteps, do not let my enemies gloat over me, and do not grant them
control over me.
O’ Allah {SWT}, if You elevate me, who can bring me down? If You bring me down, who
can elevate me? If You destroy me, who can intervene between You and me or interfere
in any matter of mine? I know that there is no injustice in Your rule and no haste in Your
punishment. The one who rushes is he who fears loss, and only the weak resort to
injustice. You are far above all of this, my God. So do not make me a target for
affliction, nor a subject for Your wrath.
Grant me respite, relieve me, forgive my faults, and do not follow one trial with
another. You see my weakness and lack of resources. I seek refuge with You this night,
so protect me. I seek Your protection from the Fire, so protect me. I ask You for
Paradise, so do not deny it to me.'
Then call upon Allah {SWT} with whatever you wish and seek His forgiveness seventy
times."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 490 • Meftah al-Falah, Part 1, p. 326 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 759 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 84, p. 203 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 84, p. 268

Chapter Title: THE SUPPLICATION OF QUNOOT IN WITR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ التُمَالِيّ قَالَ: كَانَ عَلِيْ بْنُ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ فِي آخِرٍ وَثْرِهِ وَ هَوَ قَائِمٌ
« رَبِّ أَسَأْتُ وَ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَ بِئُسَ مَا صَنَعْتُ وَ هَذِهِ يَدَايَ جَزَاءً بِمَا صَنَعَتَا » قَالَ ثُمَّ يَبْسُطُ يَدَيْهِ جَمِيعاً قُدَّامَ
وَجْهِهِ وَ يَقُولُ: « وَ هَذِهِ رَقَبَتِي خَاضِعَةٌ لَكَ لِمَا أَتَتْ » قَالَ ثُمَّ يُطَأْطِئُ رَأْسَهُ وَ يَخْضَعُ بِرَقَبَتِهِ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: » وَ هَا
أَنَا ذَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ فَخُذْ لِنَفْسِكَ الرِّضَا مِنْ نَفْسِي حَتَى تَرْضَى لَكَ ٱلْعُثْبَى لا أَعُودُ لاَ أَعُودُ لا أَعُودُ » قَالَ وَ كَانَ وَ
اَللَّهِ إِذَا قَالَ «لا أَعُودُ» لَمْ يَعُذْ
english_text:
It is narrated by Abu Hamzah al-Thumali that Imam Ali ibn al-Hussain {a.s}
would say in the last part of his Witr prayer while standing:
"My Lord {AZJ}, I have committed wrongs and wronged myself, and what a terrible thing
I have done. Here are my hands as recompense for what they have done."
Then he would raise both his hands before his face and say:
"And here is my neck, humbled before You for what it has done."
He would then bow his head and humble his neck and continue:
"Here I am before You; take from my soul the satisfaction that pleases You until You
are content. To You belongs all repentance. I will not return, I will not return, I will not
return [to sin]."
It is reported that by Allah {SWT}, when He said: "I will not return," he never returned [to
the sin].
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 491 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 762 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 84, p. 276 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 4, p. 416

Chapter Title: THE SUPPLICATION OF QUNOOT IN WITR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ الصَّادِقِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «آلْقُنُوتُ فِي ٱلْوَثْرِ اِسْتِغْفَارْ وَ فِي
الْفَرِيضَةً الدُّعَاءُ.
english_text:
It is narrated by Abdur-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah from Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} that
He said:
"The Qunoot (supplication) in the Witr prayer is for seeking forgiveness, while in the
obligatory (prayers) it is for supplication (general prayers)”.
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 340 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 450 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 491 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 131 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 755 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p. 276

Chapter Title: THE SUPPLICATION OF QUNOOT IN WITR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ كَانَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَدْعُو فِي قُنُوتِ ٱلْوَثْرِ بِهَذَا الدُّعَاءِ « اللَّهُمَّ خَلَقْتَنِي بِتَقْدِيرٍ وَ تَدْبِيرٍ وَ
تَبْصِيرٍ بِغَيْرِ تَقْصِيرٍ وَ أَخْرَجْتَنِي مِنْ «ظُلُماتٍ ثَلاثٍ » بِحَوْلِكَ وَ قُوَّتِكَ أُحَاوِلُ الدُنْيَا ثُمّ أَرَاوِلُهَا ثُمّ أُزَابِلُهَا وَ آتَيْتَنِي
فِيهَا الْكَلَاَّ وَ الْمَرْعَى وَ بَصَّرْتَنِي فِيهَا الْهُدَى فَنِعْمَ ٱلرّبُ أَنْتَ وَ نِعْمَ ٱلْمَوْلَى فَيَا مَنْ كَرّمَنِي وَ شَرَّفَنِي وَ نَعَمَنِي أَعُوذُ
بِكَ مِنَ الزَّقُومِ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ ٱلْحَمِيمِ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ مَقِيلٍ فِي النَّارِ بَيْنَ أطبَاقِ النَّارِ فِي ظِلالِ النَّارِ يَوْمَ ٱَلنَّارِ يَا
رَبَّ النَّارِ اللّهُمّ إِنِّي أُسْألُكَ مَقِيلاً فِي الْجَنَّةِ بَيْنَ أَنْهَارِهَا وَأَشجَارِهَا وَ ثِمَارِهَا وَ رَيْحَانِهَا وَ خَدَمِهَا وَ أَزْوَاجِهَا اللَّهُمْ
إِنَّي أَسْأَلْكَ خَيْرَ الْخَيْرِ رِضْوَانَكَ وَ الْجَنَّةَ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ الشِّرِّ سَخَطِكَ وَ النَّارِ هَذَا مَقَامُ ٱلْعَائِذِ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتِ اللّهُمَّ إِجْعَلْ خَوْفَكَ فِي جَسَدِي كُلِّهِ وَ اِجْعَلْ قَلْبِي أَشَدَّ مَخَافَةً لَكَ مِمَّا هُوَ وَ اِجْعَلْ لِي فِي كُلِّ يَوْمِ وَ
لَيْلَةٍ حَظَاً وَ نَصِيباً مِنْ عَمَلٍ بِطَاعَتِكَ وَ إِتَّبَاعِ مَرْضَاتِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ مُنْتَهَى غَايَتِي وَ رَجَائِي وَ مَسْأَلَتِي وَ طَلِبَتِي
أسألُكَ يَا إِلَهِي كَمَالَ الْإِيمَانِ وَ تَمَامَ الْيَقِينِ وَ صِدْقَ التَّوَكُّلِ عَلَيْكَ وَ حُسْنَ الظَّنَّ بِكَ يَا سَيِّدِي اِجْعَلْ إِحْسَانِي
مُضَاعَفاً وَ صَلاَتِي تَضَرُّعاً وَ دُعَائِي مُسْتَجَاباً وَ عَمَلِي مَقْبُولاً وَ سَعْبِي مَشكُوراً وَ ذَثْبِي مَغْفُوراً وَ لَقُّنِي مِنْكَ
«نَضْرَةً وَ سُرُوراً» وَ صَلَّى اللَهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ.
english_text:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} would supplicate in
the Qunoot of Witr with this supplication:
"O’ Allah {SWT}, You created me with precise measurement, arrangement, and foresight
without any negligence. You brought me out of 'three layers of darkness' by Your
strength and power. I attempt to engage with this world, then I turn away from it, and
then I leave it behind. You provided me with sustenance and care in it and guided me
within it, so blessed is the Lord {AZJ} and excellent is the Master. O’ the One who honored
and elevated me and bestowed upon me Your bounties, I seek refuge in You from the
tree of Zaqqum, I seek refuge in You from boiling water (al-Hameem), and I seek refuge
in You from a resting place in the Fire, amidst the layers of the Fire, under the shadows
of the Fire on the Day of Fire. O’ Lord {AZJ} of the Fire! O’ Allah {SWT}, I ask You for a place
to rest in Paradise among its rivers, trees, fruits, sweet scents, attendants, and
spouses. O’ Allah {SWT}, I ask You for the best of all good - Your pleasure and Paradise,
and I seek refuge in You from the worst of all evil - Your wrath and the Fire. This is the
station of one seeking refuge in You from the Fire." (He would repeat this three times).
"O’ Allah {SWT}, place Your fear throughout my body and make my heart fear You more
intensely than it does now. Grant me, in every day and night, a share and portion of
deeds dedicated to Your obedience and seeking Your pleasure. O’ Allah {SWT}, You are
the ultimate aim of my efforts, my hope, my requests, and my needs. I ask You, O’ my
God, for perfect faith, complete certainty, sincere reliance upon You, and a good
opinion of You, my Master. Multiply my good deeds, make my prayers an expression
of humility, accept my supplications, approve of my actions, thank my efforts, forgive
my sins, and grant me 'radiance and joy' from You. May Allah {SWT} bless Muhammad
and his family."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, V.1, p. 491 • Al-Wafi, V. 8, p. 761 • Bihar Al-Anwar, V. 84, p. 269

Chapter Title: THE SUPPLICATION OF QUNOOT IN WITR PRAYER
arabic_text: - وروى محمد بن مسلم عن أبي جعفر عليه السلام قال: " القنوت في كل ركعتين في التطوع والفريضة.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}
who said:
"There is Qunoot (a supplication) in every two rak'ahs of the optional (supererogatory)
and obligatory prayers."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE SUPPLICATION OF QUNOOT IN WITR PRAYER
arabic_text: - وروى عنه زرارة أنه قال: " القنوت في كل الصلوات.
english_text:
Zurarah narrated from Him (Imam Abu Ja'far {a.s}) that He said:
"Qunoot (a supplication) is to be recited in all prayers."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE SUPPLICATION OF QUNOOT IN WITR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى أَبَانُ بْنُ عُثُمَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيّ: أَنَّهُ قَالَ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ أُسَمِّي الْأَئِمَةَ عَلَيهِمُ السَّلاَمُ فِي
الصَّلاةٍ فَقَالَ «أَجْمِلْهُمْ.
english_text:
Aban ibn Uthman narrated from Al-Halabi that he said to Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}: "Shall I mention the names of the Imams {a.s} during the
prayer?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "Summarize them”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 493 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 131 • Tahdhib Al- Ahkam, Part 2, p. 326 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 886

Chapter Title: THE SUPPLICATION OF QUNOOT IN WITR PRAYER
arabic_text: وقال عليه السلام: " كل ما ناجيت به ربك في الصلاة فليس بكلام.
english_text:
Imam {a.s} said:
"Whatever you whisper to your Lord {AZJ} in prayer is not considered speech”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE SUPPLICATION OF QUNOOT IN WITR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ أَبِي وَلاَّدِ حَفْصِ بْنِ سَالِمِ الْحَنَّاطِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «لاَ بَأْسَ
بِأَنْ يُصَلِّيَ الرَّجُلُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ مِنَ ٱلْوَثْرِ ثُمَّ يَنْصَرِفَ فَيَقْضِيَ حَاجَتَهُ ثُمَّ يَرْجِعَ فَيُصَلِّيَ رَكْعَةً.
ولا بأس أن يصلي الرجل ركعتين من الوتر ثم يشرب الماء ويتكلم وينكح ويقضي ما شاء من حاجة ويحدث وضوءا ثم
يصلي الركعة قبل أن يصلي الغداة.
english_text:
It is narrated from Abu Walad Hafs bin Salim Al-Hannat that He said:
"I heard Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} say,
'There is no harm if a person prays two units (rak‘ahs) of Witr prayer, then turns away
to fulfil a need, and then returns to pray one unit (rak‘ah).'".
commentary:
There is no issue if a person prays two rak‘ahs of Witr, then drinks water, speaks,
engages in intimacy, fulfils any need, or renews ablution, and then performs the
remaining single rak‘ah before the Fajr prayer.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 493 • Meftah al-Falah, Part 1, p. 323

Chapter Title: THE SUPPLICATION OF QUNOOT IN WITR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: عَنِ الْقُنُوتِ فِي الْوَثْرِ قَالَ «قَبْلَ الرُّكُوعِ» قَالَ فَإِنْ
نَسِيثُ أَقْنُتُ إِذَا رَفَعْتُ رَأْسِي فَقَالَ «لا.
قال مصنف هذا الكتاب: حكم من ينسى القنوت حتى يركع أن يقنت إذا رفع رأسه من الركوع، وإنما منع الصادق عليه
السلام من ذلك في الوتر والغداة خلافا للعامة لأنهم يقنتون فيهما بعد الركوع وإنما أطلق ذلك في سائر الصلوات لان
جمهور العامة لا يرون القنوت فيها فإذا فرغ الانسان من الوتر صلى ركعتي الفجر
english_text:
Mu'awiya bin Ammar asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} bout the
position of Qunoot (supplication) in the Witr prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "It is done before the bowing (ruku‘)."
Mu'awiya then asked: "What if I forget it?"
Abu Abdullah {a.s} replied: "No (do not perform it after lifting your head from bowing)."
commentary:
The author of this book stated: If someone forgets the Qunoot until they bow (ruku'),
they should perform the Qunoot when they raise their head from the bowing position.
However, Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s}, prohibited this for Witr and Fajr (Dawn) prayers, differing
from the general practice of the public, as they perform Qunoot after the bowing. He
permitted this for other prayers because the majority of the public do not see Qunoot
as necessary in them. When a person completes the Witr prayer, they should proceed
to pray the two rak'ahs of Fajr.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE SUPPLICATION OF QUNOOT IN WITR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ: «صَلَ رَكْعَتَيِ ٱلْفَجْرِ قَبْلَ ٱلْفَجْرِ وَ عِنْدَهُ وَ بُعَيْدَهُ تَقْرَأْ فِي الْأُولَى الْحَمْدَ وَ
«قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ» وَ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ الْحَمْدَ وَ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ».
ويجوز للرجل أن يحشوهم في صلاة الليل حشوا وكلما قرب من الفجر فهو أفضل فإذا طلع الفجر فصل الغداة وافصل
بين ركعتي الفجر وبين الغداة باضطجاع ويجزيك التسليه
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Pray the two rak'ahs of Fajr (supererogatory prayer) before Fajr, at its time, or shortly
thereafter.
In the first rak'ah, recite Surah Al-Fatiha and ‘Qul ya-ayyuhal kafirun’ (Surah al-
Kafirun),
In the second rak'ah, recite Al-Hamd and 'Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad' (Surah Al-Ikhlas)."
commentary:
It is permissible for a person to combine (or perform rapidly) multiple units in the night
prayer, and the closer it is to Fajr (dawn), the more virtuous it is.
When Fajr begins, perform the Fajr prayer and separate between the two units of Fajr
and the main Fajr prayer by lying down briefly.
And the Tasleem (salutation ending the prayer) suffices for you.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 493 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 318 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 4, p.

Chapter Title: THE SUPPLICATION OF QUNOOT IN WITR PRAYER
arabic_text: - فَقَدْ قَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ: «أَيّ قَطْعٍ أَقْطَعُ مِنَ ٱلتَّسْلِيمِ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"What ending is more complete than the Tasleem (salutation)?"
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE SUPPLICATION OF QUNOOT IN WITR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ الْأَعْرَجِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنِّي أَكُونُ فِي الْوَثْرِ وَ
أَكُونُ قَدْ نَوَيْتُ الصَّوْمَ وَ أَكُونْ فِي الدُّعَاءِ وَ أَخَافُ الْفَجْرَ وَ أَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَقْطَعَ عَلَى نَفْسِي الدُّعَاءَ وَ أَشْرَبَ ٱلْمَاءَ وَ
تَكُونُ الْقُلّةُ أَمَامِي قَالَ فَقَالَ لِي «فَاخْطُ إِلَيْهَا ٱلْخُطْوَةَ وَ الْخُطْوَتَيْنِ وَ الثَّلاَثَ وَ اِشرَبْ وَ اِرْجِع إِلَى مَكَانِكَ وَ لا
نَقْطَعْ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ الدَّعَاءَ.
english_text:
It is narrated from Sa'id al-A'raj that He said:
I said to Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}
"May I be your ransom, sometimes I am in the Witr prayer and have already intended
to fast. I am engaged in supplication and I fear the approach of dawn, but I dislike
interrupting my supplication to drink water, and there is a water jug in front of me."
Imam {a.s} said to me: "Take a step, two, or three towards it, drink, and then return to
your place without interrupting your supplication."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 494 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 7, p. 279

Chapter Title: THE SUPPLICATION OF QUNOOT IN WITR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى زُرَارَةُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ: «إِذَا أَنْتَ اِنْصَرَفْتَ مِنَ ٱلْوَثْرِ فَقُلْ: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ ٱلْمَلِكِ
اَلْقُدُّوسِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ثُمَّ تَقُولُ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُومُ يَا بَرْ يَا رَجِيمُ يَا غَنِيّ يَا كَرِيمُ أُرْزُقْنِي مِنَ التَّجَارَةِ
أَعْظَمَهَا فَضْلاً وَ أَوْسَعَهَا رِزْقاً وَ خَيْرَهَا لِي عَاقِبَةً فَإِنَّهُ لاَ خَيْرَ فِيمَا لاَ عَاقِبَةَ لَهُ.
english_text:
Zurarah narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} that He said:
"When you finish the Witr prayer, say:
'Glory be to my Lord {AZJ}, the Sovereign, the Holy, the Mighty, the Wise,' three times.
Then say:
'O’ Ever-Living, O’ Self-Subsisting, O’ Beneficent, O’ Merciful, O’ Rich, O’ Generous,
provide me with the best and most profitable trade, the widest provision, and the best
outcome for me, for there is no goodness in anything that does not have a favorable
end.'"
commentary:
Between the two Rak'ahs of Fajr and the two Rak'ahs of Ghadah (morning prayer), lie
down on your right side facing the Qibla and say:
"I have held firmly to the strong rope of Allah {SWT} which cannot be broken, and I have
sought refuge in the strong handhold of Allah {SWT}. I seek refuge in Allah {SWT} from the
evil of the wicked among the Arabs and non-Arabs, and I seek refuge in Allah {SWT} from
the evil of the wicked among the jinn and humans. Glory be to the Lord {AZJ} of the
morning, the one who splits the morning, Glory be to the Lord {AZJ} of the morning, the
one who splits the morning, Glory be to the Lord {AZJ} of the morning, the one who splits
the morning."
Then say: "In the name of Allah {SWT}, I have placed my side (for rest) for Allah {SWT}, I have
entrusted my affair to Allah {SWT}, I seek my needs from Allah {SWT}, I have relied upon
Allah {SWT}; sufficient for me is Allah {SWT}, and an excellent guardian is He. And whoever
relies upon Allah {SWT}, He will suffice him. Indeed, Allah {SWT} accomplishes His
command. Allah {SWT} has set a measure for everything.
O’ Allah {SWT}, and if anyone begins their day in need of a created being, then my need
and desire are towards You alone."
Then recite five verses from the end of Surat Al-Imran: "Indeed, in the creation of the
heavens and the earth…" until the verse: "Indeed, You do not fail in Your promise”.
Conclude by sending blessings upon Muhammad and his family one hundred times.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 494 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 814 Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE DISCUSSION ON RECLINING BETWEEN THE TWO UNITS OF FAJR PRAYER AND THE MORNING PRAYER
arabic_text:
باب - القول في الضجعة بين ركعتي الفجر وركعتي الغداة
اضطجع بين ركعتي الفجر وركعتي الغداة على يمينك مستقبل القبلة وقل في ضجعتك استمسكت بعروة اللّٰه الوثقى التي
لا انفصام لها، واعتصمت بحبل اللّٰه المتين، وأعوذ بالله من شر فسقة العرب والعجم، وأعوذ بالله من شر فسقه الجن والإنس
، سبحان رب الصباح، فالق الاصباح، سبحان رب الصباح، فالق الاصباح، سبحان رب الصباح فالق الاصباح " ثم تقول: "
بسم الله وضعت جنبي لله، فوضت أمري إلى اللّٰه أطلب حاجتي من اللّٰه توكلت على اللّٰه حسبي اللّٰه ونعم الوكيل ومن
يتوكل على اللّٰه فهو حسبه إن اللّٰه بالغ أمره قد جعل اللّٰه لكل شئ قدرا اللهم ومن أصبح وحاجته إلى مخلوق فإن حاجتي
ورغبتي إليك " وتقرأ خمس آيات من آخر آل عمران
ب" إن في خلق السماوات والأرض - إلى قوله: - إنك لا تخلف الميعاد.
وصل على محمد وآله مائة مرة فإنه
فَإِنَّهُ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّهُ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةِ بَيْنَ رَكْعَتَيِ ٱلْفَجْرِ وَ رَكْعَتَيِ الْغَدَاةِ وَقَى اللَّهُ وَجْهَهُ
حَرَّ النَّارِ وَ مَنْ قَالَ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ: سُبْحَانَ رَبَّيَ الْعَظِيمِ وَ بِحَمْدِهِ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللّهَ رَبِّي وَ أَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ بَنَى اللهُ لَهُ بَيْتاً فِي
اَلْجَنَّةِ وَ مَنْ قَرَأ إِحْدَى وَ عِشرِينَ مَرّةً «قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ» بَنَى اللّهُ لَهُ بَيْتاً فِي الْجَنَّةِ فَإِنْ قَرَأْهَا أَرْبَعِينَ مَرّةً غَفَرَ
اَللَّهُ لَهُ.
english_text:
It has been narrated: "Whoever sends blessings upon Muhammad and his
family one hundred times between the two Rak'ahs of Fajr and the two Rak'ahs of
Ghadah (morning prayer), Allah {SWT} will protect his face from the heat of Hellfire.
Whoever says one hundred times:
'Glory is to my Lord {AZJ}, the Most Great, and with His praise. I seek forgiveness from
Allah {SWT}, my Lord {AZJ}, and I turn to Him in repentance,' Allah {SWT} will build for him a
house in Paradise.
And whoever recites 'Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad' (Surah Al-Ikhlas) twenty-one times, Allah
{SWT} will build for him a house in Paradise. If he recites it forty times, Allah {SWT} will
forgive him."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 495 • Wasail Al- Shia, Vol. 6, p. 494

Chapter Title: RECOMMENDED PLACES TO READ SURAH AL-IKHLAS
arabic_text:
باب - المواضع التي يستحب أن يقرأ فيها قل هو الله أحد و قل يا أيها الكافرون
«لا تَدَغْ أَنْ تَقْرَأَ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» وَ «قُلْ يَا أَيْهَا الكَافِرُونَ» فِي سَبْعَةِ مَوَاطِنَ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَوْلَتَيْنِ
مِنْ صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ وَ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اللَّتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ وَ رَكْعَتَي الزَّوَالِ وَ فِي الرّكْعَتَيْنِ اللَّتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَ رَكْعَتَيٍ
الطَوَافِ وَ رَكْعَتَي ٱلْإِحْرَامِ وَ الْفَجْرِ إِذَا أَصْبَحْتَ بِهَا.
english_text:
Do not neglect to recite 'Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad' (Surah Al-Ikhlas) and ‘Qul ya-
ayyuhal kaafirun’ (Surah al-Kafirun) in seven positions: in the first two Rak'ahs of the
Night Prayer, in the two Rak'ahs before Fajr, in the two Rak'ahs of Dhuha (mid-
morning), in the two Rak'ahs after Maghrib, in the two Rak'ahs of Tawaf
(circumambulation), in the two Rak'ahs of Ihram (intention for Hajj or Umrah), and at
Fajr when you begin the day with them.
commentary:
My father, may Allah {SWT} be pleased with him, mentioned in his letter to me:
'Know, my son, that the best of the supererogatory (nafl) prayers are the two Rak'ahs
of Fajr, followed by the single Rak'ah of Witr, then the two Rak'ahs of Dhuha (mid-
morning prayer), then the supererogatory prayers after Maghrib, then the completion
of the Night Prayer, and finally, the completion of the daytime supererogatory prayers.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: MAKING UP THE NIGHT PRAYER
arabic_text:
باب - أفضل النوافل
قال أبى - رضي اللّٰه عنه - في رسالته إلي: اعلم يا بنى إن أفضل النوافل ركعتا الفجر، وبعدهما ركعة الوتر، وبعدها ركعتا
الزال، وبعدهما نوافل المغرب، وبعدها تمام صلاة الليل، وبعدها تمام نوافل النهار.
باب - قضاء صلاة الليل
قَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «كُلُّ مَا فَاتَكَ بِاللَّيْلِ فَاقْضِهِ بِالنَّهَارِ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى: «وَ هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ
اللَّيْلَ وَ النَّهَارَ جِلْفَةً لِمَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرادَ شُكُوراً » »
يعنى أن يقضى الرجل ما فاته بالليل بالنهار، وما فاته بالنهار بالليل. واقض ما فاتك من صلاة الليل أي وقت شئت من ليل
أو نهار ما لم يكن وقت فريضة وإن فاتتك فريضة فصلها إذا ذكرت فان ذكرتها وأنت في وقت فريضة أخرى فصل التي
أنت في وقتها ثم صل الصلاة الفائتة.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Whatever you miss during the
night, make it up during the day, as Allah {SWT} the Exalted said: 'And it is He who made
the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires
gratitude.'”.
commentary:
This means that a person should make up what he missed at night during the day and
what he missed during the day during the night. Make up what you missed of the Night
Prayer at any time, whether day or night, as long as it is not during the time of an
obligatory prayer.
If you have missed an obligatory prayer, perform it whenever you remember. However,
if you recall it during the time of another obligatory prayer, perform the prayer for the
current time first, and then perform the missed prayer.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 496 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1027

Chapter Title: MAKING UP THE NIGHT PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «قَضَاءُ صَلاَةِ ٱللّيْلِ بَعْدَ ٱلْغَدَاةِ وَ بَعْدَ ٱلْعَصْرِ مِنْ سِرِّ آلِ مُحَمَّدِ ٱلْمَخْزُونِ.
وقد روي نهى عن الصلاة عند طلوع الشمس وعند غروبها لان الشمس تطلع بين قرني شيطان وتغرب بين قرني شيطان
إلا أنه روي لي جماعة من مشائخنا عن:
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Making up the Night Prayer after the Morning Prayer and after the Afternoon Prayer is
among the hidden secrets of the Family of Muhammad."
commentary:
Additionally, it has been narrated that there is a prohibition on performing prayers at
the time of sunrise and sunset because the sun rises and sets between the horns of
Shaytan (Satan). However, a group of our elders narrated (In the next Hadith)
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 497 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 357 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 4, p. 256 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 4, p. 274

Chapter Title: MAKING UP THE NIGHT PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْ أَبِي الْحُسَيْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرِ الْأَسَدِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ أَنَّهُ وَرَدَ عَلَيْهِ فِيمَا وَرَدَ مِنْ جَوَابٍ مَسَائِلِهِ مِنْ
مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ الْعَمْرِيِّ قَدَّسَ اللَّهُ رُوحَهُ: «وَ أَمّا مَا سَأَلْتَ عَنْهُ مِنَ الصَّلاةِ عِنْدَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَ عِنْدَ غُرُوبِهَا
فَلَيِنْ كَانَ كَمَا يَقُولُ النَّاسُ إِنَّ الشَّمْسَ تَطْلُعُ بَيْنَ قَرْنَي شَيْطَانٍ وَتَغْرُبُ بَيْنَ قَرْنَيْ شَيْطَانٍ فَمَا أَرْغِمَ أَنْفُ الشَّيْطَانِ
بِشَيْءٍ أَفْضَلَ مِنَ الصَّلاةِ فَصَلَّهَا وَ أَرْغِمْ أَنْفَ الشَّيْطَانِ.
english_text:
From Abu al-Hussain Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Asadi, it is narrated that in
response to his questions, Muhammad ibn Uthman al-Amri (may Allah {SWT} sanctify his
soul) conveyed:
"As for what you asked regarding prayer at the time of sunrise and sunset, if it is as
people say that the sun rises and sets between the horns of Shaytan (Satan), then what
better way to humiliate Shaytan than through prayer? So, pray during these times and
humiliate Shaytan”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 498 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 291 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 4, p. 236

Chapter Title: MAKING UP THE NIGHT PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وتَعَالَى لَيُبَاهِي مَلاَئِكَتَهُ بِالْعَبْدِ يَقْضِي صَلاَةَ اللَّيْلِ
بِالنَّهَارِ فَيَقُولُ «يَا مَلاَنِكَتِي أنْظُرُوا إلَى عَبْدِي يَقْضِي مَا لَمْ أَفْتَرِضْهُ عَلَيْهِ أُشْهِدُكُمْ أَنَّي قَدْ غَفَرْتُ لَهُ».
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"Indeed, Allah {SWT}, Blessed and Exalted, takes pride in His angels with the servant who
makes up the missed prayers of the night during the day. He says,
'O’ My angels, look at My servant who is fulfilling what I did not obligate upon him. I
make you witness that I have forgiven him.'"
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 498 • Meftah al-Falah, Part 1, p. 238 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1025 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 4, p. 77 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 4, p. 275

Chapter Title: MAKING UP THE NIGHT PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى بُرَيْدُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ الْعِجْلِيْ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱَلسِّلامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «أَفْضَلُ قَضَاءِ صَلاةِ اللَّيْلِ فِي
السَّاعَةِ الْتِي فَاتَثِكَ آخِرٍ اللِّيْلِ وَ لَيْسَ بَأْسِّ أَنْ تَقْضِيَهَا بِالنَّهَارِ وَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَزُولَ الشَّمْسُ.
english_text:
Burayd ibn Mu'awiyah al-'Ijli narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir
{a.s} that He said:
"The best time to make up the missed night prayers is at the same hour during the
following night when it was missed. However, it is permissible to make them up during
the day, even before the sun's decline (before noon)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 498 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1027 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 4, p. 275 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 80, p. 124

Chapter Title: MAKING UP THE NIGHT PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ مُرَازِمِ بْنِ حَكِيمِ الْأَزْدِيِّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: كُنْتُ مَرِضْتُ أَرْبَعَةَ أُشهْرٍ لَمْ أَصَلَ نَافِلَةً فِيهَا فَقُلْتُ لِأَبِي
عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِنَّي مَرِضتُ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشهُرٍ لَمْ أُصَلّ نَافِلَةً فَقَالَ «لَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ قَضَاءً إِنَّ الْمَرِيضَ لَيْسَ كَالصَّجِيحِ
كُلُّ مَا غَلَبَ اللهُ عَلَيْهِ فَاللهُ أَوْلَى بِالْعُذْرِ فِيهِ.
english_text:
Murazim ibn Hakim al-Azdi narrated that He said:
"I was ill for four months and did not perform any of the supererogatory (nafilah)
prayers during that time. I mentioned this to Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}
Imam {a.s} said: 'There is no obligation on you to make them up; indeed, the condition
of the sick is not like that of the healthy. Whatever overwhelms you, Allah {SWT} is more
deserving of offering an excuse for it.'".
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: MAKING UP THE NIGHT PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ رَجُلُ مَرِضَ فَتَرَكَ النَّافِلَةَ فَقَالَ »يَا
مُحَمَّدُ لَيْسَتْ بِفَرِيضَةِ إِنْ قَضَاهَا فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ يَفْعَلُهُ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Muslim narrates that Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}
said:
"I asked him about a man who became ill and thus did not perform the supererogatory
(nafilah) prayers.
Imam {a.s} said: 'O’ Muhammad, they are not obligatory. If he makes them up, it is a
good deed he performs, and if he does not, there is no obligation upon him.'"
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 412 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 499 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 2, p. 361 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 306 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1025 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 4, p. 79 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 84, p. 41

Chapter Title: MAKING UP THE NIGHT PRAYER
arabic_text: - وَ سَأْلَهُ سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ: عَنْ قَضَاءِ الْوَثْرِ بَعْدَ الظُّهْرِ فَقَالَ «اِقْضِهِ وَثْراً أَبَداً كَمَا فَاتَكَ.
english_text:
Sulaiman ibn Khalid asked Imam {a.s} about making up the Witr prayer after
midday.
Imam {a.s} said: "Make it up as a single (Witr) always, just as it was missed."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: MAKING UP THE NIGHT PRAYER
arabic_text: - وَ سَأَلَهُ حَمَّادُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ فَقَالَ لَهُ: أُصْبِحُ عَنِ ٱلْوَثْرِ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ فَكَيْفَ أَقْضِي فَقَالَ «مِثلاً بِمِثلٍ.
english_text:
Hammad ibn Uthman asked Imam {a.s} and said:
"I wake up after missing the Witr until the night. How do I make it up?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Like for like."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 499 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 165 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 293 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1034 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 274

Chapter Title: MAKING UP THE NIGHT PRAYER
arabic_text: - وَ رَوَى عَنْهُ حَرِيزٌ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «كَانَ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ رُبَّمَا قَضَى عِشرِينَ وَثراً فِي لَيْلَةٍ.
english_text:
Hariz narrated that Imam {a.s} said,
"My father (Imam {a.s}) would sometimes make up twenty Witr prayers in a single night."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 500 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1033 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 167 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 272

Chapter Title: MAKING UP THE NIGHT PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ سَأَلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ أَبَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَفُوتُهُ اَلْوَثْرُ فَقَالَ
«يَقْضِيهِ وَثْراً أَبَداً.
english_text:
Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah asked Abu Ibrahim Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim
{a.s} about a man who misses the Witr prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should make it up as a single Witr always."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: RECOGNIZING THE DAWN AND THE SAYING UPON
arabic_text:
باب - معرفه الصبح والقول عند النظر إليه
رَوَى عَلِيْ بْنُ عَطِيَّةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «اَلْفَجْرُ هُوَ الَذِي إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُ كَانَ مُعْتَرِضاً كَأَنَّهُ
بَيَاضُ نَهَرِ سُورَى.
english_text:
Ali ibn Atiyyah narrated from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-
Sadiq {a.s} that He said:
"The true Fajr (dawn) is the one that, when you see it, appears spread out horizontally,
like the whiteness of the Surā river."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 500 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Vol. 4, p. 185

Chapter Title: RECOGNIZING THE DAWN AND THE SAYING UPON
arabic_text:
وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّ وَقْتَ ٱَلْغَدَاةِ إِذَا اِعْتَرَضَ ٱلْفَجْرُ فَأَضَاءَ حَسَناً.
وأما الفجر الذي يشبه ذنب السرحان فذاك الفجر الكاذب، والفجر الصادق هو المعترض كالقباطي.
english_text:
It has been narrated:
"The time of Fajr (morning prayer) begins when the true dawn appears and spreads
light horizontally in a good way”.
commentary:
As for the "Fajr" that resembles the tail of a wolf (a narrow, vertical light), that is the
false Fajr, while the true Fajr is the one that spreads out horizontally like fine Egyptian
linen (qabāti).
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 501 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 303

Chapter Title: RECOGNIZING THE DAWN AND THE SAYING UPON SEEING IT
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى عَمَّارُ بْنُ مُوسَى السَّابَاطِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «تَقُولُ إِذَا طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
قَالِقِ الْإِصْبَاحِ سُبْحَانَ اللّهِ رَبِّ الْمَسَاءِ وَ الصَّبَاحِ اللَّهُمَّ صَبِّحْ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ بِبَرَكَةٍ وَ عَافِيَةٍ وَ سُرُورٍ وَ قُرَّةِ عَيْنِ اللَّهُمْ
إِنَّكَ تُنْزِلُ بِاللَّيْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ مَا تَشَاءُ فَأَنْزِلْ عَلَيَّ وَ عَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِي مِنْ بَرَكَةِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ رِزْقاً حَلاَلاً طَيِّباً
وَاسِعاً تُغْنِينِي بِهِ عَنْ جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ.
english_text:
Ammaar ibn Musa al-Sabati narrated from Imam Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar
ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} who said:
"When the Fajr (dawn) rises, say:
'Praise be to Allah {SWT}, the Splitter of the dawn! Glory be to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of
evening and morning! O’ Allah {SWT}, bless the family of Muhammad with blessing,
health, joy, and a source of comfort. O’ Allah {SWT}, You send down at night and during
the day whatever You will, so send upon me and my family from the blessings of the
heavens and the earth, a lawful, good, and abundant provision that makes me free of
need from all Your creation.'"
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 501 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 9, p. 1558 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 84, p. 356

Chapter Title: THE DISLIKE OF SLEEPING AFTER THE FAJR PRAYER
arabic_text:
باب - كراهية النوم بعد الغداة
رَوَى اَلْعَلَاَءُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ النَّوْمِ بَعْدَ الْغَدَاةِ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ
الرِّزْقَ يُنْسَطُ تِلْكَ السَّاعَةَ فَأَنَا أَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَنَامَ الرَّجُلُ تِلْكَ السَّاعَةَ.
english_text:
Al-Alaa narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim who reported from one of the
Imams {a.s} that he asked him about sleeping after the Fajr (morning) prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "Sustenance is distributed during that hour, and I dislike for a man to
sleep during that time."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 501 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 138 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 26, p. 543 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p. 496

Chapter Title: THE DISLIKE OF SLEEPING AFTER THE FAJR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى جَابِرٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِنَ إبْلِيسَ إِنَّمَا يَبُثُ جُنُودَ اللَّيْلِ مِنْ جِينٍ تَغِيبُ الشَّمْسُ
إِلَى مَغِيبِ الشَّفَقِ وَ يَبُثُ جُنُودَ النَّهَارِ مِنْ جِينِ يَطْلُعُ الْفَجْرُ إِلَى مَطْلَعِ الشَّمْسِ» وَ ذَكَرَ «أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ
عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَانَ يَقُولُ» «أكْثِرُوا ذِكْرَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فِي هَاتَيْنِ ٱلسَّاعَتَيْنِ وَ تَعَوْذُوا بِاللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ مِنْ شَرِّ إِبْلِيسَ
وَجُنُودِهِ وَ عَوِّذُوا صِغَارَكُمْ فِي هَاتَيْنِ ٱلسَاعَنَيْنِ فَإِنَّهُمَا سَاعَتَا غَفْلَةٍ.
english_text:
Jabir narrated from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} who said:
"Indeed, Iblis deploys his soldiers of the night from sunset until the disappearance of
twilight and deploys his soldiers of the day from the time the Fajr (morning) light
appears until the sun rises." He also mentioned that "the Prophet of Allah {SWT} {saws}
used to say: 'Increase your remembrance of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, during
these two hours, and seek refuge in Allah {SWT} from the evil of Iblis and his soldiers, and
seek protection for your children during these two hours, for they are times of
heedlessness.'"
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 501 • Meftah al-Falah, Part 1, p. 252 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p. 496

Chapter Title: THE DISLIKE OF SLEEPING AFTER THE FAJR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «نَوْمَةُ ٱلْغَدَاةِ مَشُومَةٌ تَطْرُدُ ٱلرِّزْقَ وَ تُصَفَّرُ اللَّوْنَ وَ تُقَبِّحُهُ وَ تُغَيِّرُهُ وَ هُوَ
نَوْمُ كُلِّ مَشِئُومِ إِنَّ اللّهَ تَبَارَكَ وتَعَالَى يَقْسِمُ ٱلْأَرْزَاقَ مَا بَيْنَ طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ إِلَى طُلُوعِ ٱلشَمْسِ فَإِيَاكُمْ وَ تِلْكَ النَّوْمَةَ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"The morning sleep (after Fajr) is inauspicious; it drives away sustenance, causes
paleness and disfigures the complexion, and alters it negatively. It is the sleep of every
unfortunate person. Indeed, Allah
{SWT}, the Blessed and Exalted, distributes
sustenance between the rising of Fajr and the rising of the sun, so beware of that
sleep."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 502 • The Makarem al-Akhlaq, Part 1, p. 305 • The Meftah al-Falah, Part 1, p. 9 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p. 496 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 83, p. 130

Chapter Title: THE DISLIKE OF SLEEPING AFTER THE FAJR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ الْبَاقِرُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «النَّوْمُ أَوَّلَ النَّهَارِ خُرْقٌ وَ الْقَائِلَةُ نِعْمَةً وَ النَّوْمُ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ حُمْقٌ وَ النَّوْمُ بَيْنَ
الْعِشَاءَيْنِ يَحْرِمُ الرِّزْقَ.
والنوم على أربعة أوجه نوم الأنبياء عليهم السلم على أقفيتهم لمناجاة الوحي، ونوم المؤمنين على أيمانهم ونوم الكفار
على يسارهم، ونوم الشياطين على وجوههم .
english_text:
Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"Sleeping at the beginning of the day is wastefulness, the nap at midday is a blessing,
sleeping after Asr (afternoon prayer) is foolishness, and sleeping between the two
night prayers (Maghrib and Isha) deprives one of sustenance."
commentary:
There are four types of sleep : the sleep of prophets is on their backs due to their
communication with revelation, the sleep of believers is on their right sides, the sleep
of disbelievers is on their left sides, and the sleep of devils is on their faces.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 502 • Al-Ash'athiyat, Part 1, p. 157 • Makarem al- Akhlaq, Part 1, p. 288 • The Makarem al-Akhlaq, Part 1, p. 305 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p. 503 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 185 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 5, p. 113

Chapter Title: THE DISLIKE OF SLEEPING AFTER THE FAJR PRAYER
arabic_text: - وَقَالَ الصَادِقُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ: «مَنْ رَأَيْتُمُوهُ نَائِما عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فَأَنْبِهُوهُ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"If you see someone sleeping on their face, wake them up."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 503 • Al-Ādāb al-Dīniyyah, Part 1, p. 127 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 26, p. 542 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p. 503

Chapter Title: THE DISLIKE OF SLEEPING AFTER THE FAJR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «ثَلاَثَةٌ فِيهِنَّ ٱلْمَقْتُ مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ نَوْمٌ مِنْ غَيْرٍ سَهَرٍ وَ ضَحِكْ مِنْ غَيْرِ عَجَبِ وَ
أَكْلٌ عَلَى الشَّبَعِ.
english_text:
Imam {a.s} said: "Three things bring forth the dislike (anger) of Allah {SWT}, the
Majestic: sleeping without fatigue, laughing without wonder, and eating when already
full”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 503 • Al-Khasal, Part 1, p. 89 • Al-Ādāb al-Dīniyyah, Part 1, p. 127 • Aʿlām al-Dīn, Part 1, p. 152 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 26, p. 542 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p. 503 • Wasail Al- Shia, Vol. 12, p. 115 • Bihar Al-Anwar, V. 63, p. 332 • Bihar Al Anwar, V. 73, p. 58 • Bihar Al Anwar, V. 73, p.

Chapter Title: THE DISLIKE OF SLEEPING AFTER THE FAJR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ أَتَى أَعْرَابِيْ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي كُنْتُ ذَكُوراً وَ إِنِّي صِرْتُ نَسِيَاً
فَقَالَ «أكُنْتَ تَقِيلُ» قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ »وَ تَرَكْتَ ذَاكَ» قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ «عُد» فَعَادَ فَرَجَعَ إِلَيْهِ ذِهْنُهُ.
english_text:
A Bedouin came to the Prophet {saws} and said: "O’ Messenger of Allah {saws}, I
used to have a strong memory but now I have become forgetful."
The Prophet {saws} asked: "Did you use to take a midday nap (Qailulah)?"
The man replied: "Yes."
The Prophet {saws} then asked: "And did you stop doing that?"
The man answered, "Yes."
The Prophet {saws} said: "Resume it." The man did so and his memory returned.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 503 • Al-Ādāb al-Dīniyyah, Part 1, p. 127 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 26, p. 542 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p. 501

Chapter Title: THE DISLIKE OF SLEEPING AFTER THE FAJR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى أَبُو بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «خَمْسَةٌ لاَ يَنَامُونَ ٱلْهَامُ بِدَمِ يَسْفِكُهُ وَ ذُو ٱلْمَالِ
اَلْكَثِيرِ لا أَمِينَ لَهُ وَ الْقَائِلُ فِي النَّاسِ الزُّورَ وَ ٱلْبُهْتَانَ عَنْ عَرَضٍ مِنَ الدُّثْيَا يَنَالُهُ وَ ٱلْمَأْخُوذُ بِالْمَالِ الْكَثِيرِ وَ لا مَالَ
لَهُ وَ الْمُحِبُّ حَبِيبا يَتَوَقَعُ فِرَاقَهُ.
english_text:
Abu Basir narrated from Imam Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar Al-Sadiq {a.s} who
said:
"There are five types of people who cannot sleep: one who is anxious about shedding
blood, the possessor of a great amount of wealth who lacks a trustworthy guardian,
one who spreads lies and false accusations among people to gain a worldly benefit,
the person burdened with a large amount of wealth but has none himself, and one who
deeply loves someone and fears separation from them."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 503 • Al-Khisal, Part 1, p. 296 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 26, p. 545 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 67, p. 15 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 179

Chapter Title: THE DISLIKE OF SLEEPING AFTER THE FAJR PRAYER
arabic_text: - وَ رُوِيَ: «قِيلُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُطْعِمُ الصَّائِمَ فِي مَنَامِهِ وَ يَسْقِيهِ.
english_text:
It is narrated:
"Take a midday nap (Qailulah), for indeed Allah {SWT} nourishes and provides drink to
the fasting person during their sleep."
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 4, p. 65 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 503 • Man La Yahduruhu Al- Faqih, Vol. 2, p. 76 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al-A’mal, Part 1, p. 51 • The Virtues of the Three Months, Part 1, p. 120 • Al-Ādāb al-Dīniyyah, Part 1, p. 127 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 11, p. 29 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 26, p. 542 • Wasail Al- Shia, Vol. 6, p. 501 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 10, p. 136

Chapter Title: THE DISLIKE OF SLEEPING AFTER THE FAJR PRAYER
arabic_text: - وَ رُوِيَ: «قِيلُوا فَإِنّ الشَّيْطَانَ لا يَقِيلُ.
english_text:
It is narrated,
"Take a midday nap (Qailulah), for indeed the Shaytan does not take a nap."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 503 • Al-Ādāb al-Dīniyyah, Part 1, p. 127 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 26, p. 542 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p. 501

Chapter Title: THE DISLIKE OF SLEEPING AFTER THE FAJR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «نَوْمُ الْغَدَاةِ شُوْمٌ يَحْرِمُ الرَّزْقَ وَ يُصَفَّرُ اللَّوْنَ وَ كَانَ ٱلْمَنْ وَ السَّلْوَى يَنْزِلُ عَلَى بَنِي
إِسْرَائِيلَ مَا بَيْنَ طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ إِلَى طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ فَمَنْ نَامَ تِلْكَ السَّاعَةَ لَمْ يَنْزِلْ نَصِيبُهُ فَكَانَ إِذَا اِنْتَبَهَ فَلاَ يَرَى
نَصِيبَهُ اِحْتَاجَ إِلَى السُّؤَالِ وَ الطَّلَبِ.
english_text:
Imam {a.s} said:
"Sleeping in the morning (after dawn) is an omen of misfortune; it deprives one of
sustenance and pales the complexion. The manna and quails used to descend upon
the Children of Israel between the time of dawn until sunrise, so whoever slept during
that hour would not receive their share. When they woke up and did not find their
portion, they were compelled to ask and seek provision”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE DISLIKE OF SLEEPING AFTER THE FAJR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ: فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: «فَالْمُقَسِّمَاتِ أَمْرا)» قَالَ «اَلْمَلائِكَةُ تُقَسِّمُ أَرْزَاقَ بَنِي
آدَمَ مَا بَيْنَ طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ إِلَى طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ فَمَنْ يَنَامُ فِيمَا بَيْنَهُمَا يَنَامُ عَنْ رِزْقِهِ.
english_text:
Imam al-Ridha {a.s} said regarding the verse of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted: "By those
who distribute commands"
He (Imam {a.s}) explained: "The angels distribute the sustenance of the children of
Adam from the time of dawn until sunrise. Therefore, whoever sleeps during this
period sleeps away their sustenance."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: THE DISLIKE OF SLEEPING AFTER THE FAJR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى مُعَمَّرُ بْنُ خَلاَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: كَانَ وَ هُوَ بِخُرَاسَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى الْفَجْرَ
جَلَسَ فِي مُصَلاَهُ إِلَى أَنْ تَظْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ ثُمَّ يُوْتَى بِخَرِيطَةٍ فِيهَا مَسَاوِيكُ فَيَسْتَاكُ بِهَا وَاحِداً بَعْدَ وَاحِدِ ثُمَّ يُوْتَى
بِكُنْدُرٍ فَيَمْضَغُهُ ثُمَّ يَدَعُ ذَلِكَ فَيُوتَى بِالْمُصْحَفِ فَيَقْرَأْ فِيهِ.
english_text:
Muammar ibn Khallad narrated from Imam al-Ridha {a.s} that when he was in
Khurasan, after performing the Fajr prayer, he would sit in his prayer place until the
sun rose. Then, a pouch containing miswaks (tooth-cleaning sticks) would be brought
to him, and he would use them one by one. Afterward, he would be given frankincense,
which he would chew for some time before leaving it aside. He would then be brought
a Qur'an, which he would read from.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 504 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 9, p. 1554 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 26 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p. 460

Chapter Title: THE DISLIKE OF SLEEPING AFTER THE FAJR PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلِّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «مَنْ جَلَسَ فِي مُصَلاَهُ مِنْ صَلاَةِ ٱَلْفَجْرِ إِلَى طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ سَتَرَهُ
اللَّهُ مِنَ النَّارِ.
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"Whoever remains seated in their place of prayer after the Fajr prayer until the sun
rises, Allah {SWT} will protect them from the Fire."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 504 • Tahdhib Al- Ahkam, Part 2, p. 139 • Makarem al-Akhlaq, Part 1, p. 304 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 9, p. 1553 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p. 459

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
arabic_text:
باب - صلاة العيدين
رَوَى جَمِيلُ بْنُ دَرَّاجٍ عَنِ الصَّادِقِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «صَلاَةُ ٱَلْعِيدَيْنِ فَرِيضَةً وَ صَلاَةُ ٱَلْكُسُوفِ فَرِيضَةٌ.
يعنى أنهما من صغار الفرائض، وصغار الفرائض سنن، لرواية حريز:
english_text:
Jamil ibn Darraj narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that
He said: "The prayers of the two Eids (Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha) are obligatory, and
the prayer of the eclipse (Salat al-Kusoof) is also obligatory."
commentary:
It means that they are among the minor obligatory acts, and the minor obligations are
considered Sunnahs, according to the narration of Hariz.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 504 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 443 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 9, p. 1286 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 7, p. 419 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 7, p. 420 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 7, p. 483

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
arabic_text:
عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «صَلاَةُ ٱلْعِيدَيْنِ مَعَ الْإِمَامِ سُنَّةٌ وَ لَيْسَ قَبْلَهُمَا وَ لاَ بَعْدَهُمَا
صَلاَةٌ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمَ إِلَى الزَّوَالِ.
ووجوب العيد إنما هو مع إمام عدل.
english_text:
From Zurarah, from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} who said:
"The prayer of the two Eids (Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha) with the Imam is a Sunnah, and
there is no prayer before or after them on that day until noon (zawal)."
commentary: The obligation of the holiday is only with a just Imam.
